	public interface IPdfDocumentEditHistoryItem
	{
		void Redo();

		void Undo();
	}
	public abstract class PdfDocumentEditHistoryItem : IPdfDocumentEditHistoryItem
	{
		public abstract void Redo();

		public abstract void Undo();
	}
	public class PdfDocumentEditHistory
	{
		private const int maxItemCount = 50000;

		private readonly Stack<IPdfDocumentEditHistoryItem> undoStack = new Stack<IPdfDocumentEditHistoryItem>();

		private readonly Stack<IPdfDocumentEditHistoryItem> redoStack = new Stack<IPdfDocumentEditHistoryItem>();

		public bool CanUndo => undoStack.Count != 0;

		public bool CanRedo => redoStack.Count != 0;

		public void Register(IPdfDocumentEditHistoryItem item)
		{
			if (undoStack.Count < 50000)
			{
				undoStack.Push(item);
				redoStack.Clear();
			}
		}

		public void Redo()
		{
			if (CanRedo)
			{
				IPdfDocumentEditHistoryItem pdfDocumentEditHistoryItem = redoStack.Pop();
				pdfDocumentEditHistoryItem.Undo();
				undoStack.Push(pdfDocumentEditHistoryItem);
			}
		}

		public void Undo()
		{
			if (CanUndo)
			{
				IPdfDocumentEditHistoryItem pdfDocumentEditHistoryItem = undoStack.Pop();
				pdfDocumentEditHistoryItem.Undo();
				redoStack.Push(pdfDocumentEditHistoryItem);
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			undoStack.Clear();
			redoStack.Clear();
		}
	}

		private IPdfAnnotationController GetAnnotation(PdfMouseAction action)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int pageIndex = ((PdfMouseAction)(ref action)).DocumentPosition.PageIndex;

			{
				return Pages[pageIndex].Annotations.LastOrDefault((IPdfAnnotationController annot) => annot.HitTest(((PdfMouseAction)(ref action)).DocumentPosition.Point, ViewerController.ViewerTool));

		}

		private void UpdateHandler(PdfMouseAction action, bool mouseDown)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IPdfAnnotationController annotation = GetAnnotation(action);
			if (mouseDown)
			{
				if (annotation != null && annotation.CanFocus)
				{
					FocusedAnnotation = annotation;
					if (annotation != null && annotation.CanSelect)
					{
						SelectedAnnotation = annotation;
					}
					else
					{
						SelectedAnnotation = null;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					FocusedAnnotation = null;
					SelectedAnnotation = null;
				}
			}
			PdfInteractiveElementController pdfInteractiveElementController = ((PdfInteractiveElementController)annotation) ?? CurrentTool;
			if (capturedElement != pdfInteractiveElementController)
			{
				capturedElement?.MouseLeave();
				pdfInteractiveElementController?.MouseEnter();
				capturedElement = pdfInteractiveElementController;
			}
		}

			PdfInteractiveElementController pdfInteractiveElementController = capturedElement;

		}

		private bool SetFocus(IPdfAnnotationController annotation)
		{
			if (focusedAnnotation != annotation && (annotation == null || annotation.CanFocus))
			{
				IPdfAnnotationController pdfAnnotationController = focusedAnnotation;
				focusedAnnotation = annotation;
				pdfAnnotationController?.LostFocus();
				focusedAnnotation?.GotFocus();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public PdfTextSearchResults FindText(string text, PdfTextSearchParameters parameters, int newSearchStartPage, Func<int, bool> terminate)
		{
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0085: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00ce: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d8: Expected O, but got Unknown
			searchInProgress = true;
			try
			{
				PdfTextSearchResults val = TextSearch.Find(text, (PdfTextSearchParameters)(((object)parameters) ?? ((object)new PdfTextSearchParameters())), newSearchStartPage, ViewerController.CurrentPageIndex + 1, terminate);
				if ((int)val.Status == 0)
				{
					int num = val.PageNumber - 1;
					ViewerController.EnsureVisible(num, val.BoundingRectangle, inCenter: true);
					PdfWord val2 = val.Words[val.Words.Count - 1];
					PdfTextSelector val3 = new PdfTextSelector((IPdfViewerLayoutInfoProvider)(object)layoutInfoProvider, TextSearch.Cache, SelectionState);
					val3.SelectText(new PdfPageTextRange(num, val.Words[0].Parts.First().WordNumber, 0, val2.Parts.Last().WordNumber, val2.Parts.Last().Characters.Count));
					dataSelector.HideCaret();
				}
				else
				{
					dataSelector.ClearSelection();
					searchInProgress = false;
				}
				return val;
			}
			catch
			{
				searchInProgress = false;
				throw;
			}
		}

				IPdfViewerAnnotation info = PdfViewerAnnotation.Create(selectedAnnotation.AnnotationState);

					selectedAnnotation.RemoveFromPage();

			}
		}

		public void OpenFileAttachment(PdfFileAttachment attachment)
		{
			if (ViewerController.PromptFileAttachmentConfirmation(attachment))
			{
				string fileName = Path.GetFileName(attachment.FileName);
				string text = Path.Combine(PdfTempFolder.Create(), string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileName) ? Path.GetRandomFileName() : fileName);
				SaveFileAttachment(text, attachment);
				ViewerController.StartTrustedProcess(text);
			}
		}

		public void SaveFileAttachment(PdfFileAttachment attachment)
		{
			string text = ViewerController.SaveFileAttachment(attachment);
			try
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					SaveFileAttachment(text, attachment);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ex.Data.Add("path", text);
				throw;
			}
		}

		private void SaveFileAttachment(string path, PdfFileAttachment attachment)
		{
			using Stream stream = File.Create(path);
			byte[] data = attachment.Data;
			if (data != null)
			{
				stream.Write(data, 0, data.Length);
			}
		}

		public void ShowAnnotationPropertiesDialog(PdfMarkupAnnotationPropertiesFormViewModel form)
		{
			if (ViewerController.ReadOnly || form == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool annotationChanged = false;
			PropertyChangedEventHandler value = delegate
			{
				annotationChanged = true;
			};
			form.PropertyChanged += value;
			lockAnnotationChangeEvents = true;
			try
			{
				if (ViewerController.ShowMarkupAnnotationPropertiesDialog(form))
				{
					if (annotationChanged)
					{
						if (ViewerController.RaiseAnnotationChangingEvent(form.CreateOldInfo(), form.Info))
						{
							ViewerController.RaiseAnnotationChangedEvent(form.Info);
						}
						else
						{
							form.RollbackChanges();
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					form.RollbackChanges();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				lockAnnotationChangeEvents = false;
			}
			form.PropertyChanged -= value;
		}

		public PdfDocumentContent GetContentInfo(PdfDocumentPosition position)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0091: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ab: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b1: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0069: Expected O, but got Unknown
			PdfPoint point = position.Point;
			int pageIndex = position.PageIndex;
			bool flag = SelectionState.Contains(position);
			if (pageIndex >= 0 && pageIndex < Pages.Count)
			{
				IPdfPageController pdfPageController = Pages[pageIndex];
				foreach (IPdfAnnotationController annotation in pdfPageController.Annotations)
				{
					if (annotation.HitTest(point, (PdfViewerTool)1))
					{
						return new PdfDocumentContent(position, (PdfDocumentContentType)3, flag);
					}
				}
			}
			PdfDocumentContentType val = (dataSelector.HasText(position) ? ((PdfDocumentContentType)1) : ((!dataSelector.HasImage(position)) ? ((PdfDocumentContentType)0) : ((PdfDocumentContentType)2)));
			return new PdfDocumentContent(position, val, flag);
		}

		public void GoToBookmark(PdfViewerBookmark bookmark)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)bookmark, "bookmark");
			if (bookmark.Outline.DocumentCatalog != ((PdfDocumentStateBase)DocumentState).Document.DocumentCatalog)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The specified bookmark does not belong to the current document.", "bookmark");
			}
			interactiveOperationController.ExecuteInteractiveOperation(bookmark.InteractiveOperation);
		}

		public bool GoToDestination(string destinationName)
		{
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (destinationName == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (DocumentState.NamedDestinations.TryGetValue(destinationName, out var value))
			{
				interactiveOperationController.ExecuteInteractiveOperation(new PdfInteractiveOperation((PdfAction)null, value));
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		void IPdfDocumentCommentController.NotifySelectedCommentChanged(IPdfAnnotationStateComment comment)
		{
			IPdfMarkupAnnotationController pdfMarkupAnnotationController = ((comment == null) ? null : pages[comment.PageNumber - 1].Annotations.OfType<IPdfMarkupAnnotationController>().FirstOrDefault((IPdfMarkupAnnotationController annot) => annot.MarkupAnnotationState.Comment == comment));
			if (pdfMarkupAnnotationController != null)
			{
				if (!pdfMarkupAnnotationController.Select())
				{
					pdfMarkupAnnotationController.Focus();
				}
				ViewerController.EnsureVisible(pdfMarkupAnnotationController.PageIndex, pdfMarkupAnnotationController.Bounds, inCenter: true);
			}
			else
			{
				SelectedAnnotation = null;
				FocusedAnnotation = null;
			}
		}
	}

	public class PdfMarkupAnnotationController<T> : PdfAnnotationController<T>, IPdfMarkupAnnotationController, IPdfAnnotationController where T : IPdfMarkupAnnotationState
	{
		private readonly bool canDrag;

		private readonly List<PdfReplyController> replyControllers;

		protected override bool Selectable => true;

		protected override bool CanDrag
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.DocumentController.ViewerController.ReadOnly)
				{
					return canDrag;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		IPdfMarkupAnnotationState IPdfMarkupAnnotationController.MarkupAnnotationState => (IPdfMarkupAnnotationState)(object)base.AnnotationState;

		public override bool AcceptTabStop
		{
			get
			{
				if (((IPdfAnnotationState)base.AnnotationState).Visible)
				{
					return Selectable;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected override PdfToolTipSettings ToolTip => new PdfToolTipSettings(((IPdfMarkupAnnotationState)base.AnnotationState).Author, ((IPdfAnnotationState)base.AnnotationState).Contents, ((IPdfAnnotationState)base.AnnotationState/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).GetInteractiveArea());

		protected internal PdfMarkupAnnotationController(IPdfPageController page, T annotationState, bool canDrag)
			: base(page, annotationState)
		{
			this.canDrag = canDrag;
			replyControllers = new List<PdfReplyController>(((IEnumerable<IPdfAnnotationStateComment>)((IPdfMarkupAnnotationState)annotationState).Comment.Replies).Select((IPdfAnnotationStateComment r) => new PdfReplyController(base.DocumentController, r)));
			((INotifyCollectionChanged)((IPdfMarkupAnnotationState)annotationState).Comment.Replies).CollectionChanged += OnRepliesChanged;
			((INotifyCollectionChanged)((IPdfMarkupAnnotationState)annotationState).Comment.Reviews).CollectionChanged += OnReviewsChanged;
		}

		private void OnReviewsChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.DocumentController.AnnotationChanged(PdfViewerAnnotation.Create((IPdfAnnotationState)(object)base.AnnotationState));
		}

		private void OnRepliesChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0083: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				foreach (IPdfAnnotationStateComment newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					IPdfAnnotationStateComment comment2 = newItem;
					replyControllers.Add(new PdfReplyController(base.DocumentController, comment2));
					base.DocumentController.ReplyCreated(new PdfViewerReply(comment2));
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				foreach (IPdfAnnotationStateComment oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					IPdfAnnotationStateComment comment = oldItem;
					base.DocumentController.ReplyDeleted(new PdfViewerReply(comment));
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		public PdfMarkupAnnotationPropertiesFormViewModel CreatePropertiesForm()
		{
			return PdfMarkupAnnotationPropertiesFormViewModel.Create(base.DocumentController.DocumentState, (IPdfMarkupAnnotationState)(object)base.AnnotationState);
		}

		protected override void OnAnnotationStateChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnAnnotationStateChanged(sender, e);
			if (e.PropertyName == "Hidden" && ((IPdfAnnotationState)base.AnnotationState).Hidden)
			{
				ClearSelectionAndFocus();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDown(PdfMouseAction action)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			base.OnMouseDown(action);
			if ((int)((PdfMouseAction)(ref action)).Button == 1 && ((PdfMouseAction)(ref action)).Clicks == 2)
			{
				ShowCommentEditor();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			base.OnClick();
			ShowCommentEditor();
		}

		protected override bool SupportsTool(PdfViewerTool tool)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			return (int)tool != 2;
		}

		protected override PdfPopupMenuContext GetPopupMenuContext(PdfMouseAction action)
		{
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (((PdfMouseAction)(ref action)).DocumentPosition.PageIndex != base.PageIndex || !Contains(((PdfMouseAction)(ref action)).DocumentPosition.Point))
			{
				return base.GetPopupMenuContext(action);
			}
			return PdfPopupMenuContext.AnnotationProperties;
		}

		private void ShowCommentEditor()
		{
			base.DocumentController.ShowCommentEditor(((IPdfMarkupAnnotationState)base.AnnotationState).Comment);
		}

	public class PdfPageController : IPdfPageController
	{
		private class PdfPageAnnotationControllerCollection : IReadOnlyList<IPdfAnnotationController>, IReadOnlyCollection<IPdfAnnotationController>, IEnumerable<IPdfAnnotationController>, IEnumerable
		{
			private readonly List<IPdfAnnotationController> annotations;

			private readonly IPdfPageController pageController;

			public IPdfAnnotationController this[int index] => annotations[index];

			public int Count => annotations.Count;

			public PdfPageAnnotationControllerCollection(IPdfPageController pageController, PdfPageState pageState)
			{
				//IL_0067: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0071: Expected O, but got Unknown
				this.pageController = pageController;
				annotations = new List<IPdfAnnotationController>();
				PdfAnnotationControllerFactory pdfAnnotationControllerFactory = new PdfAnnotationControllerFactory(pageController);
				foreach (IPdfAnnotationState annotationState in pageState.AnnotationStates)
				{
					IPdfAnnotationController pdfAnnotationController = ((PdfVisitorBasedFactory<IPdfAnnotationState, IPdfAnnotationController>)pdfAnnotationControllerFactory).Create(annotationState);
					if (pdfAnnotationController != null)
					{
						annotations.Add(pdfAnnotationController);
					}
				}
				pageState.AnnotationsChanged += new PdfPageStateAnnotationsChangedEventHandler(OnPageStateAnnotationsChanged);
			}

			public IEnumerator<IPdfAnnotationController> GetEnumerator()
			{
				return annotations.GetEnumerator();
			}

			IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
			{
				return GetEnumerator();
			}

			private void OnPageStateAnnotationsChanged(IPdfAnnotationState state, bool removed)
			{
				if (removed)
				{
					int num = annotations.FindIndex((IPdfAnnotationController c) => c.AnnotationState == state);
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						if (annotations[num].Selected)
						{
							pageController.DocumentController.SelectedAnnotation = null;
						}
						annotations.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					IPdfAnnotationController pdfAnnotationController = ((PdfVisitorBasedFactory<IPdfAnnotationState, IPdfAnnotationController>)new PdfAnnotationControllerFactory(pageController)).Create(state);
					if (pdfAnnotationController != null)
					{
						annotations.Add(pdfAnnotationController);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly PdfPageState pageState;

		private readonly Lazy<PdfPageAnnotationControllerCollection> annotations;

		public PdfDocumentController DocumentController { get; }

		public IReadOnlyList<IPdfAnnotationController> Annotations => annotations.Value;

		public PdfPageController(PdfDocumentController document, PdfPageState pageState)
		{
			PdfPageController pageController = this;
			DocumentController = document;
			this.pageState = pageState;
			annotations = new Lazy<PdfPageAnnotationControllerCollection>(() => new PdfPageAnnotationControllerCollection(pageController, pageState));
		}

		public IPdfAnnotationController AddTextMarkupAnnotation(IPdfTextMarkupAnnotationBuilder builder)
		{
			pageState.AddTextMarkupAnnotation(builder);
			return Annotations.LastOrDefault();
		}

		public IPdfAnnotationController AddStickyNoteAnnotation(IPdfTextAnnotationBuilder builder)
		{
			pageState.AddTextAnnotation(builder);
			return Annotations.LastOrDefault();
		}
	}

	public class PdfToolTipController : IDisposable
	{
		private interface IToolTip : IDisposable
		{
			void Show(PdfToolTipSettings settings);
		}

		private class DelayedToolTip : IToolTip, IDisposable
		{
			private readonly IPdfViewerController viewerController;

			private readonly int msecDelay;

			private Timer timer;

			public DelayedToolTip(IPdfViewerController viewerController, int msecDelay)
			{
				this.viewerController = viewerController;
				this.msecDelay = msecDelay;
			}

			private void TimerCallback(object state)
			{
				viewerController.SynchronizationContext.Post(ShowToolTip, state);
			}

			private void ShowToolTip(object state)
			{
				//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0011: Expected O, but got Unknown
				viewerController.ShowTooltip((PdfToolTipSettings)state);
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				timer?.Dispose();
			}

			public void Show(PdfToolTipSettings settings)
			{
				timer = new Timer(TimerCallback, settings, msecDelay, -1);
			}
		}

		private class ToolTip : IToolTip, IDisposable
		{
			private readonly IPdfViewerController controller;

			public ToolTip(IPdfViewerController controller)
			{
				this.controller = controller;
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
			}

			public void Show(PdfToolTipSettings settings)
			{
				controller.ShowTooltip(settings);
			}
		}

		private readonly IPdfViewerController viewerController;

		private object toolTipOwner;

		private IToolTip toolTip;

		public PdfToolTipController(IPdfViewerController viewerController)
		{
			this.viewerController = viewerController;
		}

		public void ShowToolTip(object owner, PdfToolTipSettings settings, int delayInMilliseconds)
		{
			if (toolTipOwner != owner)
			{
				HideToolTip();
			}
			toolTipOwner = owner;
			IToolTip obj;
			if (delayInMilliseconds != 0)
			{
				IToolTip toolTip = new DelayedToolTip(viewerController, delayInMilliseconds);
				obj = toolTip;
			}
			else
			{
				IToolTip toolTip = new ToolTip(viewerController);
				obj = toolTip;
			}
			this.toolTip = obj;
			this.toolTip.Show(settings);
		}

		public void ShowToolTip(object owner, PdfToolTipSettings settings)
		{
			ShowToolTip(owner, settings, 0);
		}

		public void HideToolTip(object owner)
		{
			if (toolTipOwner == owner)
			{
				HideToolTip();
			}
		}

		public void HideToolTips()
		{
			HideToolTip();
		}

		private void HideToolTip()
		{
			toolTip?.Dispose();
			viewerController.HideTooltip();
			toolTip = null;
			toolTipOwner = null;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			HideToolTip();
		}
	}

	internal class Win32IconService : PdfFileIconService
	{
		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static int GetIconIndex(string pszFile)
		{
			SHFILEINFO fileInfo = default(SHFILEINFO);
			Shell32Interop.SHGetFileInfo(pszFile, (ShellFileAttributes)0, ref fileInfo, Marshal.SizeOf(fileInfo), SHGFI.SysIconIndex | SHGFI.UseFileAttributes);
			return fileInfo.iIcon;
		}

		private static int GetIconSize(int dimension)
		{
			if (dimension <= 16)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (dimension > 16 && dimension <= 32)
			{
				if (!((double)(dimension - 16) / 16.0 >= 0.5))
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
			if (dimension > 32 && dimension <= 48)
			{
				if (!((double)(dimension - 32) / 16.0 >= 0.5))
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return 2;
			}
			if (dimension > 48 && dimension <= 256)
			{
				if (!((double)(dimension - 48) / 208.0 >= 0.5))
				{
					return 2;
				}
				return 4;
			}
			return 4;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private IntPtr GetIconHandle(string extension, int iconSize)
		{
			IImageList ppv = null;
			Guid riid = Shell32Interop.IID_IImageList;
			int iconIndex = GetIconIndex(extension);
			Shell32Interop.SHGetImageList(iconSize, ref riid, ref ppv);
			IntPtr picon = IntPtr.Zero;
			ppv.GetIcon(iconIndex, 33, ref picon);
			if (picon == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				ppv.GetIcon(0, 33, ref picon);
			}
			return picon;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected override byte[] GetIconData(string extension, int dimension)
		{
			IntPtr iconHandle = GetIconHandle(extension, GetIconSize(dimension));
			try
			{
				using Icon icon = Icon.FromHandle(iconHandle);
				using Bitmap bitmap = icon.ToBitmap();
				using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
				bitmap.Save(memoryStream, ImageFormat.Png);
				return memoryStream.ToArray();
			}
			finally
			{
				User32Interop.DestroyIcon(iconHandle);
			}
		}
	}

	public class PdfMouseScrollSynchronizationController : IDisposable
	{
		private const int scrollTimeInterval = 10;

		private readonly IPdfViewerController viewerController;

		private Timer scrollTimer;

		private static void SynchronizeWithMousePosition(object controller)
		{
			if (controller is IPdfViewerController pdfViewerController)
			{
				pdfViewerController.SynchronizeWithMousePosition();
			}
		}

		private static void OnTimerClick(object controller)
		{
			if (controller is IPdfViewerController pdfViewerController)
			{
				pdfViewerController.SynchronizationContext.Post(SynchronizeWithMousePosition, controller);
			}
		}

		public PdfMouseScrollSynchronizationController(IPdfViewerController viewerController)
		{
			this.viewerController = viewerController;
		}

		public void Start()
		{
			if (scrollTimer == null)
			{
				scrollTimer = new Timer(OnTimerClick, viewerController, 10, 10);
			}
		}

		public void Stop()
		{
			if (scrollTimer != null)
			{
				scrollTimer.Dispose();
			}
			scrollTimer = null;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Stop();
		}
	}

	public class PdfProcessingBackend : IDisposable, IPdfRenderingFontInfoProvider, IPdfPlatformServiceProvider, IPdfRenderFontStorage
	{
		private const long defaultCacheSizeInMegabytes = 300L;

		private readonly IPdfPrintingCallbackProvider callbackProvider;

		private readonly Lazy<IPdfFileIconService> iconService;

		private PdfDocumentRenderer renderer;

		private long imageCacheSizeInMegabytes = 300L;

		private int maxPrintingDpi;

		private PdfRenderingEngine renderingEngine;

		private PdfDocumentState documentState;

		private string fullTextCache;

		public PdfDocumentState DocumentState => documentState;

		public PdfDocument Document
		{
			get
			{
				if (documentState != null)

					return ((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentState).Document;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public long ImageCacheSize
		{
			get
			{
				return imageCacheSizeInMegabytes;
			}
			set

				imageCacheSizeInMegabytes = value;
				if (renderer != null)
				{
					renderer.ImageCacheSize = ImageCacheSizeInBytes;
				}
			}
		}

		private long ImageCacheSizeInBytes => imageCacheSizeInMegabytes * 1024 * 1024;

		public PdfRenderingEngine RenderingEngine
		{
			get
			{
				return renderingEngine;
			}
			set

		}

		public int MaxPrintingDpi
		{

		protected virtual bool SupportsCaching => false;

		private static void ValidateDpiValue(float imageDpi)
		{
			if (float.IsInfinity(imageDpi) || float.IsNaN(imageDpi) || imageDpi <= 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("imageDpi");
			}
		}

		public PdfProcessingBackend(IPdfPrintingCallbackProvider callbackProvider)

			iconService = new Lazy<IPdfFileIconService>(() => (IPdfFileIconService)(object)new Win32IconService());
		}

		private void DisposeDocumentState()
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentState).PageInvalidate -= new PdfPageStateInvalidateEventHandler(OnPageInvalidate);
			((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentState).PagesChanged -= OnPagesChanged;
			((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentState).Dispose();
			documentState = null;
		}

		public void SetDocument(PdfDocument document)
		{
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (documentState != null)
			{
				DisposeDocumentState();
				DisposeRenderer();
			}
			if (document != null)
			{
				documentState = new PdfDocumentState(document, (IPdfPlatformServiceProvider)(object)this);
				((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentState).PageInvalidate += new PdfPageStateInvalidateEventHandler(OnPageInvalidate);
				((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentState).PagesChanged += OnPagesChanged;
			}
			OnSetDocumentState(documentState);
		}

		protected void Print(PdfPrinterSettings printerSettings, Func<PdfPrinterSettings, PdfDocumentPrinter> createPrinter)
		{
			if (printerSettings == null)
			{
				printerSettings = new PdfPrinterSettings();
			}
			printerSettings.MaxDpi = maxPrintingDpi;
			if (documentState != null && ((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentState).Document.Pages.Count > 0)
			{
				PdfDocumentPrinter pdfDocumentPrinter = createPrinter(printerSettings);
				pdfDocumentPrinter.CallbackProvider = callbackProvider;
				pdfDocumentPrinter.Print();
			}
		}

		public virtual void Print(PdfPrinterSettings printerSettings)
		{
			Print(printerSettings, (PdfPrinterSettings actualSettings) => new PdfDocumentPrinter(Renderer, documentState, actualSettings));
		}

		public DXBitmap CreateBitmap(int pageNumber, PdfPageRenderingParameters options)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)options, "options");
			int largestEdgeLength;
			if (!options.LargestEdgeLength.HasValue)
			{
				ValidateDpiValue(options.Dpi.Value);
				largestEdgeLength = ValidatePageNumberAndCalculateLargestEdgeLength(pageNumber, options.Dpi.Value);
			}
			else
			{
				largestEdgeLength = options.LargestEdgeLength.Value;
			}
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = CreateBitmap(pageNumber, largestEdgeLength, PdfRenderMode.Print);
			if (options.Dpi.HasValue)
			{
				dXBitmap.SetResolution(options.Dpi.Value, options.Dpi.Value);
			}
			return dXBitmap;
		}

		public DXBitmap CreateBitmap(int pageNumber, int largestEdgeLength)
		{
			return CreateBitmap(pageNumber, largestEdgeLength, PdfRenderMode.Print);
		}

		public DXBitmap CreateBitmap(int pageNumber, int largestEdgeLength, PdfRenderMode renderMode)
		{
			return CreateBitmap(pageNumber, largestEdgeLength, renderMode, renderStickyNotes: true);
		}

		private DXBitmap CreateBitmap(int pageNumber, int largestEdgeLength, PdfRenderMode renderMode, bool renderStickyNotes)
		{
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			CheckPageNumber(pageNumber);
			if (largestEdgeLength < 1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("largestEdgeLength", PdfCoreLocalizer.GetString((PdfCoreStringId)43));
			}
			int num = pageNumber - 1;
			PdfPageState val = ((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentState)[num];
			PdfSize viewSize = val.GetViewSize();
			float scale = (float)largestEdgeLength / (float)Math.Max(((PdfSize)(ref viewSize)).Width, ((PdfSize)(ref viewSize)).Height);
			Size size = viewSize.ToGDISizeI(scale);
			int width = size.Width;
			int height = size.Height;
			DXBitmap dXBitmap;
			try
			{
				dXBitmap = CreateBitmapCore(width, height);
			}
			catch (Exception innerException)
			{
				throw new PdfRenderingOutOfMemoryException(innerException);
			}
			try
			{
				PdfPagePrintingInfo info = new PdfPagePrintingInfo(scale, renderMode, val, PointF.Empty)
				{
					RenderStickyNotes = renderStickyNotes
				};
				Renderer.RenderToBitmap(info, dXBitmap);
				return dXBitmap;
			}
			catch (COMException innerException2)
			{
				throw new PdfRenderingOutOfMemoryException(innerException2);
			}
			catch
			{
				dXBitmap.Dispose();
				throw;
			}
		}

		private DXBitmap CreateBitmapCore(int pageWidth, int pageHeight)
		{
			if (Renderer.IsGdiPlusOnly)
			{
				Bitmap image = new Bitmap(pageWidth, pageHeight, PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb);
				return (DXBitmap)SystemDrawingConverter.WrapImage(image);
			}
			return new DXBitmap(pageWidth, pageHeight, DXPixelFormat.ARGB32bpp);
		}

		public void CreateTiff(Stream stream, int largestEdgeLength)
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			for (int i = 0; i < ((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentState).Document.Pages.Count; i++)
			{
				list.Add(i + 1);
			}
			CreateTiff(stream, largestEdgeLength, list);
		}

		public void CreateTiff(Stream stream, IEnumerable<int> pageNumbers, float imageDpi)
		{
			ValidateDpiValue(imageDpi);
			CreateTiff(stream, pageNumbers, imageDpi, (int number) => ValidatePageNumberAndCalculateLargestEdgeLength(number, imageDpi));
		}

		public void CreateTiff(Stream stream, int largestEdgeLength, IEnumerable<int> pageNumbers)
		{
			CreateTiff(stream, pageNumbers, null, (int number) => largestEdgeLength);
		}

			{
				DisposeDocumentState();
			}
			DisposeRenderer();
		}

		public string GetFullTextNoCache(PdfTextExtractionOptions options)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0057: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PdfDocument document = Document;
			if (document == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			List<PdfPageTextRange> list = new List<PdfPageTextRange>();
			for (int i = 0; i < document.Pages.Count; i++)
			{
				list.Add(new PdfPageTextRange(i));
			}
			return new PdfTextSelection(new PdfPageDataCache(document.Pages, (IPdfRenderingFontInfoProvider)(object)this, false, options == null || options.ClipToCropBox), (IList<PdfPageTextRange>)list).Text;
		}

		private void UpdateRenderer()
		{
			renderer = CreateRenderer(renderingEngine);
		}

		private PdfDirectXRendererFlags GetDirectXRendererFlags()
		{
			PdfDirectXRendererFlags pdfDirectXRendererFlags = PdfDirectXRendererFlags.None;
			if (SupportsCaching)
			{
				pdfDirectXRendererFlags |= PdfDirectXRendererFlags.SupportsCaching;
			}
			if (RenderingEngine == PdfRenderingEngine.DirectXSoftware)
			{
				pdfDirectXRendererFlags |= PdfDirectXRendererFlags.ForceSoftwareRendering;
			}
			return pdfDirectXRendererFlags;
		}

		private PdfDocumentRenderer CreateRenderer(PdfRenderingEngine engine)
		{
			return engine switch
			{
				PdfRenderingEngine.GdiPlus => new PdfGDIDocumentRenderer(ImageCacheSizeInBytes), 
				PdfRenderingEngine.DirectX => new PdfDirectXDocumentRenderer(new PdfDirectXRendererOptions(ImageCacheSizeInBytes, GetDirectXRendererFlags())), 
				PdfRenderingEngine.Skia => CreateSkiaRenderer(), 
				_ => CreateDefaultRender(), 
			};
		}

		private PdfDocumentRenderer CreateDefaultRender()
		{
			try
			{
				return new PdfDirectXDocumentRenderer(new PdfDirectXRendererOptions(ImageCacheSizeInBytes, GetDirectXRendererFlags()));
			}
			catch
			{
				return new PdfGDIDocumentRenderer(ImageCacheSizeInBytes);
			}
		}

		private PdfDocumentRenderer CreateSkiaRenderer()
		{
			Assembly assembly = AssemblyHelper.GetLoadedAssembly("DevExpress.Pdf.v23.2.SkiaRenderer") ?? SafeTypeResolver.GetOrLoadAssembly("DevExpress.Pdf.v23.2.SkiaRenderer, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", false);
			if (assembly == null)
			{
				throw new Exception("The 'DevExpress.Pdf.v23.2.SkiaRenderer.dll' assembly reference is missing.");
			}
			Type knownType = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownType(assembly, "DevExpress.Pdf.Drawing.Skia.PdfSkiaDocumentRenderer", false, (bool?)null);
			return (PdfDocumentRenderer)Activator.CreateInstance(knownType, ImageCacheSizeInBytes);
		}

		private void OnPageInvalidate(object sender, PdfPageStateInvalidateEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.InvalidateContent)
			{
				Renderer?.InvalidateContentStreamCache(((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentState)[e.PageIndex].Page);
			}
			Renderer?.InvalidateBitmapCache(e.PageIndex, e.Rectangle);
			if (e.InvalidateContent)
			{
				fullTextCache = null;
			}
		}

		private void OnPagesChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			fullTextCache = null;
		}

		private void CheckPageNumber(int pageNumber)
		{
			if (pageNumber < 1 || pageNumber > ((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentState).Document.Pages.Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("pageNumber", PdfCoreLocalizer.GetString((PdfCoreStringId)40));
			}
		}

		private void CreateTiff(Stream stream, IEnumerable<int> pageNumbers, float? dpi, Func<int, int> calcLargestEdgeLength)
		{
			if (stream == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("stream");
			}
			if (pageNumbers == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("pageNumbers");
			}
			if (!pageNumbers.Any())
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(PdfCoreLocalizer.GetString((PdfCoreStringId)67));
			}
			using IMultiPageTiffBuilder multiPageTiffBuilder = CreateTiffBuilder(stream);
			foreach (int pageNumber in pageNumbers)
			{
				DXBitmap dXBitmap = CreateBitmap(pageNumber, calcLargestEdgeLength(pageNumber));
				if (dpi.HasValue)
				{
					dXBitmap.SetResolution(dpi.Value, dpi.Value);
				}
				multiPageTiffBuilder.AppendPage(dXBitmap);
			}
		}

		private IMultiPageTiffBuilder CreateTiffBuilder(Stream stream)
		{
			DXTiffImageFormatOptions imageOptions = new DXTiffImageFormatOptions(DXTiffCompression.LZW);
			if (Renderer.IsGdiPlusOnly)
			{
				return new GdiMultiPageTiffBuilder(stream, imageOptions);
			}
			return DXDrawingEngine.CreateTiffBuilder(stream, imageOptions);
		}

				renderer = null;
			}
		}

		public void CheckPlatformOperation(bool isGdiMethod, string crossplatformMethodName = "")
		{
			if (!PlatformHelpers.IsWindows && !DXDrawingEngine.IsGDIPlusAvailable)
			{
				if (Renderer.IsGdiPlusOnly)
				{
					throw new PlatformNotSupportedException($"If RenderingEngine is set to {RenderingEngine}, this method works only on Windows. Specify another rendering engine to perform this operation.");
				}
				if (isGdiMethod)
				{
					throw new PlatformNotSupportedException("This method is unavailable in non-Windows environments. Use the " + crossplatformMethodName + " method instead.");
				}
			}
		}

		private int ValidatePageNumberAndCalculateLargestEdgeLength(int pageNumber, float imageDpi)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			CheckPageNumber(pageNumber);
			int num = pageNumber - 1;
			PdfPageState val = ((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentState)[num];
			PdfSize viewSize = val.GetViewSize();
			return (int)Math.Round(Math.Max(((PdfSize)(ref viewSize)).Width, ((PdfSize)(ref viewSize)).Height) / 72.0 * (double)imageDpi);
		}

		}

		}

	public class PdfTabBackwardNavigationStrategy : PdfTabNavigationStrategy
	{
		protected override int StartPageIndex => base.PageCount - 1;

		protected override int Step => -1;

		protected override IPdfAnnotationController GetPageFirstAnnotationStateController(IReadOnlyList<IPdfAnnotationController> page)
		{
			if (page != null && page.Count != 0)
			{
				return page[page.Count - 1];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public PdfTabBackwardNavigationStrategy(PdfTabNavigationController tabNavigationController, IPdfDocumentController documentController)
			: base(tabNavigationController, documentController)
		{
		}
	}
	public class PdfTabForwardNavigationStrategy : PdfTabNavigationStrategy
	{
		protected override int StartPageIndex => 0;

		protected override int Step => 1;

		protected override IPdfAnnotationController GetPageFirstAnnotationStateController(IReadOnlyList<IPdfAnnotationController> page)
		{
			if (page != null && page.Count != 0)
			{
				return page[0];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public PdfTabForwardNavigationStrategy(PdfTabNavigationController tabNavigationController, IPdfDocumentController documentController)
			: base(tabNavigationController, documentController)
		{
		}
	}
	public abstract class PdfTabNavigationStrategy
	{
		private readonly IPdfDocumentController documentController;

		private readonly PdfTabNavigationController tabNavigationController;

		protected abstract int Step { get; }

		protected abstract int StartPageIndex { get; }

		protected int PageCount => ((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentController.DocumentState).Document.Pages.Count;

		protected IPdfAnnotationController FirstAnnotationStateController => GetFirstAnnotationStateController(-1);

		private static int IndexOf(IReadOnlyList<IPdfAnnotationController> page, IPdfAnnotationController element)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < page.Count; i++)
			{
				if (page[i] == element)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		protected IPdfAnnotationController GetNextAnnotationStateController(IPdfAnnotationController current)
		{
			if (current == null)
			{
				return FirstAnnotationStateController;
			}
			int pageIndex = current.PageIndex;
			IReadOnlyList<IPdfAnnotationController> annotations = documentController.Pages[pageIndex].Annotations;
			if (annotations != null)
			{
				int num = IndexOf(annotations, current);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					num += Step;
					if (num < 0 || num >= annotations.Count)
					{
						return GetPageFirstAnnotationStateController(GetNextPageWithAnnotations(pageIndex));
					}
					return annotations[num];
				}
			}
			return GetPageFirstAnnotationStateController(GetNextPageWithAnnotations(pageIndex));
		}

		protected PdfTabNavigationStrategy(PdfTabNavigationController tabNavigationController, IPdfDocumentController documentController)
		{
			this.documentController = documentController;
			this.tabNavigationController = tabNavigationController;
		}

		public void TabNext(int lastPageIndex)
		{
			IPdfAnnotationController pdfAnnotationController = ((documentController.FocusedAnnotation != null) ? GetNextAnnotationStateController(documentController.FocusedAnnotation) : GetFirstAnnotationStateController(lastPageIndex));
			if (pdfAnnotationController == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IPdfAnnotationController pdfAnnotationController2 = pdfAnnotationController;
			while (!pdfAnnotationController.AcceptTabStop)
			{
				pdfAnnotationController = GetNextAnnotationStateController(pdfAnnotationController);
				if (pdfAnnotationController == pdfAnnotationController2)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (pdfAnnotationController != null && pdfAnnotationController.AcceptTabStop)
			{
				tabNavigationController.LastPageIndex = pdfAnnotationController.PageIndex;
				documentController.ViewerController.EnsureVisible(pdfAnnotationController.PageIndex, pdfAnnotationController.Bounds, inCenter: true);
				documentController.FocusedAnnotation = pdfAnnotationController;
			}
		}

		protected abstract IPdfAnnotationController GetPageFirstAnnotationStateController(IReadOnlyList<IPdfAnnotationController> page);

		protected IReadOnlyList<IPdfAnnotationController> GetNextPageWithAnnotations(int currentPageIndex)
		{
			int num = currentPageIndex + Step;
			int num2 = num;
			int pageCount = PageCount;
			if (num2 >= pageCount || num2 < 0)
			{
				num2 = StartPageIndex;
			}
			int step = Step;
			if (pageCount == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			do
			{
				IReadOnlyList<IPdfAnnotationController> annotations = documentController.Pages[num2].Annotations;
				if (annotations != null && annotations.Count > 0)
				{
					return annotations;
				}
				num2 += step;
				if (num2 < 0 || num2 >= pageCount)
				{
					num2 = StartPageIndex;
				}
			}
			while (num2 != num);
			return null;
		}

		protected IPdfAnnotationController GetFirstAnnotationStateController(int lastPageIndex)
		{
			int currentPageIndex = ((lastPageIndex == -1) ? StartPageIndex : lastPageIndex) - Step;
			IReadOnlyList<IPdfAnnotationController> nextPageWithAnnotations = GetNextPageWithAnnotations(currentPageIndex);
			if (nextPageWithAnnotations != null)
			{
				return GetPageFirstAnnotationStateController(nextPageWithAnnotations);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public class PdfInteractiveOperationController : IPdfInteractiveOperationController
	{
		private readonly IPdfDocumentController documentController;

		private bool isContinueExecuting = true;

		private IPdfViewerController ViewerController => documentController.ViewerController;

		private int CurrentPageIndex => ViewerController.CurrentPageIndex;

		public PdfInteractiveOperationController(IPdfDocumentController documentController)
		{
			this.documentController = documentController;
		}

		public void ShowDocumentPosition(PdfTarget target)
		{
			int pageIndex = target.PageIndex;
			if (pageIndex >= 0 && pageIndex < documentController.Pages.Count)
			{
				ViewerController.ShowDocumentPosition(target);
				UpdateTabNavigationPage();
			}
		}

		public void ExecuteInteractiveOperation(PdfInteractiveOperation interactiveOperation)
		{
			if (interactiveOperation != null)
			{
				PdfDestination destination = interactiveOperation.Destination;
				if (destination != null)
				{
					ShowDocumentPosition(destination.CreateTarget(((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentController.DocumentState).Document.Pages));
				}
				isContinueExecuting = true;
				ExecuteAllActions(interactiveOperation.Action, new List<PdfAction>());
			}
		}

		private void ExecuteAllActions(PdfAction action, List<PdfAction> executedAction)
		{
			if (action == null || executedAction.Contains(action) || !isContinueExecuting)
			{
				return;
			}
			action.Execute((IPdfInteractiveOperationController)(object)this, ((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentController.DocumentState).Document.Pages);
			executedAction.Add(action);
			if (action.Next == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (PdfAction item in action.Next)
			{
				ExecuteAllActions(item, executedAction);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateTabNavigationPage()
		{
			PdfTabNavigationController tabNavigationController = documentController.TabNavigationController;
			if (tabNavigationController.LastPageIndex != CurrentPageIndex)
			{
				tabNavigationController.LastPageIndex = CurrentPageIndex;
				documentController.FocusedAnnotation = null;
			}
		}

		private void ResetField(IPdfFormFieldProvider state)
		{
			state.ResetValue();
		}

		private bool ContainsField(IEnumerable<PdfInteractiveFormField> fields, PdfInteractiveFormField interactiveFormField)
		{
			foreach (PdfInteractiveFormField field in fields)
			{
				if (field == interactiveFormField)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void PerformResetFields(Action<IPdfFormFieldProvider> action)
		{
			//IL_0066: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int count = documentController.Pages.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				PdfInteractiveOperationProviderFactory pdfInteractiveOperationProviderFactory = new PdfInteractiveOperationProviderFactory();
				PdfPageState val = ((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentController.DocumentState)[i];
				foreach (IPdfAnnotationState annotationState in val.AnnotationStates)
				{
					IPdfFormFieldProvider val2 = ((PdfVisitorBasedFactory<IPdfAnnotationState, IPdfFormFieldProvider>)pdfInteractiveOperationProviderFactory).Create(annotationState);
					if (val2 != null && (val2.FormField == null || !((Enum)val2.FormField.Flags).HasFlag((Enum)(object)(PdfInteractiveFormFieldFlags)65536)))
					{
						action(val2);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		void IPdfInteractiveOperationController.GoToPreviousPage()
		{
			ViewerController.GoToPreviousPage();
			UpdateTabNavigationPage();
		}

		void IPdfInteractiveOperationController.GoToNextPage()
		{
			ViewerController.GoToNextPage();
			UpdateTabNavigationPage();
		}

		void IPdfInteractiveOperationController.GoToFirstPage()
		{
			ViewerController.GoToFirstPage();
			UpdateTabNavigationPage();
		}

		void IPdfInteractiveOperationController.GoToLastPage()
		{
			ViewerController.GoToLastPage();
			UpdateTabNavigationPage();
		}

		void IPdfInteractiveOperationController.OpenUri(string uriValue)
		{
			uriValue = uriValue.Trim();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(uriValue))
			{
				return;
			}
			Uri uri = new Uri(uriValue, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
			string documentFilePath = ViewerController.DocumentFilePath;
			if (!uri.IsAbsoluteUri)
			{
				try
				{
					uri = new Uri(new Uri(documentFilePath), uriValue);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			if (ViewerController.PromptURIConfirmation(uri))
			{
				ViewerController.StartTrustedProcess(uri.ToString());
			}
		}

		void IPdfInteractiveOperationController.OpenDocument(string documentPath, PdfTarget target, bool openInNewWindow)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			try
			{
				if (ViewerController.OpenDocument(documentPath, (PdfTarget)(((object)target) ?? ((object)new PdfTarget((PdfTargetMode)0, 0))), openInNewWindow))
				{
					isContinueExecuting = false;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		void IPdfInteractiveOperationController.ShellExecute(string filePath, string defaultDirectory, string parameters)
		{
			try
			{
				if (ViewerController.ShellExecute(filePath, defaultDirectory, parameters))
				{
					isContinueExecuting = false;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		void IPdfInteractiveOperationController.ShowPrintDialog()
		{
			ViewerController.ShowPrintDialog();
		}

		void IPdfInteractiveOperationController.ResetFormFields(IEnumerable<PdfInteractiveFormField> fields)
		{
			PerformResetFields(delegate(IPdfFormFieldProvider controller)
			{
				if (ContainsField(fields, controller.FormField))
				{
					ResetField(controller);
				}
			});
		}

		void IPdfInteractiveOperationController.ResetFormExcludingFields(IEnumerable<PdfInteractiveFormField> fields)
		{
			PerformResetFields(delegate(IPdfFormFieldProvider controller)
			{
				if (!ContainsField(fields, controller.FormField))
				{
					ResetField(controller);
				}
			});
		}

		void IPdfInteractiveOperationController.ResetForm()
		{
			PerformResetFields(delegate(IPdfFormFieldProvider controller)
			{
				ResetField(controller);
			});
		}
	}

		private static PdfTransformationMatrix CalculateBitmapTransformationMatrix(int bitmapWidth, int bitmapHeight, PdfRectangle boundingBox)
		{
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Expected O, but got Unknown
			double num = (double)bitmapWidth / boundingBox.Width;
			double num2 = (double)bitmapHeight / boundingBox.Height;
			return new PdfTransformationMatrix(num, 0.0, 0.0, num2, (0.0 - boundingBox.Left) * num, (0.0 - boundingBox.Bottom) * num2);
		}

		private static void ApplySoftMask(PdfCustomSoftMask softMask, Bitmap bitmap, Bitmap softMaskBitmap)
		{
			if (softMask is PdfLuminositySoftMask)
			{
				PdfLuminosityMaskBlender.Blend(bitmap, softMaskBitmap, softMask.TransferFunction);
			}
			else
			{
				PdfAlphaMaskBlender.Blend(bitmap, softMaskBitmap, softMask.TransferFunction);
			}
		}

		private static double CalculateDistanceSquare(PointF point1, PointF point2)
		{
			double num = point2.X - point1.X;
			double num2 = point2.Y - point1.Y;
			return num * num + num2 * num2;
		}

		public PointF TransformPoint(PdfPoint point)
		{
			double num = offsetX + (double)scale * ((PdfPoint)(ref point)).X;
			double num2 = offsetY - (double)scale * ((PdfPoint)(ref point)).Y;
			return new PointF((float)num, (float)num2);
		}

		public Size CalculateSize(PdfTransformationMatrix matrix, PdfRectangle boundingBox)
		{
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0051: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0064: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0069: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (boundingBox.Width == 0.0 || boundingBox.Height == 0.0)
			{
				return Size.Empty;
			}
			PointF pointF = TransformPoint(matrix.Transform(boundingBox.TopLeft));
			PointF pointF2 = TransformPoint(matrix.Transform(boundingBox.TopRight));
			PointF point = TransformPoint(matrix.Transform(boundingBox.BottomRight));
			PointF point2 = TransformPoint(matrix.Transform(boundingBox.BottomLeft));
			return new Size(Math.Max(1, Convert.ToInt32(Math.Sqrt(Math.Max(CalculateDistanceSquare(pointF2, pointF), CalculateDistanceSquare(point, point2))))), Math.Max(1, Convert.ToInt32(Math.Sqrt(Math.Max(CalculateDistanceSquare(pointF, point2), CalculateDistanceSquare(point, pointF2))))));
		}

		private Matrix GetImageMatrix(PointF location)
		{
			PdfTransformationMatrix transformationMatrix = ((PdfCommandInterpreter)this).GraphicsState.TransformationMatrix;
			return new Matrix((float)transformationMatrix.A * scale, (float)(0.0 - transformationMatrix.B) * scale, (float)(0.0 - transformationMatrix.C) * scale, (float)transformationMatrix.D * scale, location.X, location.Y);
		}

		public Bitmap GetBackdropBitmap(PdfRectangle boundingBox, int bitmapWidth, int bitmapHeight)
		{
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			{
				new PointF(0f, 0f),
				new PointF(x, 0f),
				new PointF(0f, y),
				new PointF(x, y)
			};
			matrix.TransformPoints(array);
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			double num2 = double.MinValue;
			double num3 = double.MaxValue;
			double num4 = double.MinValue;

			for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
			{
				PointF pointF = array2[i];
				double num5 = pointF.X;
				num = PdfMathUtils.Min(num, num5);
				num2 = PdfMathUtils.Max(num2, num5);
				double num6 = pointF.Y;
				num3 = PdfMathUtils.Min(num3, num6);
				num4 = PdfMathUtils.Max(num4, num6);
			}
			int num7 = PdfMathUtils.ToInt32(num);
			int num8 = PdfMathUtils.ToInt32(num3);
			int num9 = PdfMathUtils.ToInt32(num2) - num7 + 1;
			int num10 = PdfMathUtils.ToInt32(num4) - num8 + 1;

		private void PerformGraphicsOperation(Action action)
		{
			if (IsInTextRendering)
			{
				try
				{
					DoEndText();
					action();
					return;
				}
				finally
				{
					DoBeginText();
				}
			}
			action();
		}

		private bool IsFlatPath(bool forFilling)
		{
			if (!ShouldUseRectangularGraphicsPath || ((PdfCommandInterpreter)this).GraphicsState.SmoothnessTolerance != 0.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (PdfGraphicsPath path in ((PdfCommandInterpreter)this).Paths)
			{
				if (!path.IsFlat(forFilling))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void UpdateSmoothingMode(bool forFilling)
		{
			if (IsFlatPath(forFilling))
			{
				graphics.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.None;
			}
		}

		private void EnsureEndText()
		{
			if (IsInTextRendering)
			{
				((PdfCommandInterpreter)this).EndText();
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private void DoBeginText()
		{
			if (!IsInTextRendering)
			{
				textRenderer = new GDITextRenderer(graphics, currentState.Clip, fontQuality);
				UpdateCurrentFont();
				UpdateTextColor();
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private void DoEndText()
		{
			if (IsInTextRendering)
			{
				textRenderer.Dispose();
				textRenderer = null;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCurrentFont()
		{
			if (IsInTextRendering)
			{
				PdfTextState textState = ((PdfCommandInterpreter)this).GraphicsState.TextState;
				PdfFont font = textState.Font;
				if (font != null && !(font is PdfType3Font))
				{
					textRenderer.Font = Context.FontStorage.GetRenderFont(font);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateTextColor()
		{
			if (IsInTextRendering)
			{
				PdfColor nonStrokingColor = ((PdfCommandInterpreter)this).GraphicsState.NonStrokingColor;
				int textColor;
				if (nonStrokingColor == null)
				{
					textColor = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					PdfRGBColorData val = default(PdfRGBColorData);
					((PdfRGBColorData)(ref val))..ctor(nonStrokingColor);
					textColor = (Convert.ToByte(((PdfRGBColorData)(ref val)).B * 255.0) << 16) + (Convert.ToByte(((PdfRGBColorData)(ref val)).G * 255.0) << 8) + Convert.ToByte(((PdfRGBColorData)(ref val)).R * 255.0);
				}
				textRenderer.TextColor = textColor;
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private void DrawString(short[] stringData, double[] glyphOffsets)
		{
			//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_010d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			val = PdfTransformationMatrix.Multiply(val, textState.TextMatrix);

			float num4 = 0f;

			}

			{
				using (GraphicsPath stringPath = textRenderer.GetTextOutline(stringData, array, val, isIndices))

					return;
				}
			}

		private void DrawStringPath(GraphicsPath stringPath)
		{
			if (stringPath == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			PerformGraphicsOperation(delegate
			{
				//IL_009f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00a4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00a5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00c7: Expected I4, but got Unknown
				GraphicsState gstate = graphics.Save();
				try
				{
					graphics.ResetTransform();
					PdfTransformationMatrix val = PdfTransformationMatrix.Multiply(((PdfCommandInterpreter)this).GraphicsState.TransformationMatrix, DeviceTransformationMatrix);
					using (Matrix transform = new Matrix((float)val.A, (float)val.B, (float)val.C, (float)val.D, (float)val.E, (float)val.F))
					{
						graphics.Transform = transform;
					}
					PdfTextRenderingMode renderingMode = ((PdfCommandInterpreter)this).GraphicsState.TextState.RenderingMode;
					switch ((int)renderingMode)
					{
					case 0:
					case 4:
						FillStringPath(stringPath);
						break;
					case 1:
					case 5:
						StrokeStringPath(stringPath);
						break;
					case 2:
					case 6:
						FillStringPath(stringPath);
						StrokeStringPath(stringPath);
						break;
					case 3:
						break;
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					graphics.Restore(gstate);
				}
			});
		}

		private double CalcLength(PdfPoint direction)
		{
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_003d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PdfTransformationMatrix transformationMatrix = ((PdfCommandInterpreter)this).GraphicsState.TransformationMatrix;
			PdfTransformationMatrix val = new PdfTransformationMatrix(transformationMatrix.A, transformationMatrix.B, transformationMatrix.C, transformationMatrix.D, 0.0, 0.0);
			PdfPoint val2 = val.Transform(direction);
			double x = ((PdfPoint)(ref val2)).X;
			double y = ((PdfPoint)(ref val2)).Y;
			return Math.Sqrt(x * x + y * y);
		}

		private double CalcLineExtendFactor(PdfPoint startPoint, PdfPoint endPoint)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			double num = CalcFinalAngle(startPoint, endPoint);
			double num2 = Math.Sin(num);
			double num3 = Math.Cos(num);
			return CalcLength(new PdfPoint(num2, num3)) / CalcLength(new PdfPoint(num3, num2));
		}

		private double GetLineWidth(PdfPoint startPoint, PdfPoint endPoint)
		{
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			double lineWidth = ((PdfCommandInterpreter)this).GraphicsState.LineWidth;
			if (lineWidth >= 0.1)
			{
				return lineWidth;
			}
			double num = CalcFinalAngle(startPoint, endPoint);
			return 1.0 / (CalcLength(new PdfPoint(Math.Cos(num), Math.Sin(num))) * (double)scale);
		}

		private float GetPenWidth(PdfPoint startPoint, PdfPoint endPoint)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			if (!(lineWidth < 0.1))
			{
				return (float)(lineWidth * CalcLength(new PdfPoint(Math.Cos(num), Math.Sin(num))) * (double)scale);
			}
			return 1f;
		}

		private void UpdatePenProperties(Pen pen, PdfPoint startPoint, PdfPoint endPoint)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			pen.DashStyle = DashStyle.Custom;
			pen.DashOffset = (float)lineStyle.DashPhase;

			if (num == 2 && array[0] == 0.0)
			{
				array[1] -= 1.0;
			}
			List<float> list = new List<float>();
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{

		}

		private bool StrokeRectangle(Pen pen, PdfGraphicsPath path)
		{
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00cf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00de: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0108: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0119: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0125: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_014c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0182: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PdfRectangularGraphicsPath val = (PdfRectangularGraphicsPath)(object)((path is PdfRectangularGraphicsPath) ? path : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			PdfRectangle rectangle = val.Rectangle;

			double right = rectangle.Right;
			double bottom = rectangle.Bottom;
			PdfPoint startPoint = default(PdfPoint);

			double num = CalcLineExtendFactor(startPoint, endPoint);
			if (num > 0.5 && num < 2.0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LineCap startCap = pen.StartCap;
			try
			{
				pen.StartCap = LineCap.Flat;
				pen.EndCap = LineCap.Flat;

				graphics.DrawLine(pen, TransformPoint(new PdfPoint(num4, top)), TransformPoint(new PdfPoint(num5, top)));
				UpdatePenProperties(pen, startPoint, endPoint2);
				float num6 = GetPenWidth(startPoint, endPoint) / num2;

				double num8 = top + (double)num6;
				graphics.DrawLine(pen, TransformPoint(new PdfPoint(left, num7)), TransformPoint(new PdfPoint(left, num8)));
				graphics.DrawLine(pen, TransformPoint(new PdfPoint(right, num7)), TransformPoint(new PdfPoint(right, num8)));
			}
			finally
			{
				pen.StartCap = startCap;
				pen.EndCap = startCap;

		}

		private Bitmap CreateTransparencyGroupBitmap(PdfGroupForm form, Size bitmapSize, PdfTransformationMatrix transformationMatrix, PdfRectangle clipRectangle)
		{

			{

					{

					}

		private static int CalculateDistance(PointF point1, PointF point2)
		{
			return (int)Math.Ceiling(Math.Sqrt(CalculateDistanceSquare(point1, point2)));
		}

				}

		}

							RectangleF bounds = graphicsPath.GetBounds();
							if (bounds.Width >= 0.08f || bounds.Height >= 0.08f)
							{
								graphics.DrawPath(pen, graphicsPath);
							}
							else if (val4.HasValue && !((PdfImmediateRenderCommandInterpreter)this).IsPrinting)
							{
								PdfLineSegment value = val4.Value;
								PdfLineSegment val6 = ((PdfLineSegment)(ref value)).Transform(DeviceTransformationMatrix);
								double length = ((PdfLineSegment)(ref val6)).Length;
								if (length == 0.0)
								{
									val5 = ((PdfLineSegment)(ref val6)).Point2;
									double num2 = ((PdfPoint)(ref val5)).X + 0.5;
									val5 = ((PdfLineSegment)(ref val6)).Point2;
									((PdfPoint)(ref val7))..ctor(num2, ((PdfPoint)(ref val5)).Y);
									((PdfLineSegment)(ref val6))..ctor(((PdfLineSegment)(ref val6)).Point1, val7);
								}
								else if (length < 0.5)
								{
									PdfPoint val8 = PdfPoint.Lerp(((PdfLineSegment)(ref val6)).Point1, ((PdfLineSegment)(ref val6)).Point2, 0.5 / length);
									((PdfLineSegment)(ref val6))..ctor(((PdfLineSegment)(ref val6)).Point1, val8);
								}
								val5 = ((PdfLineSegment)(ref val6)).Point1;
								float x = (float)((PdfPoint)(ref val5)).X;
								val5 = ((PdfLineSegment)(ref val6)).Point1;
								PointF pt = new PointF(x, (float)((PdfPoint)(ref val5)).Y);
								val5 = ((PdfLineSegment)(ref val6)).Point2;
								float x2 = (float)((PdfPoint)(ref val5)).X;
								val5 = ((PdfLineSegment)(ref val6)).Point2;
								PointF pt2 = new PointF(x2, (float)((PdfPoint)(ref val5)).Y);
								graphics.DrawLine(pen, pt, pt2);
							}
						}
						finally
						{
							graphics.SmoothingMode = smoothingMode2;
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					graphics.SmoothingMode = smoothingMode;
				}
			});
		}

		protected override void FillPaths(bool useNonzeroWindingRule)
		{
			PdfFillPathInfo pathFillInfo = new PdfGraphicsPathBuilder(this).CreateFillPath(((PdfLegacyCommandInterpreter)this).TransformedPaths);
			try
			{
				GraphicsPath graphicsPath = pathFillInfo.GraphicsPath;
				graphicsPath.FillMode = (useNonzeroWindingRule ? FillMode.Winding : FillMode.Alternate);
				PerformRendering(graphicsPath.GetBounds(), delegate
				{
					SmoothingMode smoothingMode = graphics.SmoothingMode;
					try
					{
						UpdateSmoothingMode(forFilling: true);
						graphics.FillPath(currentState.NonStrokingBrush, graphicsPath);
						if (pathFillInfo.StrokePath != null)
						{
							using (Pen pen = new Pen(currentState.NonStrokingBrush, 1f))
							{
								graphics.DrawPath(pen, pathFillInfo.StrokePath);
								return;
							}
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						graphics.SmoothingMode = smoothingMode;
					}
				});
			}
			finally
			{
				if (pathFillInfo != null)
				{
					((IDisposable)pathFillInfo).Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ClipPaths()
		{
			IList<PdfGraphicsPath> boundsClippedTransformedPaths = ((PdfLegacyCommandInterpreter)this).BoundsClippedTransformedPaths;
			PdfGraphicsPathBuilder pdfGraphicsPathBuilder = new PdfGraphicsPathBuilder(this);
			RectangleF rect = ((boundsClippedTransformedPaths.Count == 1) ? pdfGraphicsPathBuilder.CreateRectangle(boundsClippedTransformedPaths[0]) : RectangleF.Empty);
			Region region;
			if (rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				using PdfFillPathInfo pdfFillPathInfo = pdfGraphicsPathBuilder.CreateFillPath(boundsClippedTransformedPaths);
				if (pdfFillPathInfo.GraphicsPath.PointCount == 0)
				{
					region = new Region();
					region.MakeEmpty();
				}
				else
				{
					GraphicsPath graphicsPath = pdfFillPathInfo.GraphicsPath;
					graphicsPath.FillMode = (((PdfCommandInterpreter)this).ClipUseNonZeroWindingRule.Value ? FillMode.Winding : FillMode.Alternate);
					region = new Region(graphicsPath);
					GraphicsPath strokePath = pdfFillPathInfo.StrokePath;
					if (strokePath != null)
					{
						try
						{
							strokePath.Widen(Pens.Black);
							region.Union(strokePath);
						}
						catch
						{
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				region = new Region(rect);
			}
			currentState.Clip.Intersect(region);
			graphics.Clip = currentState.Clip;
			region?.Dispose();
		}

		public override void DrawTransparencyGroup(PdfGroupForm form)
		{
			if (!viewState.ShouldRender(((PdfXObject)form).OptionalContent, ((PdfImmediateRenderCommandInterpreter)this).IsPrinting))
			{
				return;
			}
			((PdfCommandInterpreter)this).SaveGraphicsState();
			try
			{
				((PdfCommandInterpreter)this).UpdateTransformationMatrix(((PdfForm)form).Matrix);
				PdfRectangle val = TrimBoundingBox(((PdfForm)form).BBox);
				if (val == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				using Bitmap bitmap = CreateTransparencyGroupBitmap(form, val, null);
				PdfGraphicsState val2 = ((PdfCommandInterpreter)this).GraphicsState;
				PdfSoftMask softMask = val2.SoftMask;
				PdfCustomSoftMask val3 = (PdfCustomSoftMask)(object)((softMask is PdfCustomSoftMask) ? softMask : null);
				if (val3 == null)
				{
					PdfBackdropImageBlender.Blend(this, val, bitmap);
				}
				else
				{
					PdfGroupForm transparencyGroup = val3.TransparencyGroup;
					PdfRectangle val4 = TrimBoundingBox(((PdfForm)transparencyGroup).BBox);
					if (val4 != null)
					{
						PdfRectangle val5 = val4.Trim(val);
						if (val5 == null)
						{
							return;
						}
						using Bitmap softMaskBitmap = CreateTransparencyGroupBitmap(transparencyGroup, val, val5);
						ApplySoftMask(val3, bitmap, softMaskBitmap);
					}
				}
				DrawBitmap(bitmap, val);
			}
			finally
			{
				((PdfCommandInterpreter)this).RestoreGraphicsState();
			}
		}

		public override void DrawForm(PdfForm form)
		{
			if (viewState.ShouldRender(((PdfXObject)form).OptionalContent, ((PdfImmediateRenderCommandInterpreter)this).IsPrinting))
			{
				((PdfLegacyCommandInterpreter)this).DrawForm(form);
			}
		}

		public override void DrawMarkedContent(IEnumerable<PdfCommand> commands, PdfProperties properties, string tag)
		{
			if (viewState.ShouldRender((PdfOptionalContent)(object)((properties is PdfOptionalContent) ? properties : null), ((PdfImmediateRenderCommandInterpreter)this).IsPrinting))
			{
				((PdfImmediateRenderCommandInterpreter)this).DrawMarkedContent(commands, properties, tag);
			}
		}
	}
	public class PdfPrintDialogPreview : PdfDisposableObject
	{
		private readonly PdfProcessingBackend backend;

		private PdfPrintPreviewCalculator calculator;

		private DXImage previewImage;

		private int pageIndex;

		private Color previewPrintAreaBorderColor = Color.FromArgb(255, 96, 152, 192);

		public DXImage PreviewImage
		{
			get
			{
				if (previewImage == null && calculator != null)
				{
					previewImage = new DXBitmap(calculator.PreviewSize.Width, calculator.PreviewSize.Height);
					if (pageIndex >= 0)
					{
						using IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = previewImage.CreateGraphics();
						iDXGraphics.FillRectangle(new DXSolidBrush(Color.White), calculator.PaperRectangle);
						try
						{
							using DXBitmap image = backend.CreatePrintPreviewBitmap(pageIndex + 1, calculator.LargestEdgeLength, calculator.PrinterSettings.PrintStickyNotes);
							iDXGraphics.DrawImage(image, calculator.PagePosition.X, calculator.PagePosition.Y);
						}
						catch
						{
						}
						MarkUnprintableArea(iDXGraphics);
					}
				}
				return previewImage;
			}
		}

		public int PageIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return pageIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				if (pageIndex != value && value >= -1)
				{
					pageIndex = value;
					if (pageIndex >= 0)
					{
						calculator.Page = backend.Document.Pages[pageIndex];
					}
					DisposePreviewImage();
				}
			}
		}

		public PdfPrinterSettings PrinterSettings
		{
			get
			{
				return calculator.PrinterSettings;
			}
			set
			{
				calculator.PrinterSettings = value;
				DisposePreviewImage();
			}
		}

		public Size PreviewSize
		{
			get
			{
				return calculator.PreviewSize;
			}
			set
			{
				if (calculator.PreviewSize != value)
				{
					calculator.PreviewSize = value;
					DisposePreviewImage();
				}
			}
		}

		public Color PreviewPrintAreaBorderColor
		{
			get
			{
				return previewPrintAreaBorderColor;
			}
			set
			{
				previewPrintAreaBorderColor = value;
			}
		}

		internal float Scale => calculator.Scale;

		internal bool HasException => calculator.HasException;

		public PdfPrintDialogPreview(PdfProcessingBackend backend, PdfPrinterSettings settings, int pageIndex, Size previewSize)
		{
			this.backend = backend;
			this.pageIndex = pageIndex;
			PdfDocumentState documentState = backend.DocumentState;
			calculator = new PdfPrintPreviewCalculator(settings, ((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentState).Document.Pages[pageIndex], previewSize, ((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentState).RotationAngle);
		}

		public void DisposePreviewImage()
		{
			if (previewImage != null)
			{
				previewImage.Dispose();
				previewImage = null;
				calculator.Update();
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				DisposePreviewImage();
			}
		}

		private void MarkUnprintableArea(IDXGraphics g)
		{
			PointF[] unprintableArea = calculator.UnprintableArea;
			if (unprintableArea != null && unprintableArea.Length != 0)
			{
				using DXSolidBrush brush = new DXSolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(60, Color.Black));
				g.FillPolygon(brush, unprintableArea);
			}
			if (calculator.IsDrawPageRectangle)
			{
				using (DXPen pen = new DXPen(previewPrintAreaBorderColor))
				{
					g.DrawRectangle(pen, calculator.PrintablePageArea);
				}
				using DXPen pen2 = new DXPen(Color.FromArgb(128, Color.White));
				g.DrawRectangle(pen2, new Rectangle(calculator.PrintablePageArea.X - 1, calculator.PrintablePageArea.Y - 1, calculator.PrintablePageArea.Width + 2, calculator.PrintablePageArea.Height + 2));
				g.DrawRectangle(pen2, new Rectangle(calculator.PrintablePageArea.X + 1, calculator.PrintablePageArea.Y + 1, calculator.PrintablePageArea.Width - 2, calculator.PrintablePageArea.Height - 2));
			}
		}
	}

					return 600;
				}

			set
			{

				if (num != 0)

					value = Math.Min(value, num);

				{
					try
					{
						pdfPrinterSettings.PrintingDpi = value;

					printerSettings.PrintToFile = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged("PrintToFile");
					string text = default(string);
					if (value && PrintHelper.ValidateFilePath(PrintFileName, ref text))

						UpdatePrinterSettingsPrintFileName();

		public string PrintFileName
		{
			get
			{
				return printFileName ?? string.Empty;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					value = string.Empty;
				}
				if (!(value != printFileName))
				{
					return;
				}
				string text = default(string);
				if (PrintToFile && PrintHelper.ValidateFilePath(value, ref text))
				{
					if ((string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) || showFileReplacingRequest(text)) && UpdatePrintFileName(value))
					{
						UpdatePrinterSettingsPrintFileName();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					UpdatePrintFileName(value);
				}
			}
		}

		private int CurrentPageNumber
		{
