			}
		}

		private string InvalidPageRangeMessage
		{
			get
			{
				if (!EnablePageNumberPreview)
				{
					return string.Format(PdfCoreLocalizer.GetString((PdfCoreStringId)40), documentPageCount);
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		private bool IsValidPrintToFile
		{
			get
			{
				string text = default(string);
				if (PrintToFile)
				{
					return PrintHelper.ValidateFilePath(PrintFileName, ref text);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private string InvalidFilePathMessage
		{
			get
			{
				string text = default(string);
				if (!PrintToFile || PrintHelper.ValidateFilePath(PrintFileName, ref text))
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return PdfCoreLocalizer.GetString((PdfCoreStringId)57);
			}
		}

		string IDataErrorInfo.Error
		{
			get
			{
				string invalidPageRangeMessage = InvalidPageRangeMessage;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(invalidPageRangeMessage))
				{
					return invalidPageRangeMessage;
				}
				return InvalidFilePathMessage;
			}
		}

		string IDataErrorInfo.this[string columnName]
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(columnName == "PageRangeText"))
				{
					if (columnName == "PrintFileName")
					{
						return InvalidFilePathMessage;
					}
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return InvalidPageRangeMessage;
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public PdfPrintDialogViewModel(PdfProcessingBackend backend, IPrintingBridge provider, Size previewSize, int currentPageNumber, int maxPrintingDpi, Func<string, bool> showFileReplacingRequest, PdfPrinterSettings pdfPrinterSettings)
		{
			this.provider = provider;
			this.currentPageNumber = currentPageNumber;
			this.maxPrintingDpi = maxPrintingDpi;
			this.showFileReplacingRequest = showFileReplacingRequest;
			this.pdfPrinterSettings = pdfPrinterSettings;
			printerSettings = pdfPrinterSettings.CachedSettings;
			documentPageCount = backend.Document.Pages.Count;
			try
			{
				IPrinterItemContainer container = provider.Container;
				printerItems = container.Items;
				if (!printerSettings.IsValid)
				{
					string defaultPrinterName = container.DefaultPrinterName;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(defaultPrinterName))
					{
						printerSettings.PrinterName = defaultPrinterName;
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				printerItems = (IReadOnlyList<IPrinterItem>)(object)new IPrinterItem[0];
			}
			string printerName = printerSettings.PrinterName;
			printerSettings.PrinterName = printerName;
			if (!copies.HasValue)
			{
				UpdateCopies(printerSettings.Copies);
			}
			if (!collate.HasValue)
			{
				UpdateCollate(printerSettings.Collate);
			}
			if (printFileName == null)
			{
				UpdatePrintFileName(printerSettings.PrintFileName);
			}
			UpdateMaxDpi();
			UpdatePaperSources();
			int count = printerItems.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (printerItems[i].FullName == printerName)
				{
					printerIndex = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			int[] pageNumbers = PageNumbers;
			if (pageNumbers != null)
			{
				int num = pageNumbers.Length;
				if (num > 0)
				{
					StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
					int num2 = pageNumbers[0];
					stringBuilder.Append(num2);
					for (int j = 1; j < num; j++)
					{
						int num3 = pageNumbers[j];
						int num4 = num3 - num2;
						if (Math.Abs(num4) == 1)
						{
							num2 = num3;
							for (j++; j < num; j++)
							{
								num3 = pageNumbers[j];
								if (num3 - num2 != num4)
								{
									break;
								}
								num2 = num3;
							}
							stringBuilder.Append("-");
							stringBuilder.Append(num2);
							if (j == num)
							{
								break;
							}
						}
						stringBuilder.Append(',');
						stringBuilder.Append(num3);
						num2 = num3;
					}
					pageRangeText = stringBuilder.ToString();
				}
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(pageRangeText))
			{
				pageRangeText = "1-" + documentPageCount;
			}
			if (PrintRange != PrintRange.SomePages)
			{
				UpdatePageNumbers();
			}
			pagePreviewIndex = ((PageCount <= 0) ? (-1) : 0);
			currentPreviewPageNumber = CurrentPageNumber;
			dialogPreview = new PdfPrintDialogPreview(backend, pdfPrinterSettings, 0, previewSize);
			dialogPreview.PageIndex = currentPreviewPageNumber - 1;
		}

		public void UpdatePreviewSize(int width, int height)
		{
			Size size = new Size(width, height);
			if (dialogPreview.PreviewSize != size)
			{
				dialogPreview.PreviewSize = size;
				RefreshPreviewImage();
			}
		}

		public void ShowPreferences(IntPtr handle)
		{
			ShowPrinterPropertiesDialog(handle);
			RefreshAfterHidePrinterPropertiesDialog();
		}

		public void ShowPrinterPropertiesDialog(IntPtr handle)
		{
			try
			{
				provider.ShowPrinterProperties(printerSettings.NativeSettings, handle);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		public void RefreshAfterHidePrinterPropertiesDialog()
		{
			try
			{
				printerSettings.DefaultPageSettings.Refresh(refreshInfo: true);
				if (PageOrientation != PdfPrintPageOrientation.Auto)
				{
					PageOrientation = ((!printerSettings.DefaultPageSettings.Landscape) ? PdfPrintPageOrientation.Portrait : PdfPrintPageOrientation.Landscape);
				}
				if (printerSettings.Copies != copies)
				{
					copies = printerSettings.Copies;
					RaiseCopiesPropertyChanged();
				}
				if (printerSettings.Collate != collate)
				{
					collate = printerSettings.Collate;
					RaisePropertyChanged("Collate");
				}
				int num = paperSources.IndexOf(printerSettings.DefaultPageSettings.PaperSource.SourceName);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					PaperSourceIndex = num;
				}
				RefreshPreviewImage();
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && dialogPreview != null)
			{
				((PdfDisposableObject)dialogPreview).Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		private void RaiseCopiesPropertyChanged()
		{
			RaisePropertyChanged("Copies");
			RaisePropertyChanged("AllowCollate");
		}

		private bool SetProperty<T>(ref T storage, T value, string propertyName, Action changedCallback)
		{
			if (object.Equals(storage, value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			storage = value;
			changedCallback();
			RaisePropertyChanged(propertyName);
			return true;
		}

		private void RefreshPreviewImage()
		{
			dialogPreview.PageIndex = currentPreviewPageNumber - 1;
			dialogPreview.DisposePreviewImage();
			previewImageBytes = null;
			RaisePropertyChanged("PreviewImage");
			RaisePropertyChanged("ShowFitScaleText");
			RaisePropertyChanged("FitScale");
			RaisePropertyChanged("PreviewImageBytes");
		}

		private void SetCurrentPreviewPage()
		{
			if (PageCount > 0)
			{
				if (pagePreviewIndex == -1)
				{
					pagePreviewIndex = 0;
					RaisePropertyChanged("PagePreviewIndex");
				}
			}
			else if (pagePreviewIndex != -1)
			{
				pagePreviewIndex = -1;
				RaisePropertyChanged("PagePreviewIndex");
			}
			int num = CurrentPageNumber;
			if (num != currentPreviewPageNumber)
			{
				currentPreviewPageNumber = num;
				RaisePropertyChanged("CurrentPreviewPageNumber");
				RefreshPreviewImage();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateMaxDpi()
		{
			int num = pdfPrinterSettings.MaxDpi;
			num = ((maxPrintingDpi > 0 && maxPrintingDpi < num) ? maxPrintingDpi : num);
			if (!maxDpi.HasValue)
			{
				maxDpi = num;
				RaisePropertyChanged("MaxDpi");
				if (num < PrintingDpi)
				{
					PrintingDpi = num;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePaperSources()
		{
			List<PaperSource> list = new List<PaperSource>();
			List<string> list2 = new List<string>();
			foreach (PaperSource paperSource in printerSettings.PaperSources)
			{
				string sourceName = paperSource.SourceName;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sourceName))
				{
					list.Add(paperSource);
					list2.Add(sourceName);
				}
			}
			nativePaperSources = list;
			paperSources = list2;
			string defaultPaperSourceName = DefaultPaperSourceName;
			paperSourceIndex = -1;
			int count = list2.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (list2[i] == DefaultPaperSourceName)
				{
					paperSourceIndex = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			RaisePropertyChanged("PaperSources");
			RaisePropertyChanged("PaperSourceIndex");
		}

		private bool UpdateCopies(short copies)
		{
			copies = Math.Max(copies, (short)1);
			short num = Copies;
			this.copies = copies;
			if (copies == num)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RaiseCopiesPropertyChanged();
			return true;
		}

		private bool UpdateCollate(bool collate)
		{
			bool flag = Collate;
			this.collate = collate;
			if (collate == flag)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RaisePropertyChanged("Collate");
			return true;
		}

		private bool UpdatePrintFileName(string printFileName)
		{
			string text = PrintFileName;
			this.printFileName = printFileName;
			if (printFileName == text)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RaisePropertyChanged("PrintFileName");
			return true;
		}

		private void UpdatePageNumbers()
		{
			if (PageNumbers != null && string.IsNullOrEmpty(pageRangeText) && PrintRange == PrintRange.SomePages)
			{
				pdfPrinterSettings.PageNumbers = new int[0];
			}
			else
			{
				pdfPrinterSettings.SetPageNumbers(currentPageNumber, documentPageCount, pageRangeText);
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePreview()
		{
			UpdatePageNumbers();
			RaisePropertyChanged("PageNumbers");
			int pageCount = PageCount;
			if (pagePreviewIndex >= pageCount)
			{
				PagePreviewIndex = pageCount - 1;
			}
			SetCurrentPreviewPage();
		}

		private void SetPrintRange(PrintRange printRange)
		{
			PrintRange printRange2 = PrintRange;
			if (printRange != printRange2)
			{
				printerSettings.PrintRange = printRange;
				UpdatePreview();
				RaisePropertyChanged("PrintRange");
				if (printRange == PrintRange.SomePages || printRange2 == PrintRange.SomePages)
				{
					RaisePropertyChanged("AllowSomePages");
					RaisePropertyChanged("PageRangeText");
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePrinterSettingsPrintFileName()
		{
			string value = PrintFileName;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				printerSettings.PrintFileName = value;
			}
		}

		private void OnPrinterIndexChanged()
		{
			PrinterSettings printerSettings = new PrinterSettings();
			printerSettings.PrinterName = printerItems[printerIndex].FullName;
			printerSettings.Copies = Copies;
			printerSettings.Collate = Collate;
			printerSettings.FromPage = this.printerSettings.FromPage;
			printerSettings.ToPage = this.printerSettings.ToPage;
			printerSettings.PrintRange = this.printerSettings.PrintRange;
			printerSettings.PrintToFile = this.printerSettings.PrintToFile;
			pdfPrinterSettings = new PdfPrinterSettings(printerSettings, pdfPrinterSettings);
			this.printerSettings = pdfPrinterSettings.CachedSettings;
			UpdatePrinterSettingsPrintFileName();
			pdfPrinterSettings.MaxDpi = maxPrintingDpi;
			PrintingDpi = pdfPrinterSettings.PrintingDpi;
			maxDpi = null;
			UpdateMaxDpi();
			UpdatePaperSources();
			dialogPreview.PrinterSettings = pdfPrinterSettings;
			RaisePropertyChanged("PrinterStatus");
			RaisePropertyChanged("PrinterLocation");
			RaisePropertyChanged("PrinterComment");
			RaisePropertyChanged("PrinterDocumentsInQueue");
			RefreshPreviewImage();
		}
	}

	public class PdfDirectXMetafileBuilder : IDisposable
	{
		private IntPtr printerHdc;

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static IntPtr CreateDC(string printerName, IntPtr devmode)
		{
			return Gdi32Interop.CreateDC(null, printerName, null, devmode);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static void DeleteDC(IntPtr printerHdc)
		{
			Gdi32Interop.DeleteDC(printerHdc);
		}

		public PdfDirectXMetafileBuilder(string printerName, HDevModeHandle hdevMode)
		{
			printerHdc = hdevMode.PerformDevModeFunction((IntPtr ptr) => CreateDC(printerName, ptr));
		}

		~PdfDirectXMetafileBuilder()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (printerHdc != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				DeleteDC(printerHdc);
				printerHdc = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		public byte[] CreateMetafile(Action<Graphics> paintCallback, RectangleF InchOverlayRect)
		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			using (Metafile image = new Metafile(memoryStream, printerHdc, InchOverlayRect, MetafileFrameUnit.Inch))
			{
				using Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(image);
				graphics.PageUnit = GraphicsUnit.Pixel;
				paintCallback?.Invoke(graphics);
			}
			return memoryStream.ToArray();
		}
	}
	public class PdfDirectXNativePrinter : INativeDocumentPrinter, IDisposable
	{
		private class StubPrintController : PrintController
		{
			public override bool IsPreview => false;

			public override void OnEndPage(PrintDocument document, PrintPageEventArgs e)
			{
			}

			public override Graphics OnStartPage(PrintDocument document, PrintPageEventArgs e)
			{
				return null;
			}

			public override void OnStartPrint(PrintDocument document, PrintEventArgs e)
			{
			}

			public override void OnEndPrint(PrintDocument document, PrintEventArgs e)
			{
			}
		}

		private readonly DocumentPrinter printer;

		private readonly PrintController printController;

		private readonly PdfDirectXRenderingContext context;

		private readonly string documentName;

		private readonly PrintDocument stubPrintDocument;

		public PdfDirectXNativePrinter(PdfDirectXRenderingContext context, DocumentPrinter printer, string documentName, bool showPrintStatusDialog)
		{
			this.context = context;
			this.printer = printer;
			this.documentName = documentName;
			if (showPrintStatusDialog)
			{
				printController = PrintStatusDialogHelper.CreatePrintControllerWithStatusDialog(new StubPrintController());
				if (printController != null)
				{
					stubPrintDocument = new PrintDocument
					{
						DocumentName = documentName
					};
				}
			}
		}

		public void Print()
		{
			//IL_00f2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (printController != null)
			{
				PrintEventArgs e = new PrintEventArgs();
				printController.OnStartPrint(stubPrintDocument, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			PdfPrintDocumentCalculator calculator = printer.Calculator;
			PdfCachedPrinterSettings cachedSettings = printer.PrinterSettings.CachedSettings;
			string printerName = cachedSettings.PrinterName;
			PageSettings pageSettings = (PageSettings)cachedSettings.DefaultPageSettings.NativeSettings.Clone();
			string text = (cachedSettings.PrintToFile ? cachedSettings.PrintFileName : null);
			NativeStream val = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text)) ? NativeStream.CreateFileStream(text) : null);
			try
			{
				using HDevModeHandle hDevModeHandle = new HDevModeHandle(cachedSettings.NativeSettings.GetHdevmode(pageSettings));
				PrintDocumentPackageTargetFactory val2 = PrintDocumentPackageTargetFactory.Create();
				try
				{
					using PTProvider pTProvider = PTProvider.Create(printerName);
					NativeStream val3 = pTProvider.ConvertDevModeToPrintTicket(hDevModeHandle, EPrintTicketScope.kPTJobScope);
					try
					{
						PrintDocumentPackageTarget val4 = val2.CreateDocumentPackageTargetForPrintJob(printerName, documentName, val, val3);
						try
						{
							D2D1_PRINT_CONTROL_PROPERTIES properties = default(D2D1_PRINT_CONTROL_PROPERTIES);
							((D2D1_PRINT_CONTROL_PROPERTIES)(ref properties))..ctor((D2D1_PRINT_FONT_SUBSET_MODE)0, (float)printer.PrinterSettings.PrintingDpi, (D2D1_COLOR_SPACE)1);
							D2D1PrintControl val5 = context.CreatePrintControl(val4, properties);
							try
							{
								bool flag = false;
								using (PdfDirectXMetafileBuilder metafileBuilder = new PdfDirectXMetafileBuilder(cachedSettings.PrinterName, hDevModeHandle))
								{
									while (true)
									{
										if (!printer.QueryPageSettings(pageSettings) || StartPage())
										{
											flag = true;
											break;
										}
										PageSettings nativeSettings = calculator.PageSettings.NativeSettings;
										calculator.CalculatePrintingDpi(96f);
										using HDevModeHandle devmode = new HDevModeHandle(cachedSettings.NativeSettings.GetHdevmode(nativeSettings));
										NativeStream val6 = pTProvider.ConvertDevModeToPrintTicket(devmode, EPrintTicketScope.kPTJobScope);
										try
										{
											PrintPageResult printPageResult = printer.PrintPage(new PdfDirectXPagePrinter(printer, val6, val5, context, metafileBuilder));
											if (printPageResult.Canceled || EndPage())
											{
												flag = true;
												break;
											}
											if (!printPageResult.HasMorePages)
											{
												break;
											}
										}
										finally
										{
											((IDisposable)val6)?.Dispose();
										}
									}
								}
								if (EndPrint() || flag)
								{
									val4.Cancel();
								}
								else
								{
									val5.Close();
								}
							}
							finally
							{
								((IDisposable)val5)?.Dispose();
							}
						}
						catch (Exception ex)
						{
							if (ex is COMException { ErrorCode: -2003238900 })
							{
								context.Reinitialize();
							}
							EndPrint();
							try
							{
								val4.Cancel();
							}
							catch
							{
							}
							throw;
						}
						finally
						{
							((IDisposable)val4)?.Dispose();
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						((IDisposable)val3)?.Dispose();
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val2)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public void StopPrinting()
		{
			EndPrint();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (stubPrintDocument != null)
			{
				stubPrintDocument.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private bool EndPrint()
		{
			if (printController != null)
			{
				PrintEventArgs e = new PrintEventArgs();
				printController.OnEndPrint(stubPrintDocument, e);
				return e.Cancel;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool EndPage()
		{
			if (printController != null)
			{
				PrintPageEventArgs e = new PrintPageEventArgs(null, Rectangle.Empty, Rectangle.Empty, null);
				printController.OnEndPage(stubPrintDocument, e);
				return e.Cancel;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool StartPage()
		{
			if (printController != null)
			{
				PrintPageEventArgs e = new PrintPageEventArgs(null, Rectangle.Empty, Rectangle.Empty, null);
				printController.OnStartPage(stubPrintDocument, e);
				return e.Cancel;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class PdfDirectXPrintDocumentPageFactory : PdfPrintDocumentPageFactory
	{
		private readonly PdfDirectXDocumentRenderer renderer;

		public PdfDirectXPrintDocumentPageFactory(PdfDirectXDocumentRenderer renderer)
		{
			this.renderer = renderer;
		}

		public override PdfPrintDocumentPage Create(DocumentPrinter printer)
		{
			PdfPrintDocumentCalculator calculator = printer.Calculator;
			PdfPageState pageState = ((PdfDocumentStateBase)printer.DocumentState)[printer.CurrentPrintingPageIndex];
			if (printer.PrintInGrayscale)
			{
				return new PdfGrayscaleTilePrintDocumentPage(renderer, pageState, calculator, PdfPrintDocumentPageFactory.GetDivisionCount(calculator.Rectangle));
			}
			return new PdfColorTilePrintDocumentPage(renderer, pageState, calculator, PdfPrintDocumentPageFactory.GetDivisionCount(calculator.Rectangle));
		}
	}
	public class PdfGDIPrintDocumentPageFactory : PdfPrintDocumentPageFactory
	{
		private readonly PdfGDIDocumentRenderer renderer;

		public PdfGDIPrintDocumentPageFactory(PdfGDIDocumentRenderer renderer)
		{
			this.renderer = renderer;
		}

		public override PdfPrintDocumentPage Create(DocumentPrinter printer)
		{
			PdfPrintDocumentCalculator calculator = printer.Calculator;
			PdfPageState pageState = ((PdfDocumentStateBase)printer.DocumentState)[printer.CurrentPrintingPageIndex];
			if (printer.PrintInGrayscale)
			{
				return new PdfGrayscaleTilePrintDocumentPage(renderer, pageState, calculator, PdfPrintDocumentPageFactory.GetDivisionCount(calculator.Rectangle));
			}
			if (printer.PrinterSettings.EnableLegacyPrinting)
			{
				if (calculator.IsDrawOnGraphics)
				{
					return new PdfBufferedPrintDocumentPage(renderer, pageState, calculator);
				}
				return new PdfColorTilePrintDocumentPage(renderer, pageState, calculator, PdfPrintDocumentPageFactory.GetDivisionCount(calculator.Rectangle));
			}
			return new PdfNativePrintDocumentPage(renderer, pageState, calculator);
		}
	}
	public static class PrintStatusDialogHelper
	{
		public static PrintController CreatePrintControllerWithStatusDialog(PrintController controller)
		{
			try
			{
				Type knownType = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownType(FrameworkAssemblies.WinForms, "System.Windows.Forms.PrintControllerWithStatusDialog", false, (bool?)null);
				return (PrintController)Activator.CreateInstance(knownType, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public, null, new object[1] { controller }, null);
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class PdfPrintDocumentPageFactory
	{
		private const double colorMByteSize = 3.814697265625E-06;

		private const double maxImageSize = 512.0;

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected static int GetDivisionCount(Rectangle rectangle)
		{
			double num = Math.Ceiling(3.814697265625E-06 * (double)rectangle.Width * (double)rectangle.Height * 3.0);
			int num2 = (int)Math.Ceiling(num / 512.0);
			if (num2 < 1)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				int num3 = Convert.ToInt32(num / (double)num2);
				if (num3 >= 16)
				{
					try
					{
						new MemoryFailPoint(num3).Dispose();
					}
					catch (InsufficientMemoryException)
					{
						num2 *= 2;
						continue;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		public abstract PdfPrintDocumentPage Create(DocumentPrinter printer);
	}
	internal class PdfPaperSizeValueWrapper : PdfReflectionValueWrapper<PaperSize>
	{
		private const string fieldName = "paperSize";

		private readonly PdfPrinterSettingsCache cache;

		public static PdfValueWrapper<PaperSize> Create(PageSettings settings, PdfPrinterSettingsCache cache)
		{
			Func<PaperSize> func = () => cache.PaperSize;
			Action<PaperSize> action = delegate(PaperSize value)
			{
				cache.PaperSize = value;
			};
			FieldInfo fieldInfo = PdfReflectionValueWrapper<PaperSize>.GetFieldInfo(settings, "paperSize");
			if (fieldInfo != null && !SecurityHelper.IsPartialTrust)
			{
				return new PdfPaperSizeValueWrapper(settings, fieldInfo, func, action, cache);
			}
			return new PdfValueWrapper<PaperSize>(func, action);
		}

		private PdfPaperSizeValueWrapper(PageSettings source, FieldInfo fieldInfo, Func<PaperSize> getValueAction, Action<PaperSize> setValueAction, PdfPrinterSettingsCache cache)
			: base((object)source, fieldInfo, (object)null, getValueAction, setValueAction)
		{
			this.cache = cache;
		}

		protected override PaperSize ValidateValue(PaperSize value)
		{
			return cache.GetValidPaperSize(value);
		}
	}
	public class DocumentPrinter
	{
		private readonly IList<int> pageIndices;

		private readonly PdfPrintDocumentCalculator calculator;

		private readonly PdfDocumentState documentState;

		private readonly IPdfPrintingCallbackProvider callbackProvider;

		private int currentPageIndex;

		private bool printInGrayscale;

		public int CurrentPrintingPageIndex => pageIndices[currentPageIndex];

		public PdfPrintDocumentCalculator Calculator => calculator;

		public bool PrintInGrayscale => printInGrayscale;

		public PdfDocumentState DocumentState => documentState;

		public PdfPrinterSettings PrinterSettings => calculator.PrinterSettings;

		public static DocumentPrinter Create(PdfDocumentState documentState, PdfPrinterSettings printerSettings, int currentPageNumber, IPdfPrintingCallbackProvider callbackProvider)
		{
			int pageCount = ((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentState).Document.Pages.Count;
			IEnumerable<int> pageNumbers = printerSettings.GetPageNumbers(currentPageNumber, ((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentState).Document.Pages.Count, null);
			if (pageNumbers == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			pageNumbers = from number in pageNumbers
				where number > 0 && number <= pageCount
				select number - 1;
			if (!pageNumbers.Any())
			{
				return null;
			}
			PdfCachedPrinterSettings cachedSettings = printerSettings.CachedSettings;
			short copies = cachedSettings.Copies;
			int maximumCopies = cachedSettings.MaximumCopies;
			List<int> list;
			if (copies > maximumCopies || (cachedSettings.Collate && copies > 1 && !cachedSettings.SupportCollate))
			{
				cachedSettings.Copies = 1;
				list = new List<int>();
				if (cachedSettings.Collate)
				{
					List<int> collection = pageNumbers.ToList();
					for (int num = 0; num < copies; num++)
					{
						list.AddRange(collection);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					foreach (int item in pageNumbers)
					{
						list.AddRange(Enumerable.Repeat(item, copies));
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				list = pageNumbers.ToList();
			}
			return new DocumentPrinter(list, documentState, printerSettings, callbackProvider);
		}

		private DocumentPrinter(IList<int> pageIndices, PdfDocumentState documentState, PdfPrinterSettings printerSettings, IPdfPrintingCallbackProvider callbackProvider)
		{
			this.pageIndices = pageIndices;
			this.documentState = documentState;
			this.callbackProvider = callbackProvider;
			printInGrayscale = printerSettings.PrintInGrayscale;
			calculator = new PdfPrintDocumentCalculator(printerSettings, ((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentState).Document.Pages[pageIndices[0]], ((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentState).RotationAngle);
		}

		public PrintPageResult PrintPage(IPagePrinter pagePrinter)
		{
			bool flag = currentPageIndex < pageIndices.Count - 1;
			PrintPageResult result = pagePrinter.PrintPage(flag);
			if (flag)
			{
				currentPageIndex++;
			}
			result.HasMorePages &= flag;
			return result;
		}

		public bool QueryPageSettings(PageSettings pageSettings)
		{
			calculator.SetPageSettings(pageSettings);
			int currentPrintingPageIndex = CurrentPrintingPageIndex;
			calculator.Page = ((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentState).Document.Pages[currentPrintingPageIndex];
			QueryPageSettingsEventArgs args = new QueryPageSettingsEventArgs(pageSettings);
			PdfQueryPageSettingsEventArgs e = new PdfQueryPageSettingsEventArgs(args, currentPrintingPageIndex + 1, Calculator.PageSize, PrinterSettings.PrintInGrayscale);
			callbackProvider.RaiseQueryPageSettingsEvent(e);
			printInGrayscale = e.PrintInGrayscale;
			calculator.PageSettings.RefreshIfChanged();
			calculator.RecalculateLandscape = false;
			calculator.Update();
			return !e.Cancel;
		}

		public void RaisePrintPage(PrintPageEventArgs args)
		{
			PdfPrintPageEventArgs e = new PdfPrintPageEventArgs(args, currentPageIndex + 1, pageIndices.Count);
			callbackProvider.RaisePrintPageEvent(e);
			args.HasMorePages = e.HasMorePages;
			args.Cancel = e.Cancel;
		}
	}
	public interface INativeDocumentPrinter : IDisposable
	{
		void Print();

		void StopPrinting();
	}
	public interface IPagePrinter
	{
		PrintPageResult PrintPage(bool hasMorePages);
	}
	public class PdfGDINativePagePrinter : IPagePrinter
	{
		private readonly PrintPageEventArgs args;

		private readonly DocumentPrinter printer;

		private readonly PdfPrintDocumentPageFactory pageFactory;

		public PdfGDINativePagePrinter(PrintPageEventArgs args, DocumentPrinter printer, PdfPrintDocumentPageFactory pageFactory)
		{
			this.printer = printer;
			this.args = args;
			this.pageFactory = pageFactory;
		}

		public PrintPageResult PrintPage(bool hasMorePages)
		{
			args.HasMorePages = hasMorePages;
			Graphics graphics = args.Graphics;
			PdfPrintDocumentCalculator calculator = printer.Calculator;
			PdfDocumentState documentState = printer.DocumentState;
			calculator.CalculatePrintingDpi(GraphicsDpi.GetGraphicsDpi(graphics));
			PdfPrintDocumentPage pdfPrintDocumentPage = pageFactory.Create(printer);
			try
			{
				pdfPrintDocumentPage.DrawPage(graphics);
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)pdfPrintDocumentPage)?.Dispose();
			}
			calculator.RecalculateLandscape = true;
			printer.RaisePrintPage(args);
			return new PrintPageResult(args.HasMorePages, args.Cancel);
		}
	}
	[ToolboxItem(false)]
	public class PdfGDINativePrinter : PrintDocument, INativeDocumentPrinter, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly DocumentPrinter printer;

		private readonly PdfPrintDocumentPageFactory pageFactory;

		public PdfGDINativePrinter(DocumentPrinter printer, PdfPrintDocumentPageFactory pageFactory, string documentName, bool showPrintStatusDialog)
		{
			this.printer = printer;
			this.pageFactory = pageFactory;
			base.DocumentName = documentName;
			base.PrinterSettings = printer.PrinterSettings.Settings;
			if (!showPrintStatusDialog)
			{
				base.PrintController = new StandardPrintController();
			}
		}

		public void StopPrinting()
		{
			PrintEventArgs e = new PrintEventArgs();
			e.Cancel = true;
			base.PrintController.OnEndPrint(this, e);
		}

		protected override void OnPrintPage(PrintPageEventArgs e)
		{
			PrintPageResult printPageResult = printer.PrintPage(new PdfGDINativePagePrinter(e, printer, pageFactory));
			e.HasMorePages = printPageResult.HasMorePages;
			e.Cancel = printPageResult.Canceled;
			base.OnPrintPage(e);
		}

		protected override void OnQueryPageSettings(QueryPageSettingsEventArgs e)
		{
			printer.QueryPageSettings(e.PageSettings);
			base.OnQueryPageSettings(e);
		}

		void INativeDocumentPrinter.Print()
		{
			Print();
		}
	}

	public class PdfCachedPageSettings
	{
		private const string printerResolutionFieldName = "printerResolution";

		private const string paperSourceFieldName = "paperSource";

		private const string landscapeFieldName = "landscape";

		private readonly PageSettings settings;

		private readonly IPdfValueWrapper<PrinterResolution> printerResolution;

		private readonly IPdfValueWrapper<bool> landscape;

		private readonly IPdfValueWrapper<PaperSource> paperSource;

		private readonly IPdfValueWrapper<PaperSize> paperSize;

		private readonly PdfPrinterSettingsCache cache;

		private PrinterSettings prevoiusPrinterSettings;

		public PageSettings NativeSettings => settings;

		public float HardMarginX => cache.HardMarginX;

		public float HardMarginY => cache.HardMarginY;

		public RectangleF PrintableArea => cache.PrintableArea;

		public PaperSize PaperSize => paperSize.Value;

		public PrinterResolution PrinterResolution
		{
			get
			{
				return printerResolution.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (printerResolution.Value != value)
				{
					printerResolution.Value = value;
					Refresh();
				}
			}
		}

		public PaperSource PaperSource
		{
			get
			{
				return paperSource.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (paperSource.Value != value)
				{
					paperSource.Value = value;
					Refresh();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool Landscape
		{
			get
			{
				return landscape.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (landscape.Value != value)
				{
					landscape.Value = value;
					Refresh();
				}
			}
		}

		public PdfCachedPageSettings(PageSettings settings)
			: this(settings, new PdfPrinterSettingsCache(settings))
		{
		}

		public PdfCachedPageSettings(PageSettings settings, PdfPrinterSettingsCache cache)
		{
			this.settings = settings;
			this.cache = cache;
			prevoiusPrinterSettings = settings.PrinterSettings;
			printerResolution = PdfReflectionValueWrapper<PrinterResolution>.Create(settings, "printerResolution", () => cache.PrinterResolution, delegate(PrinterResolution value)
			{
				cache.PrinterResolution = value;
			});
			paperSource = PdfReflectionValueWrapper<PaperSource>.Create(settings, "paperSource", () => cache.PaperSource, delegate(PaperSource value)
			{
				cache.PaperSource = value;
			});
			landscape = PdfReflectionValueWrapper<bool>.Create(settings, "landscape", () => cache.Landscape, delegate(bool value)
			{
				cache.Landscape = value;
			});
			paperSize = PdfPaperSizeValueWrapper.Create(settings, cache);
		}

		public void Refresh(bool refreshInfo)
		{
			if (refreshInfo)
			{
				cache.Refresh(PdfPrinterSettingsCacheRefreshFlags.PageSettings);
			}
			landscape.Refresh();
			paperSource.Refresh();
			printerResolution.Refresh();
			paperSize.Refresh();
		}

		public void RefreshIfChanged()
		{
			if (printerResolution.IsChanged || paperSource.IsChanged || landscape.IsChanged || paperSize.IsChanged || !prevoiusPrinterSettings.Equals(settings.PrinterSettings))
			{
				prevoiusPrinterSettings = settings.PrinterSettings;
				Refresh();
			}
		}

		private void Refresh()
		{
			Refresh(refreshInfo: true);
		}
	}

	public class PdfDirectXPagePrinter : IPagePrinter
	{
		private readonly DocumentPrinter printer;

		private readonly NativeStream pageTicketStream;

		private readonly D2D1PrintControl printControl;

		private readonly PdfDirectXRenderingContext context;

		private readonly PdfDirectXMetafileBuilder metafileBuilder;

		private readonly byte[] emptyNativeMetafile;

		private readonly bool isXPSPrinting;

		private RectangleF InchOverlayRect
		{
			get
			{
				PdfPrintDocumentCalculator calculator = printer.Calculator;
				RectangleF printableArea = calculator.PageSettings.PrintableArea;
				return new RectangleF(0f, 0f, printableArea.Width / 100f, printableArea.Height / 100f);
			}
		}

		private static bool CompareArrays(byte[] array1, byte[] array2)
		{
			if (array1.Length != array2.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return array1.SequenceEqual(array2);
		}

		public PdfDirectXPagePrinter(DocumentPrinter printer, NativeStream pageTicketStream, D2D1PrintControl printControl, PdfDirectXRenderingContext context, PdfDirectXMetafileBuilder metafileBuilder)
		{
			this.printer = printer;
			this.pageTicketStream = pageTicketStream;
			this.printControl = printControl;
			this.context = context;
			this.metafileBuilder = metafileBuilder;
			emptyNativeMetafile = metafileBuilder.CreateMetafile(null, InchOverlayRect);
			isXPSPrinting = printer.PrinterSettings.CachedSettings.IsXPSDriver;
		}

		public PrintPageResult PrintPage(bool hasMorePages)
		{
			//IL_0228: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PdfPrintDocumentCalculator calculator = printer.Calculator;
			float printScale = calculator.PrintScale;
			Rectangle rectangle = calculator.Rectangle;
			PointF offset = calculator.GetOffset(rectangle);
			float num = 0.72f / calculator.Scale;
			RectangleF printableArea = calculator.PageSettings.PrintableArea;
			PointF pointF = new PointF(printableArea.Left * num, printableArea.Top * num);
			PointF offset2 = new PointF(offset.X + (float)rectangle.Left / printScale + pointF.X, offset.Y + (float)rectangle.Top / printScale + pointF.Y);
			double imageScaleFactor = PdfMathUtils.Max((double)PdfPrinterSettings.GetResolutionDpi(calculator.PageSettings.PrinterResolution) / 96.0, 1.0);
			PrintPageResult result = new PrintPageResult(hasMorePages: true, canceled: false);
			calculator.RecalculateLandscape = true;
			byte[] array = metafileBuilder.CreateMetafile(delegate(Graphics graphics)
			{
				result = RaisePrintPage(hasMorePages, graphics);
			}, InchOverlayRect);
			D2D1GdiMetafile val = null;
			if (!CompareArrays(array, emptyNativeMetafile))
			{
				NativeStream val2 = NativeStream.Create(array);
				try
				{
					val = context.D2D1Factory.CreateGdiMetafile(val2);
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val2)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			D2D1GdiMetafile val3 = val;
			try
			{
				PointF overlayOffset = new PointF(printableArea.Left / 100f * 96f, printableArea.Top / 100f * 96f);
				PdfDirectXPrintingProperties printProperties = new PdfDirectXPrintingProperties
				{
					ConvertToGrayscale = printer.PrintInGrayscale,
					ImageScaleFactor = imageScaleFactor,
					IsXpsPrinting = isXPSPrinting,
					Overlay = val,
					OverlayOffset = overlayOffset,
					PrintTextAsOutlines = calculator.PrinterSettings.PrintTextAsOutlines
				};
				PdfPagePrintingInfo pdfPagePrintingInfo = new PdfPagePrintingInfo(printScale, PdfRenderMode.Print, ((PdfDocumentStateBase)printer.DocumentState)[printer.CurrentPrintingPageIndex], offset2);
				pdfPagePrintingInfo.RenderStickyNotes = calculator.PrinterSettings.PrintStickyNotes;
				D2D1CommandList val4 = context.CreatePrintingCommandList(pdfPagePrintingInfo, printProperties);
				try
				{
					SizeF printingPaperSize = calculator.PrintingPaperSize;
					printControl.AddPage(val4, new D2D_SIZE_F(printingPaperSize.Width, printingPaperSize.Height), pageTicketStream);
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val4)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val3)?.Dispose();
			}
			context.D3DContext.CleanUp();
			return result;
		}

		private PrintPageResult RaisePrintPage(bool hasMorePages, Graphics graphics)
		{
			PdfPrintDocumentCalculator calculator = printer.Calculator;
			Rectangle pageBounds = new Rectangle(Point.Empty, calculator.PaperSize);
			PageSettings nativeSettings = calculator.PageSettings.NativeSettings;
			Margins margins = nativeSettings.Margins;
			Rectangle marginBounds = new Rectangle(margins.Left, margins.Top, pageBounds.Width - (margins.Left + margins.Right), pageBounds.Height - (margins.Top + margins.Bottom));
			PrintPageEventArgs e = new PrintPageEventArgs(graphics, marginBounds, pageBounds, nativeSettings);
			e.HasMorePages = hasMorePages;
			printer.RaisePrintPage(e);
			return new PrintPageResult(e.HasMorePages, e.Cancel);
		}
	}
	public class PdfDocumentPrinter
	{
		private readonly PdfDocumentState documentState;

		private readonly PdfPrinterSettings printerSettings;

		private readonly int currentPageNumber;

		private readonly string documentFilePath;

		private readonly bool showPrintStatusDialog;

		private readonly PdfDocumentRenderer renderer;

		private IPdfPrintingCallbackProvider callbackProvider;

		public IPdfPrintingCallbackProvider CallbackProvider
		{
			get
			{
				return callbackProvider;
			}
			set
			{
				callbackProvider = value;
			}
		}

		public PdfDocumentPrinter(PdfDocumentRenderer renderer, PdfDocumentState documentState, PdfPrinterSettings printerSettings, int currentPageNumber, string documentFilePath, bool showPrintStatusDialog)
		{
			this.documentState = documentState;
			this.printerSettings = printerSettings;
			this.currentPageNumber = currentPageNumber;
			this.documentFilePath = documentFilePath;
			this.showPrintStatusDialog = showPrintStatusDialog;
			this.renderer = renderer;
		}

		public PdfDocumentPrinter(PdfDocumentRenderer renderer, PdfDocumentState documentState, PdfPrinterSettings printerSettings, IPdfViewerController viewerController)
			: this(renderer, documentState, printerSettings, viewerController.CurrentPageIndex + 1, viewerController.DocumentFilePath, viewerController.ShowPrintStatusDialog)
		{
		}

		public PdfDocumentPrinter(PdfDocumentRenderer renderer, PdfDocumentState state, PdfPrinterSettings settings)
			: this(renderer, state, settings, 1, string.Empty, showPrintStatusDialog: false)
		{
		}

		public void Print()
		{
			DocumentPrinter documentPrinter = DocumentPrinter.Create(documentState, printerSettings, currentPageNumber, callbackProvider);
			if (documentPrinter == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = ((PdfDocumentStateBase)documentState).Document.Title;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				text = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(documentFilePath) ? PdfCoreLocalizer.GetString((PdfCoreStringId)0) : Path.GetFileName(documentFilePath));
			}
			using INativeDocumentPrinter nativeDocumentPrinter = renderer.CreateNativePrinter(documentPrinter, text, showPrintStatusDialog);
			try
			{
				nativeDocumentPrinter.Print();
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				nativeDocumentPrinter.StopPrinting();
				if (!(ex is Win32Exception) && !(ex is COMException))
				{
					throw;
				}
			}
		}
	}

		public bool IsXPSDriver => GetProperty(() => isXPSDriver, suppressException: true);

		public int MaximumCopies => GetProperty(() => maximumCopies, suppressException: false);

		public float HardMarginX => GetProperty(() => hardMarginX, suppressException: false);

		public float HardMarginY => GetProperty(() => hardMarginY, suppressException: false);

		public PrinterSettings.PrinterResolutionCollection PrinterResolutions => GetProperty(() => printerResolutions, suppressException: true);

		public bool IsValid => GetProperty(() => isValid, suppressException: true);

		public PrinterSettings.PaperSourceCollection PaperSources => GetProperty(() => paperSources, suppressException: true);

		public PrinterSettings.PaperSizeCollection PaperSizes => GetProperty(() => paperSizes, suppressException: true);

		public bool SupportCollate => GetProperty(() => supportCollate, suppressException: true);

		{

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static string ReadNameFromBuffer(IntPtr pointer, int stringBufferSize)
		{
			string text = Marshal.PtrToStringAuto(pointer, stringBufferSize);
			int num = text.IndexOf('\0');
			if (num > -1)
			{
				text = text.Substring(0, num);
			}
			return text;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static string ReadOutputPort(IntPtr hDevNames)
		{
			IntPtr intPtr = Kernel32Interop.GlobalLock(hDevNames);
			if (intPtr == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return "";
			}
			string result = Marshal.PtrToStringAuto(intPtr + checked(Marshal.SystemDefaultCharSize * Marshal.ReadInt16(intPtr + 4)));
			Kernel32Interop.GlobalUnlock(hDevNames);
			Kernel32Interop.GlobalFree(hDevNames);
			return result;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static string GetOutputPort()
		{
			if (IntPtr.Size == 8)
			{
				PRINTDLG pRINTDLG = new PRINTDLG();
				pRINTDLG.Flags = 1024;
				if (!Comdlg32Interop.PrintDlg(pRINTDLG))
				{
					return "";
				}
				Kernel32Interop.GlobalFree(pRINTDLG.HDevMode);
				return ReadOutputPort(pRINTDLG.HDevNames);
			}
			PRINTDLGX86 pRINTDLGX = new PRINTDLGX86();
			pRINTDLGX.Flags = 1024;
			if (!Comdlg32Interop.PrintDlg(pRINTDLGX))
			{
				return "";
			}
			Kernel32Interop.GlobalFree(pRINTDLGX.HDevMode);
			return ReadOutputPort(pRINTDLGX.HDevNames);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static int DeviceCapabilities(string printerName, string outputPort, short capability, IntPtr pointerToBuffer, int defaultValue)
		{
			int num = WinspoolInterop.DeviceCapabilities(printerName, outputPort, capability, pointerToBuffer, IntPtr.Zero);
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static PrinterResolution CreatePrinterResolution(PrinterResolutionKind kind, int x, int y)
		{
			return new PrinterResolution
			{
				Kind = kind,
				X = x,
				Y = y
			};
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static PrinterResolution[] GetPrinterResolutions(string printerName, string outputPort)
		{
			int num = DeviceCapabilities(printerName, outputPort, 13, IntPtr.Zero, -1);
			PrinterResolution[] array = new PrinterResolution[Math.Max(0, num) + 4];
			array[0] = CreatePrinterResolution(PrinterResolutionKind.High, -4, -1);
			array[1] = CreatePrinterResolution(PrinterResolutionKind.Medium, -3, -1);
			array[2] = CreatePrinterResolution(PrinterResolutionKind.Low, -2, -1);
			array[3] = CreatePrinterResolution(PrinterResolutionKind.Draft, -1, -1);
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return array;
			}
			IntPtr intPtr = Marshal.AllocCoTaskMem(8 * num);
			DeviceCapabilities(printerName, outputPort, 13, intPtr, -1);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				IntPtr intPtr2 = intPtr + checked(i * 8);
				array[i + 4] = CreatePrinterResolution(PrinterResolutionKind.Custom, Marshal.ReadInt32(intPtr2), Marshal.ReadInt32(intPtr2 + 4));
			}
			Marshal.FreeCoTaskMem(intPtr);
			return array;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static PaperSource[] GetPaperSources(string printerName, string outputPort)
		{
			int num = DeviceCapabilities(printerName, outputPort, 12, IntPtr.Zero, -1);
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return new PaperSource[0];
			}
			int num2 = Marshal.SystemDefaultCharSize * 24;
			IntPtr intPtr = Marshal.AllocCoTaskMem(checked(num2 * num));
			DeviceCapabilities(printerName, outputPort, 12, intPtr, -1);
			IntPtr intPtr2 = Marshal.AllocCoTaskMem(2 * num);
			DeviceCapabilities(printerName, outputPort, 6, intPtr2, -1);
			PaperSource[] array = new PaperSource[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				checked
				{
					string sourceName = ReadNameFromBuffer(intPtr + num2 * i, 24);
					array[i] = new PaperSource
					{
						RawKind = Marshal.ReadInt16(intPtr2 + i * 2),
						SourceName = sourceName
					};
				}
			}
			Marshal.FreeCoTaskMem(intPtr);
			Marshal.FreeCoTaskMem(intPtr2);
			return array;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static PaperSize[] GetPaperSizes(string printerName, string outputPort)
		{
			int num = DeviceCapabilities(printerName, outputPort, 16, IntPtr.Zero, -1);
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return new PaperSize[0];
			}
			int num2 = Marshal.SystemDefaultCharSize * 64;
			IntPtr intPtr = Marshal.AllocCoTaskMem(checked(num2 * num));
			DeviceCapabilities(printerName, outputPort, 16, intPtr, -1);
			IntPtr intPtr2 = Marshal.AllocCoTaskMem(2 * num);
			DeviceCapabilities(printerName, outputPort, 2, intPtr2, -1);
			IntPtr intPtr3 = Marshal.AllocCoTaskMem(8 * num);
			DeviceCapabilities(printerName, outputPort, 3, intPtr3, -1);
			PaperSize[] array = new PaperSize[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				checked
				{
					short rawKind = Marshal.ReadInt16(intPtr2 + i * 2);
					int value = Marshal.ReadInt32(intPtr3 + i * 8);
					int value2 = Marshal.ReadInt32(intPtr3 + i * 8 + 4);
					array[i] = new PaperSize
					{
						RawKind = rawKind,
						PaperName = ReadNameFromBuffer(intPtr + num2 * i, 64),
						Width = PrinterUnitConvert.Convert(value, PrinterUnit.TenthsOfAMillimeter, PrinterUnit.Display),
						Height = PrinterUnitConvert.Convert(value2, PrinterUnit.TenthsOfAMillimeter, PrinterUnit.Display)
					};
				}
			}
			Marshal.FreeCoTaskMem(intPtr);
			Marshal.FreeCoTaskMem(intPtr2);
			Marshal.FreeCoTaskMem(intPtr3);
			return array;
		}

		private static PrinterResolution ReadPrinterResolution(DEVMODE mode, PrinterSettings.PrinterResolutionCollection printerResolutions)
		{
			int dmPrintQuality = mode.DmPrintQuality;
			int dmYResolution = mode.DmYResolution;
			foreach (PrinterResolution printerResolution in printerResolutions)
			{
				if ((mode.DmFields & 0x400) != 0 && dmPrintQuality >= 0 && (mode.DmFields & 0x2000) != 0)
				{
					if (printerResolution.X == dmPrintQuality && printerResolution.Y == dmYResolution)
					{
						return printerResolution;
					}
					if (printerResolution.Kind == (PrinterResolutionKind)dmPrintQuality)
					{
						return printerResolution;
					}
				}
			}
			return new PrinterResolution
			{
				Kind = PrinterResolutionKind.Custom,
				X = dmPrintQuality,
				Y = dmYResolution
			};
		}

		private static PaperSize ReadPaperSize(DEVMODE mode, PrinterSettings.PaperSizeCollection paperSizes)
		{
			if ((mode.DmFields & 2) != 0)
			{
				foreach (PaperSize paperSize in paperSizes)
				{
					if (paperSize.RawKind == mode.DmPaperSize)
					{
						return paperSize;
					}
				}
			}
			return new PaperSize
			{
				RawKind = 0,
				PaperName = "custom",
				Width = PrinterUnitConvert.Convert(mode.DmPaperWidth, PrinterUnit.TenthsOfAMillimeter, PrinterUnit.Display),
				Height = PrinterUnitConvert.Convert(mode.DmPaperLength, PrinterUnit.TenthsOfAMillimeter, PrinterUnit.Display)
			};
		}

		private static PaperSource ReadPaperSource(DEVMODE mode, PrinterSettings.PaperSourceCollection paperSources)
		{
			if ((mode.DmFields & 0x200) != 0)
			{
				foreach (PaperSource paperSource in paperSources)
				{
					if (paperSource.RawKind == mode.DmDefaultSource)
					{
						return paperSource;
					}
				}
			}
			return new PaperSource
			{
				RawKind = mode.DmDefaultSource,
				SourceName = "unknown"
			};
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static bool CheckXPSDriver(IntPtr hdc)
		{
			IntPtr intPtr = Marshal.AllocCoTaskMem(4096);
			try
			{
				int num = Gdi32Interop.ExtEscape(hdc, 20, 0, null, 4096, intPtr);
				if (num <= 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Marshal.PtrToStringAnsi(intPtr, 4096).Contains("http://schemas.microsoft.com/xps/2005/06"))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			finally
			{
				Marshal.FreeCoTaskMem(intPtr);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public PdfPrinterSettingsCache(PageSettings sourceSettings)
		{
			this.sourceSettings = sourceSettings;
			Refresh(PdfPrinterSettingsCacheRefreshFlags.All);
		}

		public void Refresh(PdfPrinterSettingsCacheRefreshFlags flags)
		{
			this.flags |= flags;
		}

		public PaperSize GetValidPaperSize(PaperSize paperSize)
		{
			PrinterSettings.PaperSizeCollection property = GetProperty(() => paperSizes, suppressException: true);
			foreach (PaperSize item in property)
			{
				if (item.RawKind == paperSize.RawKind)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return paperSize;
		}

		private T GetProperty<T>(Func<T> getPropertyAction, bool suppressException)
		{
			if (flags != PdfPrinterSettingsCacheRefreshFlags.None)
			{
				lastException = null;
				try
				{
					UpdateInfo(flags);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					lastException = ex;
				}
				flags = PdfPrinterSettingsCacheRefreshFlags.None;
			}
			if (lastException != null && !suppressException)
			{
				throw new AggregateException(lastException);
			}
			return getPropertyAction();
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private void UpdateInfo(PdfPrinterSettingsCacheRefreshFlags flags)
		{
			IntPtr intPtr = IntPtr.Zero;
			bool flag = flags.HasFlag(PdfPrinterSettingsCacheRefreshFlags.PrinterSettings);
			bool flag2 = flags.HasFlag(PdfPrinterSettingsCacheRefreshFlags.PageSettings);
			try
			{
				PrinterSettings printerSettings = sourceSettings.PrinterSettings;
				if (flag)
				{
					printerName = printerSettings.PrinterName;
					string outputPort = GetOutputPort();
					int num = DeviceCapabilities(printerName, outputPort, 18, IntPtr.Zero, -1);
					maximumCopies = ((num == -1) ? 1 : num);
					isValid = num != -1;
					printerResolutions = new PrinterSettings.PrinterResolutionCollection(GetPrinterResolutions(printerName, outputPort));
					paperSources = new PrinterSettings.PaperSourceCollection(GetPaperSources(printerName, outputPort));
					paperSizes = new PrinterSettings.PaperSizeCollection(GetPaperSizes(printerName, outputPort));
					supportCollate = DeviceCapabilities(printerName, outputPort, 22, IntPtr.Zero, 0) == 1;
				}
				try
				{
					intPtr = printerSettings.GetHdevmode(sourceSettings);
				}
				catch
				{
					copies = 1;
					collate = false;
					landscape = false;
					throw;
				}
				IntPtr intPtr2 = Kernel32Interop.GlobalLock(intPtr);
				DEVMODE dEVMODE = (DEVMODE)Marshal.PtrToStructure(intPtr2, typeof(DEVMODE));
				if (flag)
				{
					copies = dEVMODE.DmCopies;
					collate = dEVMODE.DmCollate == 1;
				}
				if (!flag2)
				{
					return;
				}
				landscape = dEVMODE.DmOrientation == 2;
				printerResolution = ReadPrinterResolution(dEVMODE, printerResolutions);
				paperSize = ReadPaperSize(dEVMODE, paperSizes);
				paperSource = ReadPaperSource(dEVMODE, paperSources);
				IntPtr intPtr3 = Gdi32Interop.CreateIC(null, printerName, null, intPtr2);
				if (intPtr3 == IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					throw new Win32Exception();
				}
				try
				{
					isXPSDriver = CheckXPSDriver(intPtr3);
					int deviceCaps = Gdi32Interop.GetDeviceCaps(intPtr3, 88);
					int deviceCaps2 = Gdi32Interop.GetDeviceCaps(intPtr3, 90);
					float num2 = (float)Gdi32Interop.GetDeviceCaps(intPtr3, 112) * 100f / (float)deviceCaps;
					float num3 = (float)Gdi32Interop.GetDeviceCaps(intPtr3, 113) * 100f / (float)deviceCaps2;
					float num4 = (float)Gdi32Interop.GetDeviceCaps(intPtr3, 8) * 100f / (float)deviceCaps;
					float num5 = (float)Gdi32Interop.GetDeviceCaps(intPtr3, 10) * 100f / (float)deviceCaps2;
					hardMarginX = num2;
					hardMarginY = num3;
					if (landscape)
					{
						printableArea = new RectangleF(num3, num2, num5, num4);
					}
					else
					{
						printableArea = new RectangleF(num2, num3, num4, num5);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					Gdi32Interop.DeleteDC(intPtr3);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					Kernel32Interop.GlobalUnlock(intPtr);
					Kernel32Interop.GlobalFree(intPtr);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	[Flags]
	public enum PdfPrinterSettingsCacheRefreshFlags
	{
		None = 0,
		PageSettings = 1,
		PrinterSettings = 2,
		All = 3
	}

				new float[5] { 0f, 0f, 0f, 0f, 1f }

			grayscaleAttributes = new ImageAttributes();

	public abstract class PdfTilePrintDocumentPage : PdfPrintDocumentPage
	{
		private readonly int divisionCount;

		private readonly PdfDocumentRenderer renderer;

		private static IEnumerable<Rectangle> GetTileRectangles(Rectangle visibleRect, int divisionCount)
		{
			int num = (int)Math.Ceiling(Math.Sqrt(divisionCount));
			int num2 = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)divisionCount / (double)num);
			List<Rectangle> list = new List<Rectangle>(num * num2);
			Size size = new Size(visibleRect.Width / num, visibleRect.Height / num2);
			Point location = visibleRect.Location;
			int num3 = 0;
			while (num3 < num2)
			{
				if (num3 == num2 - 1)
				{
					size.Height = visibleRect.Bottom - location.Y;
				}
				int num4 = 0;
				while (num4 < num - 1)
				{
					list.Add(new Rectangle(location, size));
					num4++;
					location.X += size.Width;
				}
				list.Add(new Rectangle(location, new Size(visibleRect.Right - location.X, size.Height)));
				location.X = visibleRect.Location.X;
				num3++;
				location.Y += size.Height;
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected PdfTilePrintDocumentPage(PdfDocumentRenderer renderer, PdfPageState pageState, PdfPrintDocumentCalculator calculator, int divisionCount)
			: base(pageState, calculator)
		{
			this.divisionCount = divisionCount;
			this.renderer = renderer;
		}

		public override void DrawPage(Graphics graphics)
		{
			PdfPrintDocumentCalculator calculator = base.Calculator;
			float num = calculator.PrintingDpi / 100f;
			double num2 = calculator.Scale * num;
			SizeF pageSize = calculator.PageSize;
			Size paperSize = calculator.PaperSize;
			PointF pageOffset = calculator.PageOffset;
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(Convert.ToInt32(pageOffset.X * num), Convert.ToInt32(pageOffset.Y * num), Convert.ToInt32((double)pageSize.Width * num2), Convert.ToInt32((double)pageSize.Height * num2));
			Rectangle b = new Rectangle(0, 0, Convert.ToInt32((float)paperSize.Width * num), Convert.ToInt32((float)paperSize.Height * num));
			Rectangle visibleRect = Rectangle.Intersect(rectangle, b);
			if (visibleRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Rectangle tileRectangle in GetTileRectangles(visibleRect, divisionCount))
			{
				using Bitmap pagePart = GetTile(rectangle, tileRectangle);
				Rectangle graphicsRect = Rectangle.Round(new RectangleF((float)tileRectangle.Location.X / num, (float)tileRectangle.Location.Y / num, (float)tileRectangle.Width / num, (float)tileRectangle.Height / num));
				DrawTile(graphics, pagePart, graphicsRect);
			}
		}

		protected abstract void DrawTile(Graphics graphics, Bitmap pagePart, Rectangle graphicsRect);

		protected Bitmap GetTile(Rectangle pageRect, Rectangle tileRect)
		{
			PdfPrintDocumentCalculator calculator = base.Calculator;
			int width = tileRect.Width;
			int height = tileRect.Height;
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(width, height);
			float printingDpi = calculator.PrintingDpi;
			bitmap.SetResolution(printingDpi, printingDpi);
			float printScale = calculator.PrintScale;
			PointF offset = new PointF((float)(tileRect.Location.X - pageRect.Location.X) / printScale, (float)(-(tileRect.Bottom - pageRect.Bottom)) / printScale);
			try
			{
				PdfPagePrintingInfo pdfPagePrintingInfo = new PdfPagePrintingInfo(printScale, PdfRenderMode.Print, base.PageState, offset);
				pdfPagePrintingInfo.RenderStickyNotes = calculator.PrinterSettings.PrintStickyNotes;
				renderer.RenderToBitmap(pdfPagePrintingInfo, (DXBitmap)SystemDrawingConverter.WrapImage(bitmap));
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return bitmap;
		}
	}
	public interface IPdfValueWrapper<T>
	{
		T Value { get; set; }

		bool IsChanged { get; }

		void Refresh();
	}
	public class PdfValueWrapper<T> : IPdfValueWrapper<T>
	{
		private readonly Func<T> getValueAction;

		private readonly Action<T> setValueAction;

		private T actualValue;

		private bool isValueSet;

		public virtual T Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isValueSet)
				{
					return getValueAction();
				}
				return actualValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (setValueAction != null)
				{
					actualValue = value;
					setValueAction(value);
					isValueSet = true;
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual bool IsChanged => true;

		public PdfValueWrapper(Func<T> getValueAction, Action<T> setValueAction)
		{
			this.getValueAction = getValueAction;
			this.setValueAction = setValueAction;
		}

		public virtual void Refresh()
		{
		}
	}
	internal class PdfReflectionValueWrapper<T> : PdfValueWrapper<T>
	{
		private readonly object source;

		private readonly FieldInfo fieldInfo;

		private readonly object defaultValue;

		private readonly MethodInfo convertMethod;

		private object previousValue;

		public override T Value
		{
			get
			{
				object value = fieldInfo.GetValue(source);
				if (object.Equals(value, defaultValue))
				{
					return base.Value;
				}
				T value2 = ((!(convertMethod != null)) ? ((T)value) : ((T)convertMethod.Invoke(null, new object[1] { value })));
				return ValidateValue(value2);
			}
			set
			{
				base.Value = value;
				previousValue = fieldInfo.GetValue(source);
			}
		}

		public override bool IsChanged
		{
			get
			{
				object value = fieldInfo.GetValue(source);
				if (!object.Equals(value, defaultValue))
				{
					return !object.Equals(value, previousValue);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected static FieldInfo GetFieldInfo(object source, string fieldName)
		{
			return NativeField.Try(source.GetType(), fieldName);
		}

		public static PdfValueWrapper<T> Create(object source, string fieldName, Func<T> getValueAction, Action<T> setValueAction)
		{
			FieldInfo fieldInfo = GetFieldInfo(source, fieldName);
			if (fieldInfo != null && !SecurityHelper.IsPartialTrust)
			{
				Type fieldType = fieldInfo.FieldType;
				object defaultFieldValue = (fieldType.IsValueType ? Activator.CreateInstance(fieldType) : null);
				return new PdfReflectionValueWrapper<T>(source, fieldInfo, defaultFieldValue, getValueAction, setValueAction);
			}
			return new PdfValueWrapper<T>(getValueAction, setValueAction);
		}

		public static PdfValueWrapper<T> Create(object source, string fieldName, object defaultFieldValue, Func<T> getValueAction, Action<T> setValueAction)
		{
			FieldInfo fieldInfo = GetFieldInfo(source, fieldName);
			if (fieldInfo != null && !SecurityHelper.IsPartialTrust)
			{
				return new PdfReflectionValueWrapper<T>(source, fieldInfo, defaultFieldValue, getValueAction, setValueAction);
			}
			return new PdfValueWrapper<T>(getValueAction, setValueAction);
		}

		protected PdfReflectionValueWrapper(object source, FieldInfo fieldInfo, object defaultFieldValue, Func<T> getValueAction, Action<T> setValueAction)
			: base(getValueAction, setValueAction)
		{
			this.source = source;
			this.fieldInfo = fieldInfo;
			defaultValue = defaultFieldValue;
			previousValue = fieldInfo.GetValue(source);
			Type targetType = typeof(T);
			if (!targetType.IsAssignableFrom(fieldInfo.FieldType))
			{
				convertMethod = fieldInfo.FieldType.GetMethods(BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public).FirstOrDefault((MethodInfo method) => method.Name == "op_Explicit" && method.ReturnType == targetType);
			}
		}

		public override void Refresh()
		{
			base.Refresh();
			previousValue = fieldInfo.GetValue(source);
		}

		protected virtual T ValidateValue(T value)
		{
			return value;
		}
	}
	public abstract class PdfPrintCalculator
	{
		public const float UnitsPerDot = 0.72f;

		private const int defaultPageWidth = 850;

		private const int defaultPageHeight = 1100;

		private readonly int pageRotationAngle;

		private PdfPrinterSettings printerSettings;

		private PdfPage page;

		private PdfCachedPageSettings pageSettings;

		private float scale = -1f;

		private Size paperSize = Size.Empty;

		private SizeF pageSize = Size.Empty;

		private PointF? pageOffset;

		private bool hasException;

		private bool recalculateLandscape = true;

		private SizeF? printableAreaSize;

		public PdfCachedPageSettings PageSettings => pageSettings;

		public PdfPrinterSettings PrinterSettings
		{
			get
			{
				return printerSettings;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!printerSettings.Equals(value))
				{
					printerSettings = value;
					pageSettings = printerSettings.CachedSettings.DefaultPageSettings;
					Update();
				}
			}
		}

		public PdfPage Page
		{
			get
			{
				return page;
			}
			set
			{
				if (page != value)
				{
					page = value;
					Update();
					CalculatePageLandscape();
					CalculatePageSize();
				}
			}
		}

		public Size PaperSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (paperSize == Size.Empty)
				{
					CalculateAll();
				}
				return paperSize;
			}
		}

		public SizeF PageSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (pageSize == SizeF.Empty)
				{
					CalculatePageSize();
				}
				return pageSize;
			}
		}

		public float Scale
		{
			get
			{
				if (scale < 0f)
				{
					CalculateAll();
				}
				return scale;
			}
		}

		public PointF PageOffset
		{
			get
			{
				if (!pageOffset.HasValue)
				{
					CalculateAll();
				}
				return pageOffset.Value;
			}
		}

		public bool RecalculateLandscape
		{
			get
			{
				return recalculateLandscape;
			}
			set
			{
				recalculateLandscape = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasException => hasException;

		protected SizeF PrintableAreaSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (!printableAreaSize.HasValue)
				{
					try
					{
						RectangleF printableArea = pageSettings.PrintableArea;
						hasException = false;
						printableAreaSize = printableArea.Size;
					}
					catch
					{
						hasException = true;
						printableAreaSize = new SizeF(850f, 1100f);
					}
				}
				return printableAreaSize.Value;
			}
		}

		private PaperSize PrintPaperSize
		{
			get
			{
				try
				{
					PaperSize result = pageSettings.PaperSize;
					hasException = false;
					return result;
				}
				catch
				{
					hasException = true;
					return new PaperSize(string.Empty, 850, 1100);
				}
			}
		}

		protected PdfPrintCalculator(PdfPrinterSettings printerSettings, PdfPage page, int pageRotationAngle)
		{
			if (printerSettings == null || page == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			this.printerSettings = printerSettings;
			pageSettings = printerSettings.CachedSettings.DefaultPageSettings;
			this.page = page;
			this.pageRotationAngle = pageRotationAngle;
			CalculatePageLandscape();
		}

		protected SizeF GetCurrentPageSize()
		{
			SizeF sizeF = PageSize;
			float num = Scale;
			return new SizeF(sizeF.Width * num, sizeF.Height * num);
		}

		protected virtual void CalculateAll()
		{
			CalculatePageLandscape();
			PaperSize printPaperSize = PrintPaperSize;
			int num = printPaperSize.Width;
			int num2 = printPaperSize.Height;
			if (num <= 0 || num2 <= 0)
			{
				num = 850;
				num2 = 1100;
			}
			paperSize = (pageSettings.Landscape ? new Size(num2, num) : new Size(num, num2));
			CalculatePageSize();
			scale = CalculateScale();
			CalculatePageOffset();
		}

		public virtual void Update()
		{
			scale = -1f;
			paperSize = Size.Empty;
			pageOffset = null;
			printableAreaSize = null;
		}

		public void SetPageSettings(PageSettings value)
		{
			if (!pageSettings.NativeSettings.Equals(value))
			{
				pageSettings = new PdfCachedPageSettings(value);
			}
			else
			{
				pageSettings.RefreshIfChanged();
			}
			CalculatePageLandscape();
			Update();
		}

		private void CalculatePageOffset()
		{
			SizeF sizeF = PrintableAreaSize;
			if (pageSettings.Landscape)
			{
				sizeF = new SizeF(sizeF.Height, sizeF.Width);
			}
			SizeF currentPageSize = GetCurrentPageSize();
			if (printerSettings.PageOrientation == PdfPrintPageOrientation.Auto || printerSettings.ScaleMode == PdfPrintScaleMode.Fit)
			{
				pageOffset = new PointF((sizeF.Width - currentPageSize.Width) / 2f, (sizeF.Height - currentPageSize.Height) / 2f);
			}
			else
			{
				pageOffset = new PointF(0f - pageSettings.PrintableArea.Left, 0f - pageSettings.PrintableArea.Top);
			}
		}

		private void CalculatePageLandscape()
		{
			//IL_005d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (recalculateLandscape)
			{
				if (printerSettings != null && printerSettings.PageOrientation != PdfPrintPageOrientation.Auto)
				{
					pageSettings.Landscape = printerSettings.PageOrientation == PdfPrintPageOrientation.Landscape;
					return;
				}
				SizeF sizeF = PrintableAreaSize;
				float num = sizeF.Height / sizeF.Width;
				PdfSize size = page.GetSize(pageRotationAngle);
				double num2 = ((PdfSize)(ref size)).Height / ((PdfSize)(ref size)).Width;
				pageSettings.Landscape = (num < 1f && num2 > 1.0) || (num > 1f && num2 < 1.0);
			}
		}

		private float CalculateScale()
		{
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PdfPrintScaleMode scaleMode = printerSettings.ScaleMode;
			float result = printerSettings.Scale / 100f;
			switch (scaleMode)
			{
			case PdfPrintScaleMode.Fit:
			{
				SizeF sizeF = PrintableAreaSize;
				if (pageSettings.Landscape)
				{
					sizeF = new SizeF(sizeF.Height, sizeF.Width);
				}
				SizeF sizeF2 = page.GetSize(pageRotationAngle).ToGDISizeF(1.3888888f);
				result = Math.Min(sizeF.Width / sizeF2.Width, sizeF.Height / sizeF2.Height);
				break;
			}
			case PdfPrintScaleMode.ActualSize:
				result = 1f;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void CalculatePageSize()
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PdfSize size = page.GetSize(pageRotationAngle);
			pageSize = new SizeF((float)((PdfSize)(ref size)).Width / 0.72f, (float)((PdfSize)(ref size)).Height / 0.72f);
		}
	}
	public class PdfPrintDocumentCalculator : PdfPrintCalculator
	{
		private int printerResolution;

		private float printingDpi;

		private Rectangle? rectangle;

		private bool isDrawOnGraphics;

		public Rectangle Rectangle
		{
			get
			{
				if (!rectangle.HasValue)
				{
					CalculateAll();
				}
				return rectangle ?? Rectangle.Empty;
			}
		}

		public float PrintingDpi => printingDpi;

		public float PrintScale => printingDpi * base.Scale / 72f;

		public bool IsDrawOnGraphics => isDrawOnGraphics;

		public SizeF PrintingPaperSize
		{
			get
			{
				float num = 0.96f;
				Size size = base.PaperSize;
				return new SizeF((float)size.Width * num, (float)size.Height * num);
			}
		}

		private PointF PrintOffset
		{
			get
			{
				PointF pointF = base.PageOffset;
				float num = 0.72f / base.Scale;
				return new PointF(Math.Min(pointF.X * num, 0f), Math.Min(pointF.Y * num, 0f));
			}
		}

		public PdfPrintDocumentCalculator(PdfPrinterSettings printerSettings, PdfPage page, int pageRotationAngle)
			: base(printerSettings, page, pageRotationAngle)
		{
			rectangle = Rectangle.Empty;
			printerResolution = printerSettings.PrintingDpi;
		}

		public PointF GetOffset(Rectangle rect)
		{
			float printScale = PrintScale;
			Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle;
			PointF printOffset = PrintOffset;
			return new PointF(printOffset.X - (float)(rect.Location.X - rectangle.X) / printScale, printOffset.Y - (float)(rect.Location.Y - rectangle.Y) / printScale);
		}

		public void CalculatePrintingDpi(float printerGraphicsDpi)
		{
			isDrawOnGraphics = !base.PrinterSettings.EnableLegacyPrinting || printerGraphicsDpi <= (float)printerResolution || printerResolution < 0;
			printingDpi = (isDrawOnGraphics ? printerGraphicsDpi : ((float)printerResolution));
			Update();
		}

		public override void Update()
		{
			base.Update();
			rectangle = null;
		}

		protected override void CalculateAll()
		{
			base.CalculateAll();
			SizeF sizeF = base.PageSize;
			float num = printingDpi / 100f;
			double num2 = base.Scale * num;
			sizeF = new SizeF((float)((double)sizeF.Width * num2), (float)((double)sizeF.Height * num2));
			Size size = base.PaperSize;
			PointF pointF = base.PageOffset;
			size = new Size(Convert.ToInt32((float)size.Width * num), Convert.ToInt32((float)size.Height * num));
			int x = ((pointF.X > 0f) ? Convert.ToInt32(pointF.X * num) : 0);
			int y = ((pointF.Y > 0f) ? Convert.ToInt32(pointF.Y * num) : 0);
			int width = (((float)size.Width > sizeF.Width) ? Convert.ToInt32(sizeF.Width) : size.Width);
			int height = (((float)size.Height > sizeF.Height) ? Convert.ToInt32(sizeF.Height) : size.Height);
			rectangle = new Rectangle(x, y, width, height);
		}
	}
	public class PdfPrintPreviewCalculator : PdfPrintCalculator
	{
		private const int border = 1;

		private int largestEdgeLength;

		private Point? pagePosition;

		private Rectangle paperRectangle;

		private Size previewSize;

		private PointF[] unprintableArea;

		private Rectangle printablePageArea;

		private Rectangle printablePaperArea;

		private bool? isDrawPageRectangle;

		public int LargestEdgeLength
		{
			get
			{
				if (largestEdgeLength < 1)
				{
					CalculateAll();
				}
				return largestEdgeLength;
			}
		}

		public Point PagePosition
		{
			get
			{
				if (!pagePosition.HasValue)
				{
					CalculateAll();
				}
				return pagePosition ?? Point.Empty;
			}
		}

		public Rectangle PaperRectangle
		{
			get
			{
				if (paperRectangle == Rectangle.Empty)
				{
					CalculateAll();
				}
				return paperRectangle;
			}
		}

		public bool IsDrawPageRectangle
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isDrawPageRectangle.HasValue)
				{
					CalculateAll();
				}
				return isDrawPageRectangle.Value;
			}
		}

		public Size PreviewSize
		{
			get
			{
				return previewSize;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!previewSize.Equals(value))
				{
					previewSize = value;
					Update();
				}
			}
		}

		public Rectangle PrintablePageArea
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsDrawPageRectangle)
				{
					return Rectangle.Empty;
				}
				return printablePageArea;
			}
		}

		public PointF[] UnprintableArea
		{
			get
			{
				if (unprintableArea == null)
				{
					CalculateAll();
				}
				return unprintableArea;
			}
		}

		private static int ToInt(float value)
		{
			return Convert.ToInt32(Math.Round(value, MidpointRounding.ToEven));
		}

		public PdfPrintPreviewCalculator(PdfPrinterSettings printerSettings, PdfPage page, Size previewSize, int pageRotationAngle)
			: base(printerSettings, page, pageRotationAngle)
		{
			this.previewSize = previewSize;
		}

		public override void Update()
		{
			base.Update();
			largestEdgeLength = 0;
			unprintableArea = null;
			pagePosition = null;
			paperRectangle = Rectangle.Empty;
		}

		protected override void CalculateAll()
		{
			base.CalculateAll();
			CalculatePreviewPositions();
			CalculateUnprintableArea();
			SizeF sizeF = base.PageSize;
			Size size = base.PaperSize;
			float num = base.Scale;
			isDrawPageRectangle = sizeF.Width * num > (float)size.Width || sizeF.Height * num > (float)size.Height;
		}

		private void CalculateUnprintableArea()
		{
			Point point = new Point(0, 0);
			Point point2 = new Point(previewSize.Width, 0);
			Point point3 = new Point(previewSize.Width, previewSize.Height);
			Point point4 = new Point(0, previewSize.Height);
			Point point5 = new Point(printablePaperArea.Left, printablePaperArea.Top);
			Point point6 = new Point(printablePaperArea.Left + printablePaperArea.Width, printablePaperArea.Top);
			Point point7 = new Point(printablePaperArea.Left, printablePaperArea.Top + printablePaperArea.Height);
			Point point8 = new Point(printablePaperArea.Left + printablePaperArea.Width, printablePaperArea.Top + printablePaperArea.Height);
			unprintableArea = new PointF[11]
			{
				point, point2, point3, point4, point, point5, point6, point8, point7, point5,
				point
			};
		}

		private void CalculatePreviewPositions()
		{
			Size size = base.PaperSize;
			PointF pointF = base.PageOffset;
			try
			{
				PdfCachedPageSettings pdfCachedPageSettings = base.PageSettings;
				pointF.X += pdfCachedPageSettings.HardMarginX;
				pointF.Y += pdfCachedPageSettings.HardMarginY;
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			int width = size.Width;
			int height = size.Height;
			float num = previewSize.Width - 2 - 2;
			float num2 = previewSize.Height - 2 - 2;
			float num3 = Math.Min(num / (float)width, num2 / (float)height);
			width = ToInt((float)width * num3);
			height = ToInt((float)height * num3);
			paperRectangle = new Rectangle(ToInt((num - (float)width) / 2f) + 1 + 1, ToInt((num2 - (float)height) / 2f) + 1 + 1, width, height);
			CalculatePrintablePaperArea(num3);
			Size currentPageSize = GetCurrentPageSize(num3);
			Point value = new Point(ToInt(pointF.X * num3 + (float)paperRectangle.X), ToInt(pointF.Y * num3 + (float)paperRectangle.Y));
			pagePosition = value;
			printablePageArea = new Rectangle(Math.Max(paperRectangle.X, value.X) - 1, Math.Max(paperRectangle.Y, value.Y) - 1, Math.Min(currentPageSize.Width, width) + 1, Math.Min(currentPageSize.Height, height) + 1);
			largestEdgeLength = ToInt(Math.Max(currentPageSize.Height, currentPageSize.Width));
		}

		private void CalculatePrintablePaperArea(float scaleFactor)
		{
			PdfCachedPageSettings pdfCachedPageSettings = base.PageSettings;
			SizeF sizeF = base.PrintableAreaSize;
			int num = ToInt(sizeF.Width * scaleFactor);
			int num2 = ToInt(sizeF.Height * scaleFactor);
			Size size = (pdfCachedPageSettings.Landscape ? new Size(num2, num) : new Size(num, num2));
			float num3 = 0f;
			float num4 = 0f;
			try
			{
				num3 = pdfCachedPageSettings.HardMarginX;
				num4 = pdfCachedPageSettings.HardMarginY;
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			printablePaperArea = new Rectangle(new Point(ToInt((float)paperRectangle.Left + num3 * scaleFactor), ToInt((float)paperRectangle.Top + num4 * scaleFactor)), size);
		}

		private Size GetCurrentPageSize(float scaleFactor)
		{
			SizeF currentPageSize = GetCurrentPageSize();
			return new Size(Convert.ToInt32(currentPageSize.Width * scaleFactor), Convert.ToInt32(currentPageSize.Height * scaleFactor));
		}
	}
