namespace DevExpress.Pdf.Drawing.GDI
{
	public class GDIFont : IDisposable
	{
		internal const int NormalWeight = 400;

		private const int BoldWeight = 700;

		private readonly GDIFontResource resource;

		public string Name { get; }

		public int Weight { get; }

		public bool Italic { get; }

		public FontPitchAndFamily PitchAndFamily { get; }

		public bool IsNotSubstituted => resource != null;

		private static int GetWeight(PdfFont font)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			PdfFontDescriptor fontDescriptor = font.FontDescriptor;
			if (fontDescriptor == null)
			{
				return 400;
			}
			if ((fontDescriptor.Flags & 0x40000) != 262144)
			{
				return fontDescriptor.FontWeight;
			}
			return 700;
		}

		internal static bool IsItalic(PdfFont font)
		{
			PdfFontDescriptor fontDescriptor = font.FontDescriptor;
			if (fontDescriptor != null)
			{
				return fontDescriptor.ItalicAngle != 0.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static FontPitchAndFamily GetPitchAndFamily(PdfFont font)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			PdfFontDescriptor fontDescriptor = font.FontDescriptor;
			if (fontDescriptor == null)
			{
				return FontPitchAndFamily.VARIABLE_PITCH;
			}
			PdfFontFlags flags = fontDescriptor.Flags;
			FontPitchAndFamily fontPitchAndFamily = (((flags & 1) == 1) ? FontPitchAndFamily.FIXED_PITCH : FontPitchAndFamily.VARIABLE_PITCH);
			if ((flags & 2) > 0)
			{
				fontPitchAndFamily |= FontPitchAndFamily.FF_ROMAN;
			}
			if ((flags & 8) > 0)
			{
				fontPitchAndFamily |= FontPitchAndFamily.FF_SCRIPT;
			}
			return fontPitchAndFamily;
		}

		public GDIFont(PdfFont font, GDIFontResource resource)
		{
			Name = resource.Name;
			Weight = GetWeight(font);
			PitchAndFamily = FontPitchAndFamily.DEFAULT_PITCH;
			this.resource = resource;
		}

		public GDIFont(string name, int weight, bool italic, FontPitchAndFamily pitchAndFamily)
		{
			Name = name;
			Weight = weight;
			Italic = italic;
			PitchAndFamily = pitchAndFamily;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		internal IntPtr CreateNativeFont(int fontSize, bool forceBold, FontQuality fontQuality)
		{
			return Gdi32Interop.CreateFont(-fontSize, 0, 0, 0, forceBold ? 700 : Weight, Italic, underline: false, strikeOut: false, FontCharSet.DEFAULT_CHARSET, FontOutputPrecision.OUT_DEFAULT_PRECIS, FontClipPrecision.CLIP_DEFAULT_PRECIS, fontQuality, PitchAndFamily, Name);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			resource?.Dispose();
		}
	}
	public abstract class GDIFontResource : IDisposable
	{
		private class MemoryResource : GDIFontResource
		{
			private readonly IntPtr fontHandle;

			public MemoryResource(string name, IntPtr fontHandle)
				: base(name)
			{
				this.fontHandle = fontHandle;
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			protected override void RemoveFontResources()
			{
				Gdi32Interop.RemoveFontMemResourceEx(fontHandle);
			}
		}

		private class FileResource : GDIFontResource
		{
			private readonly string fontResourceName;

			private readonly string[] files;

			private static void DeleteFontFile(string fileName)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileName))
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					if (File.Exists(fileName))
					{
						File.Delete(fileName);
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}

			public FileResource(string name, string fontResourceName, params string[] files)
				: base(name)
			{
				this.fontResourceName = fontResourceName;
				this.files = files;
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			protected override void RemoveFontResources()
			{
				Gdi32Interop.RemoveFontResourceEx(fontResourceName, FontCharacteristics.FR_PRIVATE, IntPtr.Zero);
				string[] array = files;
				foreach (string fileName in array)
				{
					DeleteFontFile(fileName);
				}
			}
		}

		public string Name { get; }

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static GDIFontResource CreateMemoryResource(string name, byte[] fontFileData)
		{
			if (fontFileData == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int fontCount;
			IntPtr intPtr = Gdi32Interop.AddFontMemResourceEx(fontFileData, fontFileData.Length, IntPtr.Zero, out fontCount);
			if (!(intPtr == IntPtr.Zero))
			{
				return new MemoryResource(name, intPtr);
			}
			return null;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static GDIFontResource CreateType1FontFileResource(string fontName, PdfFont font, PdfFontDataType1 type1File, string fontFolderName)
		{
			string text = fontFolderName + Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
			string text2 = text + ".pfm";
			string text3 = text + ".pfb";
			string text4 = text2 + "|" + text3;
			AfmPfbCreator.CreateFontFiles(fontName, font, type1File, text2, text3);
			if (Gdi32Interop.AddFontResourceEx(text4, FontCharacteristics.FR_PRIVATE, IntPtr.Zero) == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new FileResource(fontName, text4, text2, text3);
		}

		protected GDIFontResource(string name)
		{
			Name = name;
		}

		~GDIFontResource()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			RemoveFontResources();
		}

		protected abstract void RemoveFontResources();

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

	public class GDIFontStorage : RenderFontStorage<GDIFont>, IPdfRenderingFontInfoProvider
	{
		private readonly Lazy<GDIMeasuringContext> measuringContext = new Lazy<GDIMeasuringContext>(() => new GDIMeasuringContext());

		private string fontFolderName;

		private Stream lockFileStream;

		private string FontFolderName
		{
			get
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fontFolderName))
				{
					fontFolderName = PdfTempFolder.Create();
					lockFileStream = File.Create(fontFolderName + Guid.NewGuid().ToString() + ".lock", 4096, FileOptions.DeleteOnClose);
				}
				return fontFolderName;
			}
		}

		private GDIFont CreateGDIFont(string fontName, PdfFont font, byte[] data)
		{
			GDIFontResource gDIFontResource = GDIFontResource.CreateMemoryResource(fontName, data);
			if (gDIFontResource != null)
			{
				return new GDIFont(font, gDIFontResource);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override GDIFont CreateCFFRenderFont(PdfFont font, byte[] cffFont)
		{
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			PdfType1FontCompactFontProgram val = PdfType1FontCompactFontProgram.Parse(cffFont);
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.Validate();
				string text = RenderFontStorageHelpers.CreateFontName();
				byte[] data = PdfOpenTypeFontCreator.Create(font, (PdfCFFFontProgramFacade)font.FontProgramFacade, text, PdfType1FontCompactFontProgram.Write(val));
				return CreateGDIFont(text, font, data);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override GDIFont CreateTTFRenderFont(PdfFont font, byte[] ttfFont)
		{
			string fontName = RenderFontStorageHelpers.CreateFontName();
			return CreateGDIFont(fontName, font, RenderFontStorageHelpers.ValidateTTF(font, ttfFont, fontName));
		}

		protected override GDIFont CreateType1RenderFont(PdfFont font, PdfFontDataType1 type1Font)
		{
			string text = RenderFontStorageHelpers.CreateFontName();
			if (type1Font.IsCIDData)
			{
				byte[] data = PdfOpenTypeFontCreator.Create(font, PdfType1FontProgram.ConvertToCFF(font.FontName, type1Font), text);
				return CreateGDIFont(text, font, data);
			}
			PdfType1FontClassicFontProgram val = PdfType1FontClassicFontProgram.Create(font.BaseFont, type1Font);
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.Validate(font, text);
				byte[] bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(val.ToPostScript());
				int num = bytes.Length;
				int cipherTextLength = type1Font.CipherTextLength;
				int nullSegmentLength = type1Font.NullSegmentLength;
				int num2 = cipherTextLength + nullSegmentLength;
				byte[] array = new byte[num + num2];
				Array.Copy(bytes, array, num);
				Array.Copy(((PdfFontData)type1Font).Data, type1Font.PlainTextLength, array, num, num2);
				type1Font = PdfFontDataType1.CreateWithLengths(array, num, cipherTextLength, nullSegmentLength);
			}
			return CreateGDIFont(text, font, type1Font);
		}

		private GDIFont CreateGDIFont(string fontName, PdfFont font, PdfFontDataType1 type1Font)
		{
			GDIFontResource gDIFontResource = GDIFontResource.CreateType1FontFileResource(fontName, font, type1Font, FontFolderName);
			if (gDIFontResource != null)
			{
				return new GDIFont(font, gDIFontResource);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override GDIFont SubstituteRenderFont(PdfFont font)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PdfFontParameters matchingFont = GDIFontSubstitutionEngine.GetMatchingFont(font);
			FontPitchAndFamily fontPitchAndFamily = GDIFont.GetPitchAndFamily(font);
			string name = ((PdfFontParameters)(ref matchingFont)).Name;
			if (name == "Lucida Console")
			{
				fontPitchAndFamily &= ~FontPitchAndFamily.VARIABLE_PITCH;
				fontPitchAndFamily |= FontPitchAndFamily.FIXED_PITCH;
			}
			return new GDIFont(name, ((PdfFontParameters)(ref matchingFont)).Weight, ((PdfFontParameters)(ref matchingFont)).IsItalic, fontPitchAndFamily);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			base.Dispose(disposing);
			if (disposing && measuringContext.IsValueCreated)
			{
				measuringContext.Value.Dispose();
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fontFolderName))
			{
				try
				{
					lockFileStream.Close();
					Directory.Delete(fontFolderName, recursive: true);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}

		public override void RemoveRenderFont(PdfFont font)
		{
			if (measuringContext.IsValueCreated)
			{
				measuringContext.Value.Reset();
			}
			base.RemoveRenderFont(font);
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			if (measuringContext.IsValueCreated)
			{
				measuringContext.Value.Reset();
			}
			base.Clear();
		}

		double IPdfRenderingFontInfoProvider.GetWidth(PdfFont font, int charCode)
		{
			return measuringContext.Value.GetWidth(GetRenderFont(font), charCode);
		}

		PdfFontMetricsMetadata IPdfRenderingFontInfoProvider.GetMetrics(PdfFont font)
		{
			return measuringContext.Value.GetMetrics(GetRenderFont(font));
		}

			public override void Render(Graphics graphics, GDIImageRenderParams renderParams)

		internal static readonly PointF[] ImageDestinationPoints = new PointF[3]
		{
			new PointF(0f, 0f),
			new PointF(1f, 0f),
			new PointF(0f, 1f)
		};

		private static readonly PdfPoint[] pdfImageDestinationPoints = (PdfPoint[])(object)new PdfPoint[3]
		{

		private readonly int stride;

		private readonly PixelFormat pixelFormat;

		private readonly PdfImageColor[] palette;

		private readonly bool isMask;

		private readonly bool interpolate;

		{

			new PointF(1.0008f, -0.0008f),
			new PointF(-0.0008f, 1.0008f)
		};

		public bool Interpolate => interpolate;

		public static Size GetImageSize(PdfTransformationMatrix transform)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			int width = (int)Math.Round(PdfPoint.Distance(array[0], array[1]));
			int height = (int)Math.Round(PdfPoint.Distance(array[0], array[2]));
			return new Size(width, height);
		}

		private static byte[] GetImageRaster(PdfImageData imageData)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[imageData.Stride * imageData.Height];
			PdfImageDataSource data = imageData.Data;
			try
			{

			}
		}

		public static GDIImage CreateRasterImage(PdfImage image, PdfImageData imageData)

		public static GDIImage CreateDataSourceImage(PdfImage image, PdfImageData imageData)

		protected GDIImage(PdfImageData imageData, PdfImage image)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			parameters = new PdfImageParameters(imageData.Width, imageData.Height, true);
			stride = imageData.Stride;
			pixelFormat = GDIRenderingUtils.ConvertPixelFormat(imageData.PixelFormat);
			palette = imageData.Palette;
			bitsPerComponent = image.BitsPerComponent;
			isMask = image.IsMask;
			interpolate = image.Interpolate;
		}

		protected void DrawImage(Graphics graphics, Bitmap bitmap, GDIImageRenderParams renderParams)
		{
			if (renderParams.ShouldCorrectInterpolationGaps)
			{
				graphics.InterpolationMode = InterpolationMode.NearestNeighbor;
				graphics.DrawImage(bitmap, correctedImageDestinationPoints);
				graphics.InterpolationMode = InterpolationMode.HighQualityBicubic;
				graphics.DrawBitmapWithAlphaConstant(bitmap, ImageDestinationPoints, renderParams.Alpha);
			}
			else
			{
				graphics.InterpolationMode = renderParams.InterpolationMode;
				if (renderParams.Alpha == 1.0)
				{
					graphics.DrawImage(bitmap, ImageDestinationPoints);
				}
				else
				{
					graphics.DrawBitmapWithAlphaConstant(bitmap, ImageDestinationPoints, renderParams.Alpha);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void DrawImage(Graphics graphics, Bitmap bitmap, float top, float bottom, GDIImageRenderParams renderParams)
		{
			graphics.InterpolationMode = ((!renderParams.ShouldCorrectInterpolationGaps) ? renderParams.InterpolationMode : InterpolationMode.Default);
			graphics.DrawBitmapWithAlphaConstant(bitmap, new PointF[3]
			{
				new PointF(0f, top),
				new PointF(1f, top),
				new PointF(0f, bottom)
			}, renderParams.Alpha);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private void PerformRendering(byte[] data, int height, Color[] imagePalette, Action<Bitmap> action)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			GCHandle gCHandle = GCHandle.Alloc(data, GCHandleType.Pinned);
			try
			{
				PdfImageParameters val = parameters;
				using Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(((PdfImageParameters)(ref val)).Width, height, stride, pixelFormat, gCHandle.AddrOfPinnedObject());
				if (imagePalette != null)
				{
					ColorPalette colorPalette = bitmap.Palette;
					Array.Copy(imagePalette, colorPalette.Entries, 256);
					bitmap.Palette = colorPalette;
				}
				action(bitmap);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (gCHandle.IsAllocated)
				{
					gCHandle.Free();
				}
			}
		}

		public abstract void Render(Graphics g, GDIImageRenderParams renderParams);

		public abstract void Dispose();

		protected override ImageCacheItem<GDIImage> CreateValue(PdfImage image, PdfImageParameters imageParameters)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			PdfImageData actualData = image.GetActualData(imageParameters, true);
			long num = actualData.Stride * actualData.Height;
			if (num > base.Capacity)
			{
				return new ImageCacheItem<GDIImage>(GDIImage.CreateDataSourceImage(image, actualData), image, imageParameters, num);
			}
			try
			{
				return new ImageCacheItem<GDIImage>(GDIImage.CreateRasterImage(image, actualData), image, imageParameters, num);
			}
			catch (OutOfMemoryException)
			{

			}
		}

	internal struct GDIImageRenderParams
	{
		public Color[] Palette { get; }

		public double Alpha { get; }

		public InterpolationMode InterpolationMode { get; }

		public bool ShouldCorrectInterpolationGaps { get; }

		private static InterpolationMode GetInterpolationMode(GDIImage image, double scale, PdfTransformationMatrix gsTransform)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0046: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0064: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0069: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0083: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0088: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (scale < 1.5277777910232544)
			{
				return InterpolationMode.HighQualityBicubic;
			}
			PdfImageParameters parameters = image.Parameters;
			int width = ((PdfImageParameters)(ref parameters)).Width;
			parameters = image.Parameters;
			int height = ((PdfImageParameters)(ref parameters)).Height;
			PdfPoint val = gsTransform.Transform(new PdfPoint(0.0, 0.0));
			double num = PdfPoint.Distance(gsTransform.Transform(new PdfPoint(1.0, 0.0)), val);
			double num2 = PdfPoint.Distance(gsTransform.Transform(new PdfPoint(0.0, 1.0)), val);
			if (image.BitsPerComponent != 1 || (!((double)width < num * 1.35) && !((double)height < num2 * 1.35)))
			{
				return InterpolationMode.HighQualityBicubic;
			}
			return InterpolationMode.NearestNeighbor;
		}

		public static GDIImageRenderParams Create(GDIImage gdiImage, PdfColor color, double alpha, double scale, PdfTransformationMatrix gsTransform)
		{
			InterpolationMode interpolationMode = GetInterpolationMode(gdiImage, scale, gsTransform);
			bool shouldCorrectInterpolationGaps = gdiImage.BitsPerComponent > 1 && alpha == 1.0 && gdiImage.PixelFormat != PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb;
			return new GDIImageRenderParams(ConvertPalette(gdiImage, color, alpha), alpha, interpolationMode, shouldCorrectInterpolationGaps);
		}

		private static Color[] ConvertPalette(GDIImage image, PdfColor nonStrokingColor, double nonStrokingAlpha)
		{
			Color[] array;
			if (image.IsMask)
			{
				array = new Color[256];
				Color baseColor = (array[0] = GDIRenderingUtils.ConvertToGDIPlusColor(nonStrokingColor, nonStrokingAlpha));
				int a = baseColor.A;
				double num = (double)a / 255.0;
				for (int i = 1; i < 255; i++)
				{
					array[i] = Color.FromArgb((int)Math.Round((double)a - (double)i * num), baseColor);
				}
				array[255] = Color.FromArgb(0, 0, 0, 0);
			}
			else
			{
				PdfImageColor[] palette = image.Palette;
				if (palette == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				array = new Color[palette.Length];
				int num2 = palette.Length;
				for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
				{
					PdfImageColor val = palette[j];
					array[j] = Color.FromArgb(val.Alpha, val.Red, val.Green, val.Blue);
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		private GDIImageRenderParams(Color[] palette, double alpha, InterpolationMode interpolationMode, bool shouldCorrectInterpolationGaps)
		{
			Palette = palette;
			Alpha = alpha;
			InterpolationMode = interpolationMode;
			ShouldCorrectInterpolationGaps = shouldCorrectInterpolationGaps;
		}
	}

		public static bool ShouldFillText(this PdfTextRenderingMode mode)

			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

	public static class GDIRenderingUtils
	{
		public static PixelFormat ConvertPixelFormat(PdfPixelFormat pixelFormat)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			return (pixelFormat - 1) switch
			{
				0 => PixelFormat.Format8bppIndexed, 
				1 => PixelFormat.Format24bppRgb, 
				2 => PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb, 
				_ => PixelFormat.Format24bppRgb, 
			};
		}

		public static ImageAttributes GetImageOpacityAttributes(double alphaConstant)
		{
			float[][] newColorMatrix = new float[5][]
			{
				new float[5] { 1f, 0f, 0f, 0f, 0f },
				new float[5] { 0f, 1f, 0f, 0f, 0f },
				new float[5] { 0f, 0f, 1f, 0f, 0f },
				new float[5]
				{
					0f,
					0f,
					0f,
					(float)alphaConstant,
					0f
				},
				new float[5] { 0f, 0f, 0f, 0f, 1f }
			};
			ImageAttributes imageAttributes = new ImageAttributes();
			imageAttributes.SetColorMatrix(new ColorMatrix(newColorMatrix), ColorMatrixFlag.Default, ColorAdjustType.Bitmap);
			return imageAttributes;
		}

		public static ImageAttributes GetImageAttributes(double alphaConstant)
		{
			ImageAttributes imageAttributes = ((alphaConstant == 1.0) ? new ImageAttributes() : GetImageOpacityAttributes(alphaConstant));
			imageAttributes.SetWrapMode(WrapMode.TileFlipXY);
			return imageAttributes;
		}

		public static Color ConvertToGDIPlusColor(PdfColor color, double alphaConstant)
		{
			PdfRGBColorData val = default(PdfRGBColorData);
			((PdfRGBColorData)(ref val))..ctor(color);
			return Color.FromArgb(Convert.ToByte(alphaConstant * 255.0), Convert.ToByte(((PdfRGBColorData)(ref val)).R * 255.0), Convert.ToByte(((PdfRGBColorData)(ref val)).G * 255.0), Convert.ToByte(((PdfRGBColorData)(ref val)).B * 255.0));
		}

		public static Color ConvertToGDIPlusColor(PdfColor color)
		{
			return ConvertToGDIPlusColor(color, 1.0);
		}

		public static bool IsFlatPath(IList<PdfGraphicsPath> paths, bool forFilling)
		{
			if (paths.Count == 1)
			{
				return paths[0].IsFlat(forFilling);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static GraphicsPath ConvertPath(IList<PdfGraphicsPath> paths, bool nonZero = false)
		{
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0092: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ae: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
			graphicsPath.FillMode = (nonZero ? FillMode.Winding : FillMode.Alternate);
			foreach (PdfGraphicsPath path in paths)
			{
				graphicsPath.StartFigure();
				PointF pt = path.StartPoint.ToPointF();
				foreach (PdfGraphicsPathSegment segment in path.Segments)
				{
					PdfLineGraphicsPathSegment val = (PdfLineGraphicsPathSegment)(object)((segment is PdfLineGraphicsPathSegment) ? segment : null);
					if (val != null)
					{
						PointF pointF = ((PdfGraphicsPathSegment)val).EndPoint.ToPointF();
						graphicsPath.AddLine(pt, ((PdfGraphicsPathSegment)val).EndPoint.ToPointF());
						pt = pointF;
						continue;
					}
					PdfBezierGraphicsPathSegment val2 = (PdfBezierGraphicsPathSegment)(object)((segment is PdfBezierGraphicsPathSegment) ? segment : null);
					if (val2 != null)
					{
						PointF pointF2 = ((PdfGraphicsPathSegment)val2).EndPoint.ToPointF();
						graphicsPath.AddBezier(pt, val2.ControlPoint1.ToPointF(), val2.ControlPoint2.ToPointF(), pointF2);
						pt = pointF2;
					}
				}
				if (path.Closed)
				{
					graphicsPath.CloseFigure();
				}
			}
			return graphicsPath;
		}

		public static Pen CreateStrokingPen(PdfGraphicsState graphicsState, Brush brush)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			float num = (float)graphicsState.LineWidth;
			Pen pen = new Pen(brush, num);
			pen.LineJoin = graphicsState.LineJoin.ToGDILineJoin();
			LineCap endCap = (pen.StartCap = graphicsState.LineCap.ToGDILineCap());
			pen.EndCap = endCap;
			pen.DashCap = graphicsState.LineCap.ToGDIDashCap();
			PdfLineStyle lineStyle = graphicsState.LineStyle;
			if (lineStyle.IsDashed)
			{
				pen.DashStyle = DashStyle.Custom;
				double[] dashPattern = lineStyle.DashPattern;
				int num2 = dashPattern.Length;
				bool flag = num2 % 2 != 0;
				float[] array = new float[flag ? (num2 * 2) : num2];
				for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
				{
					float num3 = (float)dashPattern[i] / num;
					array[i] = ((num3 <= 0f) ? 1f : num3);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					Array.Copy(array, 0, array, num2, num2);
				}
				pen.DashPattern = array;
				pen.DashOffset = (float)lineStyle.DashPhase / num;
			}
			pen.MiterLimit = (float)graphicsState.MiterLimit;
			return pen;
		}

		public static SmoothingMode GetSmoothingMode(PdfTransformationMatrix matrix, IList<PdfGraphicsPath> path, bool forFilling)
		{
			if (!matrix.IsNotRotated || !IsFlatPath(path, forFilling))
			{
				return SmoothingMode.HighQuality;
			}
			return SmoothingMode.None;
		}
	}
	internal class GDITextRenderer : IDisposable
	{
		private class GDIGraphicsPath
		{
			private const float precisionFactor = 0.0001f;

			private readonly POINT[] points;

			private readonly byte[] types;

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			public static GDIGraphicsPath GetCurrentPath(IntPtr hdc)
			{
				int path = Gdi32Interop.GetPath(hdc, null, null, 0);
				if (path > 0)
				{
					POINT[] lpPoints = new POINT[path];
					byte[] lpTypes = new byte[path];
					Gdi32Interop.GetPath(hdc, lpPoints, lpTypes, path);
					return new GDIGraphicsPath(lpPoints, lpTypes);
				}
				return null;
			}

			public GDIGraphicsPath(POINT[] points, byte[] types)
			{
				this.points = points;
				this.types = types;
			}

			private static PointF ConvertPoint(POINT pt)
			{
				return new PointF((float)pt.X * 0.0001f, (float)pt.Y * 0.0001f);
			}

			public GraphicsPath CreatePath()
			{
				if (points != null)
				{
					int num = points.Length;
					PointF pt = ConvertPoint(points[0]);
					GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath(FillMode.Winding);
					for (int i = 1; i < num; i++)
					{
						PointF pointF = ConvertPoint(points[i]);
						if (types[i] < 6)
						{
							if ((types[i] & 2) != 0)
							{
								graphicsPath.AddLine(pt, pointF);
							}
							if ((types[i] & 4) != 0 && i < num - 2)
							{
								PointF pt2 = ConvertPoint(points[i + 1]);
								PointF pointF2 = ConvertPoint(points[i + 2]);
								graphicsPath.AddBezier(pt, pointF, pt2, pointF2);
								pointF = pointF2;
								i += 2;
							}
							if ((types[i] & 1) != 0)
							{
								graphicsPath.CloseFigure();
							}
						}
						else
						{
							graphicsPath.StartFigure();
						}
						pt = pointF;
					}
					return graphicsPath;
				}
				return new GraphicsPath();
			}
		}

		private const int textRenderingPrecision = 10000;

		private static readonly PdfTransformationMatrix precisionCompensationMatrix = new PdfTransformationMatrix(0.0001, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0001, 0.0, 0.0);

		private int currentTextColor;

		private GDIFont currentFont;

		private IntPtr currentFontHandle;

		private IntPtr defaultFontHandle;

		private readonly GraphicsMode initalGraphicsMode;

		private readonly TextAlign initalTextAlign;

		private readonly BackgroundMode initalBackgroundMode;

		private readonly int initalTextColor;

		private readonly Graphics graphics;

		private readonly Region clipRegion;

		private readonly IntPtr hdc;

		private readonly IntPtr clipHrgn;

		private readonly FontQuality fontQuality;

		public GDIFont Font
		{
			get
			{
				return currentFont;
			}
			set
			{
				DeleteCurrentFont();
				currentFont = value;
			}
		}

		public int TextColor
		{
			get
			{
				return currentTextColor;
			}
			set
			{
				SetTextColor(value);
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public GDITextRenderer(Graphics graphics, Region clipRegion, FontQuality fontQuality)
		{
			this.graphics = graphics;
			clipHrgn = clipRegion?.GetHrgn(graphics) ?? IntPtr.Zero;
			hdc = graphics.GetHdc();
			this.clipRegion = clipRegion;
			this.fontQuality = fontQuality;
			Gdi32Interop.SelectClipRgn(hdc, clipHrgn);
			initalGraphicsMode = Gdi32Interop.SetGraphicsMode(hdc, GraphicsMode.GM_ADVANCED);
			initalTextAlign = Gdi32Interop.SetTextAlign(hdc, TextAlign.TA_BASELINE);
			initalBackgroundMode = Gdi32Interop.SetBkMode(hdc, BackgroundMode.TRANSPARENT);
			initalTextColor = Gdi32Interop.SetTextColor(hdc, TextColor);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private void SetTextColor(int color)
		{
			currentTextColor = color;
			Gdi32Interop.SetTextColor(hdc, currentTextColor);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public GraphicsPath GetTextOutline(short[] str, float[] positions, PdfTransformationMatrix transform, bool isIndices)
		{
			Gdi32Interop.BeginPath(hdc);
			ShowText(str, positions, transform, isIndices);
			Gdi32Interop.EndPath(hdc);
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = GDIGraphicsPath.GetCurrentPath(hdc)?.CreatePath();
			if (graphicsPath != null)
			{
				using Matrix matrix = new Matrix((float)transform.A, (float)transform.B, (float)transform.C, (float)transform.D, (float)transform.E, (float)transform.F);
				graphicsPath.Transform(matrix);
			}
			return graphicsPath;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public void ShowText(short[] str, float[] positions, PdfTransformationMatrix transform, bool isIndices)
		{
			if (EnsureCurrentFont())
			{
				TextOutOptions options = (isIndices ? TextOutOptions.ETO_GLYPH_INDEX : TextOutOptions.ETO_IGNORELANGUAGE);
				int[] spacing = Array.ConvertAll(positions, (float pos) => (int)Math.Round(pos * 10000f));
				transform = PdfTransformationMatrix.Multiply(precisionCompensationMatrix, transform);
				XFORM xform = new XFORM(transform);
				Gdi32Interop.SetWorldTransform(hdc, ref xform);
				RECT dimensions = default(RECT);
				Gdi32Interop.ExtTextOut(hdc, 0, 0, options, ref dimensions, str, str.Length, spacing);
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private void DeleteCurrentFont()
		{
			if (currentFontHandle != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				Gdi32Interop.DeleteObject(currentFontHandle);
				currentFontHandle = IntPtr.Zero;
				if (defaultFontHandle != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					Gdi32Interop.SelectObject(hdc, defaultFontHandle);
					defaultFontHandle = IntPtr.Zero;
				}
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private bool EnsureCurrentFont()
		{
			if (currentFontHandle == IntPtr.Zero && currentFont != null)
			{
				currentFontHandle = currentFont.CreateNativeFont(10000, forceBold: false, fontQuality);
				if (currentFontHandle == IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					return false;
				}
				IntPtr hObject = Gdi32Interop.SelectObject(hdc, currentFontHandle);
				if (defaultFontHandle == IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					defaultFontHandle = hObject;
				}
				else
				{
					Gdi32Interop.DeleteObject(hObject);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public void Dispose()
		{
			XFORM xForm = default(XFORM);
			Gdi32Interop.ModifyWorldTransform(hdc, ref xForm, ModifyWorldTransformMode.MWT_IDENTITY);
			Gdi32Interop.SelectClipRgn(hdc, IntPtr.Zero);
			Gdi32Interop.SetTextAlign(hdc, initalTextAlign);
			Gdi32Interop.SetBkMode(hdc, initalBackgroundMode);
			Gdi32Interop.SetTextColor(hdc, initalTextColor);
			Gdi32Interop.SetGraphicsMode(hdc, initalGraphicsMode);
			DeleteCurrentFont();
			clipRegion.ReleaseHrgn(clipHrgn);
			graphics.ReleaseHdc(hdc);
		}
	}
	internal class GDIMeasuringContext : IDisposable
	{
		private Bitmap bitmap;

		private Graphics graphics;

		private IntPtr defaultFont;

		private GDIFont currentMeasuringFont;

		private IntPtr hdc;

		public GDIMeasuringContext()
		{
			bitmap = new Bitmap(1, 1);
			graphics = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
			hdc = graphics.GetHdc();
		}

		public double GetWidth(GDIFont font, int charCode)
		{
			return PerformActionWithFont(font, delegate(IntPtr hdc)
			{
				ABCFLOAT lpABC = default(ABCFLOAT);
				return (Gdi32Interop.GetCharABCWidthsFloat(hdc, charCode, ref lpABC) != 0) ? ((double)((lpABC.A + lpABC.B + lpABC.C) / 10f)) : 0.0;
			});
		}

		public PdfFontMetricsMetadata GetMetrics(GDIFont font)
		{
			return PerformActionWithFont(font, GetMetrics);
		}

		private T PerformActionWithFont<T>(GDIFont font, Func<IntPtr, T> action)
		{
			try
			{
				if (!SelectFont(font))
				{
					return default(T);
				}
				return action(hdc);
			}
			catch
			{
				return default(T);
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static PdfFontMetricsMetadata GetMetrics(IntPtr hdc)
		{
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (Gdi32Interop.GetTextMetrics(hdc, out var metric))
			{
				return new PdfFontMetricsMetadata((double)(metric.Ascent / 10), (double)(-metric.Descent / 10));
			}
			return null;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private bool SelectFont(GDIFont font)
		{
			if (font != currentMeasuringFont)
			{
				IntPtr intPtr = font.CreateNativeFont(10000, forceBold: false, FontQuality.DEFAULT_QUALITY);
				if (intPtr == IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					return false;
				}
				IntPtr hObject = Gdi32Interop.SelectObject(hdc, intPtr);
				if (defaultFont == IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					defaultFont = hObject;
				}
				else
				{
					Gdi32Interop.DeleteObject(hObject);
				}
				currentMeasuringFont = font;
			}
			return true;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public void Reset()
		{
			currentMeasuringFont = null;
			if (defaultFont != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				Gdi32Interop.DeleteObject(Gdi32Interop.SelectObject(hdc, defaultFont));
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			graphics?.ReleaseHdc(hdc);
			graphics?.Dispose();
			bitmap?.Dispose();
			graphics = null;
			bitmap = null;
		}
	}

		private static short ConvertToShort(double value)
		{
			return (short)Math.Ceiling(value);
		}

		public static void CreateFontFiles(string fontName, PdfFont font, PdfFontDataType1 fontFileData, string pfmFileName, string pfbFileName)
		{
			AfmPfbCreator afmPfbCreator = new AfmPfbCreator(fontName, font, fontFileData, pfmFileName, pfbFileName);
			try
			{
				afmPfbCreator.CreateFiles();
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)afmPfbCreator)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private AfmPfbCreator(string fontName, PdfFont font, PdfFontDataType1 fontFileData, string pfmFileName, string pfbFileName)
		{
			//IL_00c4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ca: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00cc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ce: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00da: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00dc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00de: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00f2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f6: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			this.fontName = fontName;
			this.font = font;
			this.fontFileData = fontFileData;
			PdfFontDescriptor fontDescriptor = font.FontDescriptor;
			if (fontDescriptor == null)
			{
				top = 0;
				height = 0;
				fontWeight = 400;
				pitchAndFamily = 48;
				avgWidth = 0;
				maxWidth = 0;
				capHeight = 0;
				xHeight = 0;
				ascent = 0;
				descent = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				PdfRectangle fontBBox = fontDescriptor.FontBBox;
				top = ConvertToShort(fontBBox.Top);
				height = ConvertToShort(Math.Max(0.0, fontBBox.Height - 1000.0));
				fontWeight = (short)fontDescriptor.FontWeight;
				PdfFontFlags flags = fontDescriptor.Flags;
				if ((flags & 2) == 2)
				{
					pitchAndFamily = 16;
				}
				else if ((flags & 8) == 8)
				{
					pitchAndFamily = 64;
				}
				else
				{
					pitchAndFamily = 48;
				}
				if ((flags & 1) == 1)
				{
					pitchAndFamily++;
				}
				avgWidth = ConvertToShort(fontDescriptor.AvgWidth);
				maxWidth = ConvertToShort(fontDescriptor.MaxWidth);
				capHeight = ConvertToShort(fontDescriptor.CapHeight);
				xHeight = ConvertToShort(fontDescriptor.XHeight);
				ascent = ConvertToShort(fontDescriptor.Ascent);
				descent = ConvertToShort(Math.Abs(fontDescriptor.Descent));
			}
			pfmStream = CreateStream(pfmFileName);
			pfbStream = CreateStream(pfbFileName);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				pfmStream.Dispose();
				pfbStream.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void WriteByte(byte value)
		{
			pfmStream.WriteByte(value);
		}

		private void WriteShort(short value)
		{
			pfmStream.WriteByte((byte)(value & 0xFF));
			pfmStream.WriteByte((byte)((value & 0xFF00) >> 8));
		}

		private void WriteInt(Stream stream, int value)
		{
			stream.WriteByte((byte)(value & 0xFF));
			stream.WriteByte((byte)((value & 0xFF00) >> 8));
			stream.WriteByte((byte)((value & 0xFF0000) >> 16));
			stream.WriteByte((byte)((value & 0xFF000000u) >> 24));
		}

		private void WriteString(string value)
		{
			foreach (char c in value)
			{
				pfmStream.WriteByte((byte)c);
			}
			pfmStream.WriteByte(0);
		}

		private void CreateFiles()
		{
			//IL_0099: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			byte[] data = ((PdfFontData)fontFileData).Data;
			int plainTextLength = fontFileData.PlainTextLength;
			int cipherTextLength = fontFileData.CipherTextLength;
			int nullSegmentLength = fontFileData.NullSegmentLength;
			pfbStream.WriteByte(128);
			pfbStream.WriteByte(1);
			WriteInt(pfbStream, plainTextLength);
			pfbStream.Write(data, 0, plainTextLength);
			pfbStream.WriteByte(128);
			pfbStream.WriteByte(2);
			if (PdfType1FontEexecCipher.IsASCIICipher(data, plainTextLength))
			{
				byte[] array = new PdfType1FontEexecBinaryCipher(((PdfType1FontCipher)PdfType1FontEexecCipher.Create(data, plainTextLength, cipherTextLength)).Decrypt()).Encrypt();

			pfbStream.WriteByte(128);
			pfbStream.WriteByte(1);
			if (nullSegmentLength == 0)
			{

			}
			else
			{

			}
			pfbStream.WriteByte(128);
			pfbStream.WriteByte(3);
			WriteShort(256);
			WriteInt(pfmStream, 0);

			WriteByte(0);
			WriteByte(0);
			WriteShort(0);
			WriteInt(pfmStream, 199);
			WriteInt(pfmStream, 210);
			WriteInt(pfmStream, 0);
			WriteInt(pfmStream, 0);
			WriteShort(30);
			WriteInt(pfmStream, 147);
			WriteInt(pfmStream, 0);
			WriteInt(pfmStream, 0);
			WriteInt(pfmStream, 0);
			WriteInt(pfmStream, 0);
			WriteInt(pfmStream, 0);
			WriteInt(pfmStream, 0);
			WriteShort(52);
			WriteShort(240);
			WriteShort(0);
			WriteShort(1000);

namespace DevExpress.Pdf.Drawing.Extensions

	internal static class DrawingExtensions
	{
		public static Size ToGDISizeI(this PdfSize size, float scale = 1f)
		{
			return new Size(Math.Max(1, Convert.ToInt32(((PdfSize)(ref size)).Width * (double)scale)), Math.Max(1, Convert.ToInt32(((PdfSize)(ref size)).Height * (double)scale)));
		}

		public static Size ToGDISizeI(this PdfSize size, Size maximumSize)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return size.ToGDISizeI(Math.Min((float)maximumSize.Width / (float)PdfMathUtils.Max(1.0, ((PdfSize)(ref size)).Width), (float)maximumSize.Height / (float)PdfMathUtils.Max(1.0, ((PdfSize)(ref size)).Height)));
		}

		public static SizeF ToGDISizeF(this PdfSize size, float scale = 1f)
		{
			return new SizeF((float)Math.Max(1.0, ((PdfSize)(ref size)).Width * (double)scale), (float)Math.Max(1.0, ((PdfSize)(ref size)).Height * (double)scale));
		}

		public static PointF Div(this PointF point, float value)
		{
			return new PointF(point.X / value, point.Y / value);
		}

		public static PointF Mul(this PointF point, float value)
		{
			return new PointF(point.X * value, point.Y * value);
		}

		public static void DrawRectangle(this Graphics graphics, Pen pen, RectangleF rectangle)
		{
			graphics.DrawRectangle(pen, rectangle.X, rectangle.Y, rectangle.Width, rectangle.Height);
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Pdf.Drawing.Common

	public abstract class RenderFontStorage<TRenderFont> : IDisposable where TRenderFont : class
	{
		private readonly IDictionary<PdfFont, TRenderFont> storage = new Dictionary<PdfFont, TRenderFont>();

		public TRenderFont GetRenderFont(PdfFont font)
		{
			if (!storage.TryGetValue(font, out var value))
			{
				value = CreateRenderFont(font);
				if (value == null)
				{
					value = SubstituteRenderFont(font);
				}
				storage.Add(font, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public virtual void RemoveRenderFont(PdfFont font)
		{
			if (storage.TryGetValue(font, out var value))
			{
				DisposeItem(value);
			}
			storage.Remove(font);
		}

		private TRenderFont CreateRenderFont(PdfFont font)
		{
			try
			{
				PdfFontProgramFacade fontProgramFacade = font.FontProgramFacade;
				PdfTrueTypeFontProgramFacade val = (PdfTrueTypeFontProgramFacade)(object)((fontProgramFacade is PdfTrueTypeFontProgramFacade) ? fontProgramFacade : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					return CreateTTFRenderFont(font, val.Data);
				}
				PdfCFFFontProgramFacade val2 = (PdfCFFFontProgramFacade)(object)((fontProgramFacade is PdfCFFFontProgramFacade) ? fontProgramFacade : null);
				if (val2 != null)
				{
					return CreateCFFRenderFont(font, val2.Data);
				}
				PdfType1FontProgramFacade val3 = (PdfType1FontProgramFacade)(object)((fontProgramFacade is PdfType1FontProgramFacade) ? fontProgramFacade : null);
				if (val3 != null)
				{
					return CreateType1RenderFont(font, val3.Data);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				Clear();
			}
		}

		private void DisposeItem(TRenderFont item)
		{
			if (item is IDisposable disposable)
			{
				disposable.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public virtual void Clear()
		{
			foreach (TRenderFont value in storage.Values)
			{
				DisposeItem(value);
			}
			storage.Clear();
		}

		~RenderFontStorage()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected abstract TRenderFont SubstituteRenderFont(PdfFont font);

		protected abstract TRenderFont CreateTTFRenderFont(PdfFont font, byte[] ttfFile);

		protected abstract TRenderFont CreateCFFRenderFont(PdfFont font, byte[] cffFile);

		protected abstract TRenderFont CreateType1RenderFont(PdfFont font, PdfFontDataType1 type1File);
	}
	public static class RenderFontStorageHelpers
	{
		public static string CreateFontName()
		{
			return Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0, 31);
		}

		private static short Min(short? first, short second)
		{
			if (!first.HasValue)
			{
				return second;
			}
			return Math.Min(first.Value, second);
		}

		private static short Max(short? first, short second)
		{
			if (!first.HasValue)
			{
				return second;
			}
			return Math.Max(first.Value, second);
		}

		public static byte[] ValidateTTF(PdfFont font, byte[] fontFileData, string fontName)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_029a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02a4: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_01b3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01bd: Expected O, but got Unknown
			PdfFontFile val = new PdfFontFile(fontFileData);
			try
			{
				val.Version = PdfFontFile.TTFVersion;
				PdfFontDescriptor fontDescriptor = font.FontDescriptor;
				bool isSymbolic = font.IsSymbolic;
				PdfFontCmapTableDirectoryEntry val2 = new PdfFontCmapTableDirectoryEntry(new PdfFontCmapSegmentMappingFormatEntry((PdfFontEncodingID)1));
				val.AddTable((PdfFontTableDirectoryEntry)(object)val2);
				PdfFontNameTableDirectoryEntry val3 = new PdfFontNameTableDirectoryEntry(val2, fontName ?? font.BaseFont ?? CreateFontName());
				val.AddTable((PdfFontTableDirectoryEntry)(object)val3);
				PdfFontHheaTableDirectoryEntry hhea = val.Hhea;
				PdfFontOS2TableDirectoryEntry oS = val.OS2;
				PdfFontHeadTableDirectoryEntry head = val.Head;
				if (hhea != null && hhea.Ascender == 0 && hhea.Descender == 0)
				{
					hhea.Ascender = 1;
					hhea.Descender = -1;
				}
				if (oS != null)
				{
					if (hhea != null)
					{
						short ascender = hhea.Ascender;
						if (ascender > oS.WinAscent)
						{
							oS.WinAscent = ascender;
						}
						short num = (short)(-hhea.Descender);
						if (num > oS.WinDescent)
						{
							oS.WinDescent = num;
						}
					}
					if (head != null && fontDescriptor != null)
					{
						PdfRectangle fontBBox = fontDescriptor.FontBBox;
						if (fontBBox != null)
						{
							double top = fontBBox.Top;
							double bottom = fontBBox.Bottom;
							double num2 = (double)head.UnitsPerEm / (top - bottom);
							short num3 = (short)(num2 * top);
							if (num3 > oS.WinAscent)
							{
								oS.WinAscent = num3;
							}
							short num4 = (short)((0.0 - num2) * bottom);
							if (num4 > oS.WinDescent)
							{
								oS.WinDescent = num4;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				PdfFontHmtxTableDirectoryEntry hmtx = val.Hmtx;
				if (hmtx != null)
				{
					PdfFontMaxpTableDirectoryEntry maxp = val.Maxp;
					int num5 = Math.Max((hhea != null) ? hhea.NumberOfHMetrics : 0, (maxp != null) ? maxp.NumGlyphs : 0) * 4;
					if (((PdfFontTableDirectoryEntry)hmtx).TableData.Length < num5)
					{
						byte[] array = new byte[num5];
						Array.Copy(((PdfFontTableDirectoryEntry)hmtx).TableData, array, ((PdfFontTableDirectoryEntry)hmtx).TableData.Length);
						val.AddTable((PdfFontTableDirectoryEntry)new PdfFontHmtxTableDirectoryEntry(array));
					}
				}
				if (head != null && val.Glyf != null)
				{
					short num6 = head.XMin;
					short num7 = head.YMin;
					short num8 = head.XMax;
					short num9 = head.YMax;
					foreach (PdfGlyphDescription value in val.Glyf.Glyphs.Values)
					{
						num6 = Min(value.XMin, num6);
						num7 = Min(value.YMin, num7);
						num8 = Max(value.XMax, num8);
						num9 = Max(value.YMax, num9);
					}
					head.XMin = num6;
					head.XMax = num8;
					head.YMin = num7;
					head.YMax = num9;
				}
				if (val.Post == null)
				{
					val.AddTable((PdfFontTableDirectoryEntry)new PdfFontPostTableDirectoryEntry(font));
				}
				return val.GetData();
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Pdf.Drawing.DirectX

	public class PdfDirectXAtlasCache
	{
		private const int padding = 1;

		private const int doublePadding = 2;

		private const int maxAtlasDimension = 8192;

		private const int maxAtlasSampleCount = 65536;

		private const int smallMaskImageSampleCount = 16384;

		private const int minimumSmallImageCount = 20;

		private static readonly Size atlasSize = new Size(8192, 8192);

		private readonly IDictionary<PdfRenderImageAtlas, PdfDirectXImageAtlas> atlasStorage;

		private readonly PdfRenderImageAtlasMapping mapping;

		public static PdfRenderImageAtlasMapping CreateAtlasMap(ISet<PdfImage> images)
		{
			ISet<PdfImage> set = new HashSet<PdfImage>(images.Where((PdfImage img) => IsSmallImage(img)));
			if (set.Count >= 20)
			{
				return PdfRenderImageAtlasFactory.CreateAtlases(set, atlasSize, 1, 65536);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static bool IsSmallImage(PdfImage image)
		{
			if (image.Width + 2 > 8192 || image.Height + 2 > 8192 || image.SMask != null || image.Mask != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (image.Width == 1 || image.Height == 1)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (image.IsMask)
			{
				return image.Width * image.Height <= 16384;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static IDictionary<PdfRenderImageAtlas, PdfDirectXImageAtlas> CreateAtlasMap(PdfRenderImageAtlasMapping mapping, PdfDirectXRenderingContext context)
		{
			if (mapping == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Dictionary<PdfRenderImageAtlas, PdfDirectXImageAtlas> dictionary = new Dictionary<PdfRenderImageAtlas, PdfDirectXImageAtlas>();
			foreach (PdfRenderImageAtlas atlase in mapping.Atlases)
			{
				PdfDirectXImageAtlas value = new PdfDirectXImageAtlas(context, atlase, 1);
				dictionary.Add(atlase, value);
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		public PdfDirectXAtlasCache(PdfDirectXPage page, PdfDirectXRenderingContext context)
		{
			atlasStorage = CreateAtlasMap(page.Atlas, context);
			mapping = page.Atlas;
		}

		public PdfDirectXImageAtlasItem GetAtlasItem(PdfImage image, bool shouldInterpolate)
		{
			PdfRenderImageAtlas pdfRenderImageAtlas = mapping?.GetAtlas(image);
			if (pdfRenderImageAtlas == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return atlasStorage[pdfRenderImageAtlas].GetAtlasItem(image, shouldInterpolate);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (atlasStorage == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (PdfDirectXImageAtlas value in atlasStorage.Values)
			{
				value.Dispose();
			}
		}
	}

			protected void CopyWithMargin(D2D_RECT_U dstRect, IntPtr ptr, int width, int height, int stride)
			{
				//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0079: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0088: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

				//IL_0105: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

				D2D_RECT_U val2 = default(D2D_RECT_U);

			}

			{
				((IDisposable)systemFontCollection)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected override DWriteFont GetFirstMatchingNativeFont(DirectWriteSystemFontFamily family, DXFontDescriptor descriptor)
		{
			DWriteFontCollection systemFontCollection = factory.GetSystemFontCollection(false);
			try
			{
				DWriteFontFamily fontFamily = systemFontCollection.GetFontFamily(family.FamilyIndex);
				try
				{
					return fontFamily.GetFirstMatchingFont((DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT)descriptor.Weight, (DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH)descriptor.Stretch, (DWRITE_FONT_STYLE)descriptor.Slant);
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)fontFamily)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)systemFontCollection)?.Dispose();
			}
		}
	}
	public class DirectWriteSystemFont : IFont
	{
		public DirectWriteSystemFontFamily Family { get; }

		public int FontIndex { get; }

		public bool IsSerif { get; }

		public bool IsMonospaced { get; }

		public bool IsSymbol { get; }

		public string PostScriptName { get; }

		public DirectWriteSystemFont(DirectWriteSystemFontFamily parent, DWriteFont1 font, int fontIndex)
		{
			Family = parent;
			FontIndex = fontIndex;
			byte[] panose = font.GetPanose();
			IsSerif = panose[0] == 2 && panose[1] < 11;
			IsMonospaced = font.IsMonospacedFont();
			IsSymbol = ((DWriteFont)font).IsSymbolFont();
			DWriteLocalizedStrings informationalStrings = ((DWriteFont)font).GetInformationalStrings((DWRITE_INFORMATIONAL_STRING_ID)17);
			try
			{
				if (informationalStrings == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				int count = informationalStrings.GetCount();
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (informationalStrings.GetLocaleName(i) == "en-us")
					{
						PostScriptName = informationalStrings.GetString(i);
						break;
					}
					if (PostScriptName == null)
					{
						PostScriptName = informationalStrings.GetString(i);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)informationalStrings)?.Dispose();
			}
		}
	}
	public class DirectWriteSystemFontFamily : IFontFamily<DirectWriteSystemFont>
	{
		public int FamilyIndex { get; }

		public HashSet<string> FamilyNames { get; }

		public IList<DirectWriteSystemFont> Fonts { get; }

		public DirectWriteSystemFontFamily(DWriteFontFamily family, int familyIndex)
		{
			//IL_007d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			FamilyIndex = familyIndex;
			FamilyNames = new HashSet<string>();
			DWriteLocalizedStrings familyNames = family.GetFamilyNames();
			try
			{
				int count = familyNames.GetCount();
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					FamilyNames.Add(familyNames.GetString(i));
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)familyNames)?.Dispose();
			}
			int fontCount = ((DWriteFontList)family).GetFontCount();
			Fonts = new List<DirectWriteSystemFont>();
			for (int j = 0; j < fontCount; j++)
			{
				DWriteFont font = ((DWriteFontList)family).GetFont(j);
				try
				{
					DWriteFont1 val = font.AsDWriteFont1();
					try
					{
						if ((int)((DWriteFont)val).GetSimulations() == 0)
						{
							Fonts.Add(new DirectWriteSystemFont(this, val, j));
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)font)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}
	}

		private void FillGeometryWithBrush(D2D1Geometry geometry, D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F transform, D2D1Brush brush)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		private void FillGeometryWithBrush(IPdfDirectXGeometryObject obj, D2D1Brush brush)
		{
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PdfTransformationMatrix val = PdfTransformationMatrix.Multiply(obj.Transform, viewInfo.DeviceTransform);
			float num = obj.Geometry.ComputeArea(val.ToD2DMatrix(), 0.25f);
			if (num == 0f)
			{
				StrokeHairline(obj.Geometry, brush, pageContext.FillGeometryStrokeInfo, val);
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (obj.IsAxisAligned && val.IsNotRotated)
			{
				PdfRectangle val2 = viewInfo.DeviceTransform.TransformBoundingBox(obj.BoundingBox);
				flag = val2.Width > 1.0 && val2.Height > 1.0;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				((D2D1RenderTarget)DeviceContext).SetAntialiasMode((D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE)1);
			}
			try
			{
				if (ShouldApplyTransformProgrammatically(val))
				{
					D2D1TransformedGeometry val3 = ((D2D1Factory)Factory).CreateTransformedGeometry(obj.Geometry, val.ToD2DMatrix());
					try
					{
						FillGeometryWithBrush((D2D1Geometry)(object)val3, D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F.Identity, brush);
						return;
					}
					finally
					{
						((IDisposable)val3)?.Dispose();
					}
				}
				FillGeometryWithBrush(obj.Geometry, val.ToD2DMatrix(), brush);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					((D2D1RenderTarget)DeviceContext).SetAntialiasMode((D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE)0);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsHairline(PdfTransformationMatrix fullTransform, float lineWidth)
		{
			if (lineWidth == 0f)
			{
				return true;
			}
			float dpiScale = viewInfo.Options.DpiScale;
			return (double)(lineWidth * dpiScale) * Math.Sqrt(fullTransform.A * fullTransform.A + fullTransform.B * fullTransform.B) < 0.5;
		}

		private D2D1StrokeStyle CreateHairlineStrokeStyle(PdfTransformationMatrix transform, float hairlineLineWidth, float sourceLineWidth, D2D1StrokeStyle sourceStyle)
		{
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ad: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0060: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0091: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			float[] dashes = sourceStyle.GetDashes();
			float[] array;
			float num;
			if (dashes.Length != 0)
			{
				float dashOffset = sourceStyle.GetDashOffset();
				array = new float[dashes.Length];
				PdfPoint val = transform.Transform(new PdfPoint(0.0, 0.0));
				for (int i = 0; i < dashes.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = (float)PdfPoint.Distance(val, transform.Transform(new PdfPoint((double)(dashes[i] * sourceLineWidth), 0.0))) / hairlineLineWidth;
				}
				num = (float)PdfPoint.Distance(val, transform.Transform(new PdfPoint((double)(dashOffset * sourceLineWidth), 0.0))) / hairlineLineWidth;
			}
			else
			{
				array = null;
				num = 0f;
			}
			D2D1_STROKE_STYLE_PROPERTIES1 val2 = default(D2D1_STROKE_STYLE_PROPERTIES1);
			((D2D1_STROKE_STYLE_PROPERTIES1)(ref val2))..ctor(sourceStyle.GetEndCap(), sourceStyle.GetLineJoin(), sourceStyle.GetMiterLimit(), array != null, num, false);
			return Factory.CreateStrokeStyle(val2, array, (array != null) ? array.Length : 0);
		}

		private void StrokeHairline(D2D1Geometry geometry, D2D1Brush brush, PdfDirectXStrokeInfo strokeInfo, PdfTransformationMatrix fullTransform)
		{
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ResetTransform();
			float num = ((strokeInfo.LineWidth == 0f && !viewInfo.Options.IsPrinting) ? 0.5f : 1f);
			float num2 = num / viewInfo.Options.DpiScale;
			D2D1Geometry val = (D2D1Geometry)(object)((D2D1Factory)Factory).CreateTransformedGeometry(geometry, fullTransform.ToD2DMatrix());
			try
			{
				D2D1StrokeStyle val2 = CreateHairlineStrokeStyle(fullTransform, num2, strokeInfo.LineWidth, strokeInfo.StrokeStyle);
				try
				{
					((D2D1RenderTarget)DeviceContext).DrawGeometry(val, brush, num2, val2);
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val2)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldApplyTransformProgrammatically(PdfTransformationMatrix matrix)
		{
			if (viewInfo.Options.IsPrinting && !viewInfo.Options.IsXpsPrinting)
			{
				return Math.Abs(matrix.Determinant) < 1.1920929E-07;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void StrokeGeometryWithBrush(PdfDirectXStrokePathObject obj, D2D1Brush brush)
		{
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00aa: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PdfDirectXStrokeInfo strokeInfo = obj.StrokeInfo;
			PdfTransformationMatrix transform = obj.Transform;
			PdfTransformationMatrix val = PdfTransformationMatrix.Multiply(transform, viewInfo.DeviceTransform);
			if (IsHairline(val, strokeInfo.LineWidth))
			{
				StrokeHairline(obj.Geometry, brush, strokeInfo, val);
				return;
			}
			if (!ShouldApplyTransformProgrammatically(val))
			{
				((D2D1RenderTarget)DeviceContext).SetTransform(val.ToD2DMatrix());
				((D2D1RenderTarget)DeviceContext).DrawGeometry(obj.Geometry, brush, strokeInfo.LineWidth, strokeInfo.StrokeStyle);
				return;
			}
			SetUserTransform(PdfTransformationMatrix.Identity);
			D2D1PathGeometry val2 = ((D2D1Factory)Factory).CreatePathGeometry();
			try
			{
				D2D1GeometrySink val3 = val2.Open();
				try
				{
					obj.Geometry.Widen(strokeInfo.LineWidth, strokeInfo.StrokeStyle, transform.ToD2DMatrix(), 0.5f, (D2D1SimplifiedGeometrySink)(object)val3);
					((D2D1SimplifiedGeometrySink)val3).Close();
					((D2D1RenderTarget)DeviceContext).FillGeometry((D2D1Geometry)(object)val2, brush);
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val3)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val2)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void FillGlyphRunWithBrush(PdfDirectXGlyphRunObject obj, D2D1Brush brush)
		{
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0074: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (viewInfo.Options.PrintTextAsOutlines)
			{
				SetUserTransform(obj.Transform);
				((D2D1RenderTarget)DeviceContext).FillGeometry(obj.GlyphRun.TextGeometry, brush);
				return;
			}
			PdfDirectXGlyphRun glyphRun = obj.GlyphRun;
			SetUserTransform(PdfTransformationMatrix.Multiply(glyphRun.TextTransform, obj.Transform));
			((D2D1RenderTarget)DeviceContext).SetTextAntialiasMode(GetTextAntialiasMode());
			try
			{
				((D2D1RenderTarget)DeviceContext).DrawGlyphRun(D2D_POINT_2F.Empty, glyphRun.GlyphRun, brush, (DWRITE_MEASURING_MODE)0);
			}
			finally
			{
				((D2D1RenderTarget)DeviceContext).SetTextAntialiasMode((D2D1_TEXT_ANTIALIAS_MODE)0);
			}
		}

		private D2D1_TEXT_ANTIALIAS_MODE GetTextAntialiasMode()

		}

		private PdfDirectXObjectPaint CreateObjectPaint(PdfDirectXObject obj)

		private void PaintObject(PdfDirectXObjectPaint paint, Action renderAction)
		{
			ResetTransform();
			using (paint)
			{
				renderTarget.BeginRenderObject(paint, viewInfo.DeviceTransform);
				try
				{
					renderAction();
				}
				finally
				{
					renderTarget.EndRenderObject();
				}
			}
		}

		private void FillWithTilingPattern(PdfDirectXTilingPattern pattern, PdfRectangle fillBounds)
		{
			PdfRectangle boundingBox = pattern.BoundingBox;
			float num = (float)Math.Abs(pattern.XStep);
			float num2 = (float)Math.Abs(pattern.YStep);
			PdfRectangle val = PdfTransformationMatrix.Invert(pattern.PatternMatrix).TransformBoundingBox(PdfRectangle.Intersect(viewInfo.Viewport, fillBounds));
			float num3;
			float num4;
			if ((double)num >= boundingBox.Width && (double)num2 >= boundingBox.Height)
			{
				num3 = (float)Math.Floor(val.Left / (double)num) * num;
				num4 = (float)Math.Floor(val.Bottom / (double)num2) * num2;
			}
			else
			{
				num3 = (float)(Math.Floor(val.Left / (double)num) - 1.0) * num;
				num4 = (float)(Math.Floor(val.Bottom / (double)num2) - 1.0) * num2;
			}
			float num5 = (float)Math.Ceiling(val.Right / (double)num) * num;
			float num6 = (float)Math.Ceiling(val.Top / (double)num2) * num2;
			List<float> list = new List<float>();
			List<float> list2 = new List<float>();
			for (float num7 = num3; num7 < num5; num7 += num)
			{
				list.Add(num7);
			}
			for (float num8 = num4; num8 < num6; num8 += num2)
			{
				list2.Add(num8);
			}
			if (pattern.XStep < 0.0)
			{
				list.Reverse();
			}
			if (pattern.YStep < 0.0)
			{
				list2.Reverse();
			}
			ResetTransform();
			foreach (float item in list)
			{
				foreach (float item2 in list2)
				{
					PdfTransformationMatrix deviceTransform = PdfTransformationMatrix.Multiply(PdfTransformationMatrix.Multiply(PdfTransformationMatrix.CreateTranslate((double)item, (double)item2), pattern.PatternMatrix), viewInfo.DeviceTransform);
					PdfDirectXRenderTargetView pdfDirectXRenderTargetView = new PdfDirectXRenderTargetView(deviceTransform, boundingBox, viewInfo.DefaultBrush, viewInfo.Options);
					pattern.PatternCommands.Render(new PdfDirectXRenderingDeviceContext(pageContext, pdfDirectXRenderTargetView, renderTarget));
				}
			}
		}

		private void PaintObject(PdfDirectXObjectPaint paint, PdfDirectXShadingPatternBrush brush, IPdfDirectXGeometryObject obj)

		private static int CalcDistance(PdfPoint start, PdfPoint end, double imageScaleFactor)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		}

		private static bool ShouldInterpolate(PdfImage image, Size requestedSize)
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (image.Interpolate)
			{
				return true;
			}
			double num = 3.0;
			PdfSize imageSizeConsideringMasks = image.GetImageSizeConsideringMasks();
			if (!((double)(float)requestedSize.Width / ((PdfSize)(ref imageSizeConsideringMasks)).Width < num))
			{
				return (double)(float)requestedSize.Height / ((PdfSize)(ref imageSizeConsideringMasks)).Height < num;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private D2D1Image ApplyLuminocity(PdfDirectXSoftMask softMaskInfo, D2D1Image maskImage)
		{
			if (!softMaskInfo.IsLuminosity)
			{
				return maskImage;
			}
			D2D1Effect val = PdfDirectXEffectFactory.CreateColorMatrixEffect(DeviceContext, maskImage);
			try
			{
				return val.GetOutput();
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private D2D1Image ApplyTransferFunction(PdfDirectXSoftMask softMaskInfo, D2D1Image maskImage)
		{
			if (softMaskInfo.TransferFunction.IsIdentity)
			{
				return maskImage;
			}
			D2D1Effect val = PdfDirectXEffectFactory.CreateAlphaTableTransferEffect(DeviceContext, maskImage, CreateFunctionMappingTable(softMaskInfo.TransferFunction));
			try
			{
				return val.GetOutput();
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private static float[] CreateFunctionMappingTable(PdfFunction function)
		{
			float[] array = new float[256];
			for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++)
			{
				array[i] = (float)function.Transform(new double[1] { (double)i / 255.0 })[0];
			}
			return array;
		}

		private void SetDeviceTransform(D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F transform)
		{

			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		private bool MatrixEquals(D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F m1, D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F m2)
		{
			if (((D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F)(ref m1)).M11 == ((D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F)(ref m2)).M11 && ((D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F)(ref m1)).M12 == ((D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F)(ref m2)).M12 && ((D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F)(ref m1)).M21 == ((D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F)(ref m2)).M21 && ((D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F)(ref m1)).M22 == ((D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F)(ref m2)).M22 && ((D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F)(ref m1)).Dx == ((D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F)(ref m2)).Dx)
			{
				return ((D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F)(ref m1)).Dy == ((D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F)(ref m2)).Dy;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ApplyKnockout(PdfDirectXTransparencyGroupObject obj)
		{
			if (obj.Knockout)
			{
				DeviceContext.SetPrimitiveBlend((D2D1_PRIMITIVE_BLEND)1);
			}
			try
			{
				obj.Form?.Render(this);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (obj.Knockout)
				{
					DeviceContext.SetPrimitiveBlend((D2D1_PRIMITIVE_BLEND)0);
				}
			}
		}

	public static class PdfDirectXShaderCache
	{
		private static IDictionary<string, byte[]> compiledShadersCache = new Dictionary<string, byte[]>();

		private static byte[] CompileShader(string shaderName, string shaderTarget)
		{
			Stream manifestResourceStream = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly().GetManifestResourceStream(shaderName);
			byte[] array = new byte[manifestResourceStream.Length];
			manifestResourceStream.Read(array, 0, array.Length);
			D3DBlob val = D3DNativeInterop.D3DCompile(array, "main", shaderTarget);
			try
			{
				return val.GetData();
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public static byte[] GetCompliedShader(string shaderResourceName, string shaderTarget)
		{
			if (!compiledShadersCache.TryGetValue(shaderResourceName, out var value))
			{
				value = CompileShader(shaderResourceName, shaderTarget);
				compiledShadersCache.Add(shaderResourceName, value);
			}
			return value;
		}
	}
	public class PdfDirectXVertexesBuilder
	{
		private readonly Vertex[] vertices;

		private int v;

		private float minX = float.MaxValue;

		private float minY = float.MaxValue;

		private float maxX = float.MinValue;

		private float maxY = float.MinValue;

		public Vertex[] Vertices => vertices;

		{
			vertices[v++] = CreateVertex(triangle.Vertex1);
			vertices[v++] = CreateVertex(triangle.Vertex2);
			vertices[v++] = CreateVertex(triangle.Vertex3);
		}

		private Vertex CreateVertex(PdfRenderingVertex vertex)
		{
			float x = vertex.Point.X;
			float y = vertex.Point.Y;
			minX = Math.Min(minX, x);
			maxX = Math.Max(maxX, x);
			minY = Math.Min(minY, y);
			maxY = Math.Max(maxY, y);
			Color color = vertex.Color;
			return new Vertex(new FLOAT2(x, y), new FLOAT4((float)(int)color.R / 255f, (float)(int)color.G / 255f, (float)(int)color.B / 255f, 1f));
		}

	public interface IPdfDirectXObjectPaint
	{
		IPdfDirectXGraphicsObjectClip Clip { get; }

		IReadOnlyList<IPdfDirectXGraphicsObjectClip> Layers { get; }
	}
	public class PdfDirectXObjectPaint : IPdfDirectXObjectPaint, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly List<IPdfDirectXGraphicsObjectClip> layers = new List<IPdfDirectXGraphicsObjectClip>();

		private readonly List<bool> disposeFlags = new List<bool>();

		public IPdfDirectXGraphicsObjectClip Clip { get; private set; }

		public IReadOnlyList<IPdfDirectXGraphicsObjectClip> Layers => layers;

		public void SetClip(IPdfDirectXGraphicsObjectClip clip)
		{
			Clip = clip;
		}

		public void AddLayer(IPdfDirectXGraphicsObjectClip layer, bool disposeLayer)
		{
			if (layer != null)
			{
				layers.Add(layer);
				disposeFlags.Add(disposeLayer);
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < layers.Count; i++)
			{
				if (disposeFlags[i])
				{
					layers[i].Dispose();
				}
			}

	public abstract class PdfDirectXClipBuilder : IDisposable
	{
		private readonly PdfDirectXPageContext context;

		private readonly PdfRectangle clipBounds;

		public PdfRectangle ClipBounds => clipBounds;

		protected PdfDirectXPageContext Context => context;

		private static D2D1Geometry TransformGeometry(D2D1Geometry geometry, PdfDirectXPageContext context)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			float num = geometry.ComputeArea(D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F.Identity, 0.25f);
			if (num == 0f)
			{
				D2D1PathGeometry val = context.CreatePathGeometry();
				D2D1StrokeStyle val2 = context.CreateStrokeStyle();
				try
				{
					D2D1GeometrySink val3 = val.Open();
					try
					{
						geometry.Widen(1f, val2, D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F.Identity, 0.25f, (D2D1SimplifiedGeometrySink)(object)val3);
						((D2D1SimplifiedGeometrySink)val3).Close();
					}
					finally
					{
						((IDisposable)val3)?.Dispose();
					}
					((ComObject)geometry).Dispose();
					return (D2D1Geometry)(object)val;
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val2)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return geometry;
		}

		public static PdfDirectXClipBuilder Create(PdfDirectXPageContext context, PdfRectangle boundingBox, PdfTransformationMatrix transformationMatrix, PdfDirectXClipBuilder parentClip)
		{
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (transformationMatrix.IsNotRotated)
			{
				if (parentClip != null)
				{
					return parentClip.Combine(transformationMatrix.TransformBoundingBox(boundingBox));
				}
				return new PdfDirectXAxisAlignedClipBuilder(context, transformationMatrix.TransformBoundingBox(boundingBox));
			}
			D2D1Geometry val = context.CreateGeometry(boundingBox);
			try
			{
				return (parentClip == null) ? new PdfDirectXGenericClipBuilder(context, context.CreateTransformedGeometry(val, transformationMatrix.ToD2DMatrix())) : parentClip.Combine(val, transformationMatrix.ToD2DMatrix());
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected static PdfRectangle GetBounds(D2D1Geometry geometry)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return geometry.GetBounds(D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F.Identity).ToPdfRectangle();
		}

		protected PdfDirectXClipBuilder(PdfDirectXPageContext context, PdfRectangle clipBounds)
		{
			this.context = context;
			this.clipBounds = clipBounds;
		}

		public PdfDirectXClipBuilder Combine(IList<PdfGraphicsPath> paths, bool nonZero, PdfTransformationMatrix transformationMatrix)
		{
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PdfRectangle axisAlignedRectangleFromPath = GetAxisAlignedRectangleFromPath(paths, transformationMatrix);
			if (axisAlignedRectangleFromPath != null)
			{
				return Combine(axisAlignedRectangleFromPath);
			}
			D2D1Geometry val = TransformGeometry(context.CreateGeometry(paths, outlineOnly: false, nonZero).Geometry, context);
			try
			{
				return Combine(val, transformationMatrix.ToD2DMatrix());
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public abstract void Dispose();

		public abstract PdfDirectXClipBuilder Combine(D2D1Geometry geometry, D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F geometryTransform);

		public abstract PdfDirectXClipBuilder Combine(PdfRectangle rectangle);

		protected PdfDirectXClipBuilder CombineGeometries(D2D1Geometry geometry, D2D1Geometry inputGeometry, D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F inputGeometryTransform)
		{
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

				((D2D1SimplifiedGeometrySink)val2).Close();
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val2)?.Dispose();
			}
			return new PdfDirectXGenericClipBuilder(context, (D2D1Geometry)(object)val);
		}

		protected PdfRectangle GetAxisAlignedRectangleFromPath(IList<PdfGraphicsPath> paths, PdfTransformationMatrix matrix)
		{
			if (!matrix.IsNotRotated || paths.Count != 1)
			{
				return null;
			}

			if (axisAlignedRectangle != null)
			{
				return matrix.TransformBoundingBox(axisAlignedRectangle);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public abstract IPdfDirectXGraphicsObjectClip CreateObjectClip(bool isText);
	}

	public struct PdfDirectXRenderTargetObjectLayer
	{
		public IPdfDirectXGraphicsObjectClip Clip { get; }

		public IReadOnlyList<IPdfDirectXGraphicsObjectClip> Layers { get; }

		public PdfTransformationMatrix DeviceTransform { get; }

		public PdfDirectXRenderTargetObjectLayer(IPdfDirectXGraphicsObjectClip clip, IReadOnlyList<IPdfDirectXGraphicsObjectClip> layers, PdfTransformationMatrix deviceTransform)
		{
			Clip = clip;
			Layers = layers;
			DeviceTransform = deviceTransform;
		}
	}
	public abstract class PdfDirectXRenderTarget
	{
		private readonly D2D1DeviceContext deviceContext;

		private readonly List<PdfDirectXRenderTargetObjectLayer> objectLayers;

		private int currentLayerIndex = -1;

		private IPdfDirectXGraphicsObjectClip lastClip;

		private PdfTransformationMatrix lastClipDeviceTransform;

		private bool lastClipSupportsClearType;

		private bool supportsClearTypeInitial;

		protected D2D1DeviceContext DeviceContext => deviceContext;

		public bool SupportsClearType
		{
			get
			{
				if (supportsClearTypeInitial && objectLayers.Count == 1)
				{
					return objectLayers[0].Layers.Count == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<PdfDirectXRenderTargetObjectLayer> Layers => objectLayers;

		protected PdfDirectXRenderTarget(D2D1DeviceContext deviceContext, bool supportsClearType, IEnumerable<PdfDirectXRenderTargetObjectLayer> parentLayers)
		{
			this.deviceContext = deviceContext;
			supportsClearTypeInitial = supportsClearType;
			if (parentLayers != null)
			{
				objectLayers = new List<PdfDirectXRenderTargetObjectLayer>(parentLayers);
			}
			else
			{
				objectLayers = new List<PdfDirectXRenderTargetObjectLayer>();
			}
		}

		public abstract void SetAsCurrent();

		public abstract D2D1Image GetBackdrop(D2D_RECT_U srcRect, double imageScaleFactor);

		public void BeginRenderObject(IPdfDirectXObjectPaint objectPaint, PdfTransformationMatrix deviceTransform)
		{
			RestoreLayers();
			objectLayers.Add(new PdfDirectXRenderTargetObjectLayer(objectPaint.Clip, objectPaint.Layers, deviceTransform));
			currentLayerIndex = objectLayers.Count - 1;
			if (!object.Equals(lastClip, objectPaint.Clip) || lastClipDeviceTransform != deviceTransform || lastClipSupportsClearType != SupportsClearType)
			{
				lastClip?.ResetClip(deviceContext);
				objectPaint.Clip?.ApplyClip(deviceContext, deviceTransform, SupportsClearType);
			}
			lastClip = null;
			foreach (IPdfDirectXGraphicsObjectClip layer in objectPaint.Layers)
			{
				layer.ApplyClip(deviceContext, deviceTransform, SupportsClearType);
			}
		}

		public void EndRenderObject()
		{
			RestoreLayers();
			int index = objectLayers.Count - 1;
			ResetLastClip();
			PdfDirectXRenderTargetObjectLayer pdfDirectXRenderTargetObjectLayer = objectLayers[index];
			foreach (IPdfDirectXGraphicsObjectClip item in pdfDirectXRenderTargetObjectLayer.Layers.Reverse())
			{
				item.ResetClip(deviceContext);
			}
			lastClip = pdfDirectXRenderTargetObjectLayer.Clip;
			lastClipDeviceTransform = pdfDirectXRenderTargetObjectLayer.DeviceTransform;
			lastClipSupportsClearType = SupportsClearType;
			objectLayers.RemoveAt(index);
			currentLayerIndex = objectLayers.Count - 1;
		}

		public void RestoreLayers()
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			for (int i = currentLayerIndex + 1; i < objectLayers.Count; i++)
			{
				((D2D1RenderTarget)DeviceContext).SetTransform(D2D_MATRIX_3X2_F.Identity);
				PdfDirectXRenderTargetObjectLayer pdfDirectXRenderTargetObjectLayer = objectLayers[i];
				pdfDirectXRenderTargetObjectLayer.Clip?.ApplyClip(deviceContext, pdfDirectXRenderTargetObjectLayer.DeviceTransform, initializeFromBackground: false);
				foreach (IPdfDirectXGraphicsObjectClip layer in objectLayers[i].Layers)
				{
					layer.ApplyClip(deviceContext, pdfDirectXRenderTargetObjectLayer.DeviceTransform, initializeFromBackground: false);
				}
			}
			currentLayerIndex = objectLayers.Count - 1;
		}

		public void ResetLayers()
		{
			ResetLayersSoft();
			objectLayers.Clear();
		}

		private void ResetLastClip()
		{
			lastClip?.ResetClip(deviceContext);
			lastClip = null;
			lastClipDeviceTransform = null;
		}

		public void ResetLayersSoft()
		{
			ResetLastClip();
			for (int num = currentLayerIndex; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				PdfDirectXRenderTargetObjectLayer pdfDirectXRenderTargetObjectLayer = objectLayers[num];
				foreach (IPdfDirectXGraphicsObjectClip item in pdfDirectXRenderTargetObjectLayer.Layers.Reverse())
				{
					item.ResetClip(deviceContext);
				}
				pdfDirectXRenderTargetObjectLayer.Clip?.ResetClip(deviceContext);
			}
			currentLayerIndex = -1;
		}
	}
	public static class PdfUnmanagedCodeHelpers
	{
		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static void DoActionWithPinnedObject(object o, Action<IntPtr> pinnedObjectPointerAction)
		{
			GCHandle gCHandle = GCHandle.Alloc(o, GCHandleType.Pinned);
			try
			{
				pinnedObjectPointerAction(gCHandle.AddrOfPinnedObject());
			}
			finally
			{
				gCHandle.Free();
			}
		}
	}

	{
		private const int colorMatrixElementCount = 20;
